Achilles "Kalian".

Early body of data is tagged planet Madeira. Creche committee bribed, exowomb records altered. Parents: naval logistics/senior AM tech.

Exceptional creche scores despite conflict with peers. Medical reports green. Fleet Cadets program, commendation. Bribe to naval committee (action codename PORPHYRA). Application to Kazeron Academy. Graduation with full honors.

Offered piracy patrol, unexpectedly rescinded. Re-assigned to Yesod, Zagan system, awaiting assignment. Observation program disrupted by PL Fleet Intelligence; intel insufficient, request additional detail. Yesod MuniSec reports involvement in altercation, spacer bar; news suppressed by Fleet Intelligence.
texts.zh:
Achilles，代号 "Kalian"。

早期数据一律标在 Madeira 行星名下。育幼委员会被买通，体外子宫记录经过涂改。父母：一方在海军后勤，一方是资深反物质技师。

育幼院考评极优，尽管与同龄人屡有冲突。医学报告全部正常。舰队候补军官计划，获嘉奖。向海军委员会行贿 (行动代号 PORPHYRA)。申请 Kazeron 学院。以最高荣誉毕业。

已获派剿盗巡逻任务，却意外被撤销。改派至 Zagan 星系的 Yesod，等待分配。观察计划被英仙座联盟舰队情报部打乱；情报不足，请求补充细节。Yesod 的 MuniSec 报告其卷入一场斗殴，地点是太空船员酒吧；消息已被舰队情报部压下。

Cethlan commerce court: purchase of cometary body in Duzakh system, price reduced due to dispute over recognition of exploitation rights.

Project codename IRKALLA, refurbishment contract: NDAs, list of tech specs, unusual bio-support equipment, re-orbit to L4-point of Duzahk fringe jump-point.

Contract with Neurozenith Cybernetic Solutions Group (NCSG) for an extended program, anonymous package. Additional contracts with numbered fronts registered in various polities. Manifests imply regular site resupply. Accounting suggests unusually high cost.

Procurement of two contractors, specialized services, referred to by codenames CRASIS, AUREOLIN for 10-cycle period. Two term extensions paid upfront.
texts.zh:

项目代号 IRKALLA，改造合同：保密协议、技术规格清单、非常规生命维持设备、重新入轨至 Duzahk 边缘跳跃点的 L4 点。

与 Neurozenith Cybernetic Solutions Group (NCSG) 签订长期项目合同，以匿名形式打包。另有若干合同，对方是注册在各政体下的编号空壳。货运清单显示该处有定期补给。账目也显示费用高得不寻常。

采购两名承包商提供专门服务，以代号 CRASIS、AUREOLIN 指称，合约十个星历年。两次续约费用已预先付清。

It opens.

One by one, the characters disappear. The note closes itself and disappears from your TriPad.

Nothing.

你深吸一口气，等着看接下来会发生什么。

Records of ongoing payment to mercenary captain Maues Moroz based out of Orthrus, in the Samarra System. Medical reports green. Creche reports exceptional.

Eventide section, private academy: flight training, navigation, tactics, mathematics. Subject expelled for altercation with heir of REDACTED, a leading family of Eventide. Combat sim records good-to-exceptional.

有舰队作战记录，在核心世界与近边缘地带接过雇佣任务。与一家法人实体有关联，其所有者【Moroz】租用着 Orthrus 上的几处仓库和两个私人船坞。

texts.en: "Me?" An eyeroll. "Don't be ridiculous."
texts.zh: "我？\"一个白眼。\"别逗了。"

texts.en:
"Anyway, this is a hot one! Spicy with rads, yum yum. Names, locations, records... Seven Andradas now? Well, eight. Well. Maybe six or so. Actually, you'll want to confirm that..."

Blocks of text appear as if in thin air. Images. Reports.
texts.zh:
"总之，这一份够劲！辐射味的辣，好吃好吃。名字、地点、记录... 现在有七位 Andrada 了？哦，八位。哦。大概六位上下。其实这个你得自己去核实..."

成块成块的文字凭空浮现。图像。报告。

options.en: Would you please transfer the decrypted files to me?
options.zh: 能不能把解好的文件传给我？

texts.zh: Gargoyle 耸耸肩。"我们话已经说完了。"

texts.en:
"Intel files," he repeats your words with more than a dash of skepticism.

"Whose?"
texts.zh:
"情报文件，"他把你的话重复了一遍，怀疑不止一点点。

"谁的？"

options.en: I think they belong to Dolos Macario. You've heard of him?
options.zh: 我想它们属于 Dolos Macario。你听说过他吗？

options.en: They concern the Sindrian Diktat. Philip Andrada, actually, in particular.
options.zh: 它们事关辛达强权。确切地说，尤其是 Philip Andrada。

options.en: It's probably best if I don't tell you.
options.zh: 这事我最好还是别告诉你。

texts.en: "Yes." He rubs his temples. "I've heard of him."
texts.zh: "是啊。\"他揉了揉太阳穴，\"我听说过他。"

texts.en: "You know what I'm going to say, right?"
texts.zh: "你知道我要说什么，对吧？"

options.en: 'No'?
'Talk to Gargoyle'.
'I'd love to help.'?
'I'm going to explain to you how we're going to short volatiles futures.'
options.zh: '我来给你讲讲，我们怎么去做空挥发物期货。'

texts.en:

Arroyo cuts the comms.

texts.en:
This catches him off-guard.

"Maybe you're not as hopeless as I thought," he says. "I still don't want to be involved. Take this to Gargoyle, it sounds like the sort of stupid scheme they'd love."

"Now get out of here," he turns away. "I need to comms my volatiles guy."

Arroyo cuts the feed.
texts.zh:
这话让他一时没接上。

"也许你没我想的那么没救，\"他说，\"但我还是不想掺和。拿去找 Gargoyle 吧，听起来正对他们那种爱干蠢事的胃口。"

"现在滚吧，\"他转过身去，\"我得联络一下我那个做挥发物的经纪人。"

Arroyo 切断了画面。

texts.en:
"Critical intel, you say? Hmm."

$PersonName closes $hisOrHer eyes, thinking for a moment.

"This sounds like something Fleet Intel should know about. I think I may know who will know what to do with this..."
texts.zh:
"关键情报，你是这么说的？嗯。"

$PersonName闭上$hisOrHer眼睛，沉吟片刻。

"这听起来像是舰队情报部该管的事。我想我知道该把它交给谁处置..."

texts.en:
Reynard considers your words as a felid might consider a shiproach. A smug grin appears.

"If this intel is encrypted how do you know it is as 'critical' as you so claim?"
texts.zh:
Reynard 掂量着你的话，像一只猫在掂量船上的蟑螂。随即浮起一丝得意的笑。

"这情报既然是加密的，你又怎么知道它真像你说的那么'关键'？"

texts.en:
"The Sindrian Diktat," Horus says, repeating your words. He thinks for a moment.

"The League has maintained a distasteful partnership with the Diktat against the Hegemony for many cycles. I do wonder, however..."
texts.zh:
"辛达强权，"Horus 重复着你的话，沉吟片刻。

"许多个周期以来，联盟一直与强权维持着一种令人不快的合作，共同对付霸主。不过我在想..."

texts.en:
"Decryption?" $HeOrShe smiles.

"That won't be a problem. No one beats Tri-Tachyon at data technology, and I'm sure we can come to a discreet arrangement... if you've got the credits."

$HeOrShe puts $hisOrHer hands together, eager to do business. "If you upload a sample of the files, I can give you a better idea of what level of... investment you're going to need.
texts.zh:
"解密？"$HeOrShe笑了。

"这不成问题。论数据技术，没人比得过速子科技，而且我相信我们能谈成一桩稳妥的安排...只要你的星币够。"

$HeOrShe把$hisOrHer双手一合，一副急于做生意的样子。"你先上传一份文件样本，我就能更准确地告诉你，这笔...投入大概要多大。"

texts.en:
For a moment, you see the eyes of the junior cadet glaze over, mask-like, setting shields against another lunatic who is convinced they have key intel that will 'help' the High Hegemon.

Then you see the question cross their face - you do, after all, hold a commission with the Hegemony. That must count for something.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. I am not authorized to receive, um, potentially confidential intelligence. May I forward your comms-link?"
texts.zh:
有那么一瞬，那名年轻学员的眼神就呆滞下去，像蒙上一层壳 —— 又在为一个坚信自己手里握着能'帮到'至高霸主的关键情报的疯子竖起屏障。

随即你看见那个疑问从对方脸上一掠而过 —— 毕竟你手里握着霸主的委任状。这总该算点什么。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。我无权接收，呃，可能属于机密的情报。可以让我把你的通讯链路转接上去吗？"

texts.en:

They don't quite sigh as they put on a resigned air - what they're doing will be technically correct even if a superior officer is sure to be annoyed. Duty is duty.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. I am not authorized to receive, um, potentially confidential intelligence. May I forward your comms-link?"

对方换上一副认命的神情，几乎要叹气 —— 他们要做的这件事在程序上无可挑剔，哪怕上级军官肯定会不高兴。职责就是职责。

texts.zh: "我——对。是的，\"$heOrShe说道，神色有些意外，\"看来你的人脉比我以为的广。"

texts.en: "Well, good luck. Hope your find turns out to be something useful."
texts.zh: "那就祝你好运。希望你找到的东西真有点用处。"

texts.en:
You explain the situation. Macario's bizarre requests, the sudden interruption and the recovery from the skull of a courier killed in space by a merc on the edge of Askonia.

Reynard pretends to stifle a yawn.

"Fine, fine, perhaps it is something," he says. "Take it to Fleet Intelligence. Special Agent Finlay Siyavong."

A tap at his TriPad and a comms ID appears in your interface. Reynard sets his face, not giving a look of approval - or, for once, condescension.

"Off you go. I'll receive a report if it's anything."
texts.zh:
你解释了来龙去脉：Macario 那些古怪的要求、通讯的骤然中断，以及从一名信使的颅骨里取出的东西 —— 那信使是在 Askonia 边缘被雇佣兵杀死在太空里的。

Reynard 装模作样地压下一个哈欠。

"行，行，也许真有点东西，\"他说，\"送去舰队情报部。找特工 Finlay Siyavong。"

他在 TriPad 上一点，一个通讯识别码出现在你的界面上。Reynard 板着脸，既没有赞许的神色 —— 这一次也没有居高临下。

"去吧。要真有价值，我会收到报告的。"

texts.en:
He looks back to the feed.

"If this is 'critical intel', as you say, I can only hope for an opportunity to shake up the status quo established by Reynard Hannan. Considering the character of the Sindrian Diktat, any presumed intelligence data should prove... troublesome. Therefore it is important that it be presented objectively, and to do so we need it to get into the professional bureaucracy before it becomes 'handled' by a major gens."

"That includes Gens Yaribay," he says with a self-effacing look. "Your trust is appreciated, as a matter of course."
texts.zh:
他重新看向通讯画面。

"如果这真如你所说，是'关键情报'，那我倒希望能借此撼动 Reynard Hannan 立下的那套现状。以辛达强权的行事作风，任何被认定的情报恐怕都会相当...麻烦。所以关键在于让它以客观的面目呈上去；要做到这一点，就得赶在某个大氏族把它'处理'掉之前，送进职业官僚体系里。"

"这其中也包括 Yaribay 氏族，\"他带着几分自嘲说道，\"当然，你的信任我很领情。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Take the files to Fleet Intelligence," he says, a tone of aristocratic command entering his voice. "Special Agent Finlay Siyavong."

He taps at a TriPad and a comms ID appears in your interface.

"Gens Yaribay shall be watching the situation, captain."

He allows the hint of a smile, though there's worry in his eyes.
texts.zh:
"把文件送到舰队情报部去，\"他说，语调里带上了贵族式的命令口吻，\"特工 Finlay Siyavong。"

他在 TriPad 上点了几下，一个通讯识别码出现在你的界面上。

"Yaribay 氏族会盯着这件事的，舰长。"

他容许自己露出一丝笑意，眼里却藏着忧虑。

texts.en:
You watch $personLastName's eyes as $heOrShe skims the file header.

"This won't be cheap," $heOrShe says. "If this is what it looks like."

你看着$personLastName的眼睛 —— $heOrShe正扫过文件的头部信息。

"这可不便宜，\"$heOrShe说道，\"如果它真是看上去的那样。"

options.en: What would you say this looks like?
Let's discuss credits.

texts.en: "It might be sensitive information of interest to... a commercial partner of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation," $heOrShe says with a slightly more strained smile.
texts.zh: "它可能是些敏感信息，或许会让...速子科技的一家商业伙伴感兴趣，"$heOrShe说道，笑容略微发僵。

options.en: The Sindrian Diktat is a partner of Tri-Tachyon?
options.zh: 辛达强权是速子科技的伙伴？

options.en: Then we'll be careful. Let's discuss credits.
options.zh: 那我们就谨慎些。谈谈星币吧。

texts.en:
"Ah," $heOrShe spreads his hands, thinks better of it, and puts $hisOrHer hands together again. "Every major faction in the Persean Sector is a commercial partner of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation! Even the Luddic Church. Isn't that something?"

"It is true that there are occasional conflicts - 'kinetic negotiations', if you will - which put profitable ventures on hold. But in the end everyone recognizes that the market is the ultimate driver of prosperity, whatever political rhetoric they claim to embrace."

"After the dust settles, Tri-Tachyon is always open for business." $HeOrShe produces a business-friendly smile.
texts.zh:
"啊，\"$heOrShe摊开双手，又觉得不妥，重新把$hisOrHer双手合拢，\"英仙座星域的每一个主要势力，都是速子科技的商业伙伴！连银河救赎教会也不例外。有意思吧？"

"偶尔确实会有冲突 —— 不妨称之为'动能谈判' —— 让赚钱的生意暂时搁置。但说到底，人人都明白市场才是繁荣的根本动力，无论他们嘴上信奉的是什么政治辞令。"

"尘埃落定之后，速子科技永远乐意做生意。"$HeOrShe露出一个对生意人最友善的笑容。

options.en: How inspiring. Let's discuss credits.
options.zh: 真叫人振奋。我们来谈谈星币吧。

texts.en: "As we discussed, for a 20,000 credit finders-fee I can forward you to someone who will take care of everything."
texts.zh: "如我们所谈，20,000 星币的介绍费，我就把你转荐给一位能打理一切的人。"

texts.en: "As we discussed," $heOrShe sighs, "I'll accept a 16,000 credit finders-fee then forward you to someone who will take care of everything."

options.en: 20,000 credits. I accept.
16,000 credits. I accept.
12,000 credits. I accept.

options.en: I could probably just sell these files to another faction and make quite a profit.
options.zh: 我大概也能把这些文件卖给别的势力，赚上一笔。

"Thank me after you see some profits from this venture of yours," $heOrShe says.

"Now I ought to open a comms to my investment agent to talk about volatiles futures..."

"现在我得联络我的投资代理人，谈谈挥发物期货..."

texts.en:
"I'd call it a successful consultation to enhance efficiency in underutilized partner connections."

This line is delivered in complete earnestness.

"Thank me after you see some profits from this venture of yours," $heOrShe says with a wink. "Now I've got some volatiles futures to look into..."

"我会称之为一次成功的咨询，提升了利用不足的伙伴关系的效率。"

这句话说得一本正经。

"等你在这桩买卖里见到收益，再来谢我，\"$heOrShe眨了眨眼，\"现在我得去看看几笔挥发物期货了..."

texts.en: "16,000 credits," $heOrShe shoots back.
texts.zh: "16,000 星币，"$heOrShe回敬道。

$HeOrShe licks $hisOrHer lips, consternated.

"16,000 credits," $heOrShe says.

$HeOrShe舔了舔$hisOrHer嘴唇，一脸为难。

"16,000 星币，"$heOrShe说道。

$HeOrShe licks $hisOrHer lips, consternated.

"12,000 credits," $heOrShe says. "Take it or leave it."

$HeOrShe舔了舔$hisOrHer嘴唇，一脸为难。

"12,000 星币，\"$heOrShe说道，\"要就要，不要拉倒。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe licks $hisOrHer lips, consternated.

"Then see what you can get out of that anarchist," $heOrShe says. "You'll probably end up with a virus in your flagship for the trouble."

$HeOrShe舔了舔$hisOrHer嘴唇，一脸为难。

"那就去看看能从那个无政府主义者身上榨出什么，\"$heOrShe说道，\"到头来你的旗舰多半会中个病毒，算是这趟的报酬。"

texts.en: "You think you're the first spacer," $heOrShe says, "with a datacore full of noise claiming to have essential intel for sale?"
texts.zh: "你以为你是头一个，\"$heOrShe说道，\"抱着个塞满杂音的数据核心，声称手里有关键情报待售的太空人？"

texts.en: "But because I admire your spirit, I'll do 16,000 credits," $heOrShe says.
texts.zh: "不过看在你这份胆气的份上，16,000 星币，"$heOrShe说道。

texts.en: "Only because I admire your assertive negotiation, I'll do it for 12,000 credits," $heOrShe says. "Are you in or out?"
texts.zh: "纯粹是欣赏你这股强硬的谈法，12,000 星币，\"$heOrShe说道，\"做还是不做？"

texts.en: $HeOrShe crosses $hisOrHer arms. "Go on, try it. It'll be a waste of time, and time is credits."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe抱起$hisOrHer双臂。"去啊，试试看。白费时间，而时间就是星币。"

texts.en: "You'll be back," $heOrShe says, projecting confidence.
texts.zh: "你会回来的，"$heOrShe说道，刻意显出十足的信心。

"Affirmative, $playerSirOrMadam. One moment."

The comms-link image twitches into the crest of the Hegemony.
texts.zh:
"遵命，$playerSirOrMadam。请稍候。"

通讯画面一阵抖动，换成了霸主的徽记。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: After a few minutes, the comms flutter and stabilize.
texts.zh: 几分钟后，通讯闪了几下，稳定下来。

texts.en:
"Captain $playerLastName," $Rank $personLastName begins, with more than a touch of impatience.

"I'm told you have an important intelligence report to pass up the chain of command."
texts.zh:
"舰长 $playerLastName，"$Rank $personLastName开口道，语气里带着远不止一丝的不耐。

"我听说你有一份重要情报，要沿指挥链上报。"

options.en: Yes. I have unique intel concerning the Sindrian Mutiny. (send files)
options.zh: 是的。我有一份关于辛达叛乱的独家情报。 (发送文件)

texts.en: "I'm sorry, but the High Hegemon is unavailable." The cadet smiles blandly.
texts.zh: "不好意思，至高霸主事务繁忙。" 接待你的那名学员温和地微笑着。

texts.en:
This earns you an unusual expression - for a senior Hegemony officer, at least.

"I'm not sure I want to know how you got it." $HeOrShe holds up a finger, a warning. "And perhaps best if you didn't. There's a standing order which I believe applies to this case."
texts.zh:
这让你看到了一种少见的表情——至少，在一名霸主高级军官脸上是少见的。

"我倒不确定自己想知道你是怎么弄到的。\"$HeOrShe 竖起一根手指，是警告。\"而且你最好也别告诉我。有一道长期有效的命令，我想正适用于此案。"

texts.en: "Take this directly to Admiral Orcus Rao. His command is the Ragnar Complex, orbiting Ragnar in the Valhalla System."
texts.zh: "把这个直接送到 Orcus Rao 上将手上。他的辖区是 Ragnar 综合设施，环绕 Valhalla 星系的 Ragnar 运行。"

options.en: Orcus Rao. Got it.

texts.en:
"Item two, per that order," $heOrShe taps at an interface, and a view of $hisOrHer comms interface appears in the comms.

"I ask you to witness. I shall now delete the files I received from you."

$PersonLastName appears to delete the files, then runs a scrub of $hisOrHer comm system's temporary memory buffer.

With this done, $heOrShe nods to you. "Captain."
texts.zh:
"第二项，按那道命令的要求，"$heOrShe 在界面上点了几下，$hisOrHer 通讯界面的影像便嵌进了通讯链路里。

"我请你做个见证。现在，我将删除从你那里收到的文件。"

$PersonLastName 似乎删掉了那些文件，随后对 $hisOrHer 的通讯系统临时内存缓冲区做了一次擦除。

做完这些，$heOrShe 朝你点了点头。"舰长。"

options.en: Deletion witnessed.

texts.en: "Thank you," $heOrShe says. "We shall speak no more of this. Go to Rao."
texts.zh: "谢谢你，\"$heOrShe 说道。\"此事不必再提。去见 Rao 吧。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe raises an eyebrow.

"I see. There's a standing order which I believe applies to this situation."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 挑起一边眉毛。

"我明白了。有一道长期有效的命令，我想正适用于眼下的情况。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe raises an eyebrow.

"I see. Well, there's a standing order which I believe applies to this case... if this is what it appears to be."

Another skeptical look. "Could be another fake from the Spider. Well, this can be the old renegade's problem."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 挑起一边眉毛。

"我明白了。那么，有一道长期有效的命令，我想正适用于此案...如果这真是它看上去那样的话。"

又是一道怀疑的目光。"也可能是蜘蛛弄出来的又一份假货。行吧，那就让那位老叛逆去伤脑筋。"

options.en: Will you use AI cores to decrypt the files?
options.zh: 你会用 AI 核心来解密这些文件？

options.en: Upload the ANDRADA files
The merc you sent to intercept Macario's courier? That courier.
options.zh: 你派去拦截 Macario 信使的那个佣兵？就是那个信使。

options.en: They were intended for Dolos Macario.
options.zh: 这些文件本来是给 Dolos Macario 的。

options.en: I recovered them from a debris field in Askonia.
options.zh: 我从 Askonia 的一处残骸区里捞回来的。

options.en: I prefer not to reveal that information at this time.
options.zh: 这个来源，我暂时不想透露。

options.en: You hired the merc that made that debris field.
options.zh: 那片残骸区，就是你雇的佣兵做出来的。

options.en: So can you decrypt the files?
options.zh: 那么，这些文件你能解开吗？

texts.en: "You know better than to ask a question like that, $titleHeg."
texts.zh: "问这种问题，你不该不懂规矩，$titleHeg。"

texts.en:
You watch as Rao takes in the file headers.

"All or nothing, huh," he mutters. Then looks back up at you. "Where'd you get these?"
texts.zh:
你看着 Rao 一条条扫过那些文件抬头。

"要么全押，要么全无，是吧。\"他低声嘟囔，然后抬眼看向你。\"这些你是从哪儿弄来的？"

texts.en:
"Huh," he says, then stares off for a moment, thinking.

"Huh." He looks back at you. "Nice work."
texts.zh:
"嗯。"他应了一声，随即望向别处，思索片刻。

"嗯。\"他重新看向你。\"干得不错。"

texts.en: "Huh," he says, then stares off for a moment, thinking.
texts.zh: "嗯。"他应了一声，随即望向别处，思索片刻。

texts.en:
"Huh," he says, then stares off for a moment, thinking.

"Huh." He looks back at you. "Of course. I see. Nice work."
texts.zh:
"嗯。"他应了一声，随即望向别处，思索片刻。

"嗯。\"他重新看向你。\"当然。我明白了。干得不错。"

texts.en:
"$TitleHeg." He sounds disappointed.

"Let me be solid with you for just a moment - I'm not asking the question because I don't know the answer, or have a pretty good idea what it is, anyway. I'm asking as an exercise in trust."

"If you want to do this," he waves his hand, taking in the Hegemony itself, perhaps. Or at least this particular scheme involving his work against the Sindrian Diktat. "If you want to do this, you're going to have to be solid with me."
texts.zh:
"$TitleHeg。"他的声音里透着失望。

"我就跟你交个底吧——我问这个问题，不是因为我不知道答案，或者说，我心里其实已经有相当靠谱的猜测。我问，是为了看看能不能信得过你。"

"如果你想做成这件事，\"他挥了挥手，也许把整个霸主都划了进去，至少也划进了他针对辛达强权的这桩谋划。\"如果你想做成这件事，就得对我交底。"

texts.en: "Allegedly," he says.
texts.zh: "据说是这样。"他说。

options.en: So you knew a courier was transporting the files. Allegedly.
options.zh: 也就是说，你早就知道有一名信使在运这些文件。据说是。

texts.en:
He says nothing.

After a moment, he speaks. "Possibly transporting something unusual and important to Macario, anyway. Good thing he told you what to look for, isn't it."
texts.zh:
他一言不发。

片刻之后，他开口了。"至少，是在把某种不寻常、而且对 Macario 很重要的东西运过去。好在他告诉了你该找什么，不是吗。"

options.en: Where did this courier come from?

texts.en:
He looks at you, judging for a few seconds.

"Tri-Tachyon. An element within Tri-Tachyon, anyway. Usually it's technology and expert technicians. This one looked different."

He puts his hands together, a show of patience to hide anything but.
texts.zh:
他打量着你，像是在掂量什么，持续了几秒。

"速子科技。至少，是速子科技内部的某一股势力。通常他们运的是技术和资深技师。这一趟看着不一样。"

他双手交叠，摆出一副有耐心的样子，好把别的什么藏起来。

texts.en:
"We should have results within ten shifts or so," he says, then looks up. "Three days."

"Return to me soon. If these are what I think they are, Askonia is going to get interesting."
texts.zh:
"十轮班左右就该有结果了，\"他说着抬起头。\"也就是三天。"

"早点回来找我。如果这些真是我以为的东西，Askonia 就要热闹起来了。"

texts.en:
"Critical intel, you say? Hmm."

$PersonName closes $hisOrHer eyes, thinking for a moment.

"This sounds like something Fleet Intel should know about. I think I may know who will know what to do with this..."
texts.zh:
"关键情报，你是这么说的？嗯。"

$PersonName闭上$hisOrHer眼睛，沉吟片刻。

"这听起来像是舰队情报部该管的事。我想我知道该把它交给谁处置..."

texts.en:
Reynard considers your words as a felid might consider a shiproach. A smug grin appears.

"If this intel is encrypted how do you know it is as 'critical' as you so claim?"
texts.zh:
Reynard 掂量着你的话，像一只猫在掂量船上的蟑螂。随即浮起一丝得意的笑。

"这情报既然是加密的，你又怎么知道它真像你说的那么'关键'？"

texts.en:
"The Sindrian Diktat," Horus says, repeating your words. He thinks for a moment.

"The League has maintained a distasteful partnership with the Diktat against the Hegemony for many cycles. I do wonder, however..."
texts.zh:
"辛达强权，"Horus 重复着你的话，沉吟片刻。

"许多个周期以来，联盟一直与强权维持着一种令人不快的合作，共同对付霸主。不过我在想..."

texts.en:
"Decryption?" $HeOrShe smiles.

"That won't be a problem. No one beats Tri-Tachyon at data technology, and I'm sure we can come to a discreet arrangement... if you've got the credits."

$HeOrShe puts $hisOrHer hands together, eager to do business. "If you upload a sample of the files, I can give you a better idea of what level of... investment you're going to need.
texts.zh:
"解密？"$HeOrShe笑了。

"这不成问题。论数据技术，没人比得过速子科技，而且我相信我们能谈成一桩稳妥的安排...只要你的星币够。"

$HeOrShe把$hisOrHer双手一合，一副急于做生意的样子。"你先上传一份文件样本，我就能更准确地告诉你，这笔...投入大概要多大。"

texts.en:
For a moment, you see the eyes of the junior cadet glaze over, mask-like, setting shields against another lunatic who is convinced they have key intel that will 'help' the High Hegemon.

Then you see the question cross their face - you do, after all, hold a commission with the Hegemony. That must count for something.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. I am not authorized to receive, um, potentially confidential intelligence. May I forward your comms-link?"
texts.zh:
有那么一瞬，那名年轻学员的眼神就呆滞下去，像蒙上一层壳 —— 又在为一个坚信自己手里握着能'帮到'至高霸主的关键情报的疯子竖起屏障。

随即你看见那个疑问从对方脸上一掠而过 —— 毕竟你手里握着霸主的委任状。这总该算点什么。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。我无权接收，呃，可能属于机密的情报。可以让我把你的通讯链路转接上去吗？"

texts.en:
You explain the situation. Macario's bizarre requests, the sudden interruption and the recovery from the skull of a courier killed in space by a merc on the edge of Askonia.

Reynard pretends to stifle a yawn.

"Fine, fine, perhaps it is something," he says. "Take it to Fleet Intelligence. Special Agent Finlay Siyavong."

A tap at his TriPad and a comms ID appears in your interface. Reynard sets his face, not giving a look of approval - or, for once, condescension.

"Off you go. I'll receive a report if it's anything."
texts.zh:
你解释了来龙去脉：Macario 那些古怪的要求、通讯的骤然中断，以及从一名信使的颅骨里取出的东西 —— 那信使是在 Askonia 边缘被雇佣兵杀死在太空里的。

Reynard 装模作样地压下一个哈欠。

"行，行，也许真有点东西，\"他说，\"送去舰队情报部。找特工 Finlay Siyavong。"

他在 TriPad 上一点，一个通讯识别码出现在你的界面上。Reynard 板着脸，既没有赞许的神色 —— 这一次也没有居高临下。

"去吧。要真有价值，我会收到报告的。"

texts.en:
He looks back to the feed.

"If this is 'critical intel', as you say, I can only hope for an opportunity to shake up the status quo established by Reynard Hannan. Considering the character of the Sindrian Diktat, any presumed intelligence data should prove... troublesome. Therefore it is important that it be presented objectively, and to do so we need it to get into the professional bureaucracy before it becomes 'handled' by a major gens."

"That includes Gens Yaribay," he says with a self-effacing look. "Your trust is appreciated, as a matter of course."
texts.zh:
他重新看向通讯画面。

"如果这真如你所说，是'关键情报'，那我倒希望能借此撼动 Reynard Hannan 立下的那套现状。以辛达强权的行事作风，任何被认定的情报恐怕都会相当...麻烦。所以关键在于让它以客观的面目呈上去；要做到这一点，就得赶在某个大氏族把它'处理'掉之前，送进职业官僚体系里。"

"这其中也包括 Yaribay 氏族，\"他带着几分自嘲说道，\"当然，你的信任我很领情。"

"Gens Yaribay shall be watching the situation, captain."

He allows the hint of a smile, though there's worry in his eyes.

texts.en:
"Ah," $heOrShe spreads his hands, thinks better of it, and puts $hisOrHer hands together again. "Every major faction in the Persean Sector is a commercial partner of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation! Even the Luddic Church. Isn't that something?"

"It is true that there are occasional conflicts - 'kinetic negotiations', if you will - which put profitable ventures on hold. But in the end everyone recognizes that the market is the ultimate driver of prosperity, whatever political rhetoric they claim to embrace."

"After the dust settles, Tri-Tachyon is always open for business." $HeOrShe produces a business-friendly smile.
texts.zh:
"啊，\"$heOrShe摊开双手，又觉得不妥，重新把$hisOrHer双手合拢，\"英仙座星域的每一个主要势力，都是速子科技的商业伙伴！连银河救赎教会也不例外。有意思吧？"

"偶尔确实会有冲突 —— 不妨称之为'动能谈判' —— 让赚钱的生意暂时搁置。但说到底，人人都明白市场才是繁荣的根本动力，无论他们嘴上信奉的是什么政治辞令。"

"尘埃落定之后，速子科技永远乐意做生意。"$HeOrShe露出一个对生意人最友善的笑容。

"Affirmative, $playerSirOrMadam. One moment."

The comms-link image twitches into the crest of the Hegemony.

通讯画面一阵抖动，换成了霸主的徽记。

texts.en: After a few minutes, the comms flutter and stabilize.
texts.zh: 几分钟后，通讯闪了几下，稳定下来。

texts.en:
"Captain $playerLastName," $Rank $personLastName begins, with more than a touch of impatience.

"I'm told you have an important intelligence report to pass up the chain of command."
texts.zh:
"舰长 $playerLastName，"$Rank $personLastName开口道，语气里带着远不止一丝的不耐。

"我听说你有一份重要情报，要沿指挥链上报。"

options.en: Yes. I have unique intel concerning the Sindrian Mutiny. (send files)
options.zh: 是的。我有一份关于辛达叛乱的独家情报。 (发送文件)

texts.en: "I'm sorry, but the High Hegemon is unavailable." The cadet smiles blandly.
texts.zh: "不好意思，至高霸主事务繁忙。" 接待你的那名学员温和地微笑着。

texts.en:
This earns you an unusual expression - for a senior Hegemony officer, at least.

"I'm not sure I want to know how you got it." $HeOrShe holds up a finger, a warning. "And perhaps best if you didn't. There's a standing order which I believe applies to this case."
texts.zh:
这让你看到了一种少见的表情——至少，在一名霸主高级军官脸上是少见的。

"我倒不确定自己想知道你是怎么弄到的。\"$HeOrShe 竖起一根手指，是警告。\"而且你最好也别告诉我。有一道长期有效的命令，我想正适用于此案。"

texts.en: "Take this directly to Admiral Orcus Rao. His command is the Ragnar Complex, orbiting Ragnar in the Valhalla System."
texts.zh: "把这个直接送到 Orcus Rao 上将手上。他的辖区是 Ragnar 综合设施，环绕 Valhalla 星系的 Ragnar 运行。"

options.en: Orcus Rao. Got it.

texts.en:
"Item two, per that order," $heOrShe taps at an interface, and a view of $hisOrHer comms interface appears in the comms.

"I ask you to witness. I shall now delete the files I received from you."

$PersonLastName appears to delete the files, then runs a scrub of $hisOrHer comm system's temporary memory buffer.

With this done, $heOrShe nods to you. "Captain."
texts.zh:
"第二项，按那道命令的要求，"$heOrShe 在界面上点了几下，$hisOrHer 通讯界面的影像便嵌进了通讯链路里。

"我请你做个见证。现在，我将删除从你那里收到的文件。"

$PersonLastName 似乎删掉了那些文件，随后对 $hisOrHer 的通讯系统临时内存缓冲区做了一次擦除。

做完这些，$heOrShe 朝你点了点头。"舰长。"

options.en: Deletion witnessed.

texts.en: "Thank you," $heOrShe says. "We shall speak no more of this. Go to Rao."
texts.zh: "谢谢你，\"$heOrShe 说道。\"此事不必再提。去见 Rao 吧。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe raises an eyebrow.

"I see. There's a standing order which I believe applies to this situation."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 挑起一边眉毛。

"我明白了。有一道长期有效的命令，我想正适用于眼下的情况。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe raises an eyebrow.

"I see. Well, there's a standing order which I believe applies to this case... if this is what it appears to be."

Another skeptical look. "Could be another fake from the Spider. Well, this can be the old renegade's problem."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 挑起一边眉毛。

"我明白了。那么，有一道长期有效的命令，我想正适用于此案...如果这真是它看上去那样的话。"

又是一道怀疑的目光。"也可能是蜘蛛弄出来的又一份假货。行吧，那就让那位老叛逆去伤脑筋。"

options.en: Will you use AI cores to decrypt the files?
options.zh: 你会用 AI 核心来解密这些文件？

options.en: Upload the ANDRADA files
The merc you sent to intercept Macario's courier? That courier.
options.zh: 你派去拦截 Macario 信使的那个佣兵？就是那个信使。

options.en: They were intended for Dolos Macario.
options.zh: 这些文件本来是给 Dolos Macario 的。

options.en: I recovered them from a debris field in Askonia.
options.zh: 我从 Askonia 的一处残骸区里捞回来的。

options.en: I prefer not to reveal that information at this time.
options.zh: 这个来源，我暂时不想透露。

options.en: So can you decrypt the files?
options.zh: 那么，这些文件你能解开吗？

texts.en: "You know better than to ask a question like that, $titleHeg."
texts.zh: "问这种问题，你不该不懂规矩，$titleHeg。"

texts.en:
You watch as Rao takes in the file headers.

"All or nothing, huh," he mutters. Then looks back up at you. "Where'd you get these?"
texts.zh:
你看着 Rao 一条条扫过那些文件抬头。

"要么全押，要么全无，是吧。\"他低声嘟囔，然后抬眼看向你。\"这些你是从哪儿弄来的？"

texts.en:
"Huh," he says, then stares off for a moment, thinking.

"Huh." He looks back at you. "Nice work."
texts.zh:
"嗯。"他应了一声，随即望向别处，思索片刻。

"嗯。\"他重新看向你。\"干得不错。"

texts.en: "Huh," he says, then stares off for a moment, thinking.
texts.zh: "嗯。"他应了一声，随即望向别处，思索片刻。

texts.en:
"Huh," he says, then stares off for a moment, thinking.

"Huh." He looks back at you. "Of course. I see. Nice work."
texts.zh:
"嗯。"他应了一声，随即望向别处，思索片刻。

"嗯。\"他重新看向你。\"当然。我明白了。干得不错。"

texts.en:
"$TitleHeg." He sounds disappointed.

"Let me be solid with you for just a moment - I'm not asking the question because I don't know the answer, or have a pretty good idea what it is, anyway. I'm asking as an exercise in trust."

"If you want to do this," he waves his hand, taking in the Hegemony itself, perhaps. Or at least this particular scheme involving his work against the Sindrian Diktat. "If you want to do this, you're going to have to be solid with me."
texts.zh:
"$TitleHeg。"他的声音里透着失望。

"我就跟你交个底吧——我问这个问题，不是因为我不知道答案，或者说，我心里其实已经有相当靠谱的猜测。我问，是为了看看能不能信得过你。"

"如果你想做成这件事，\"他挥了挥手，也许把整个霸主都划了进去，至少也划进了他针对辛达强权的这桩谋划。\"如果你想做成这件事，就得对我交底。"

texts.en: "Allegedly," he says.
texts.zh: "据说是这样。"他说。

options.en: So you knew a courier was transporting the files. Allegedly.
options.zh: 也就是说，你早就知道有一名信使在运这些文件。据说是。

texts.en:
He says nothing.

After a moment, he speaks. "Possibly transporting something unusual and important to Macario, anyway. Good thing he told you what to look for, isn't it."
texts.zh:
他一言不发。

片刻之后，他开口了。"至少，是在把某种不寻常、而且对 Macario 很重要的东西运过去。好在他告诉了你该找什么，不是吗。"

options.en: Where did this courier come from?

texts.en:
He looks at you, judging for a few seconds.

"Tri-Tachyon. An element within Tri-Tachyon, anyway. Usually it's technology and expert technicians. This one looked different."

He puts his hands together, a show of patience to hide anything but.
texts.zh:
他打量着你，像是在掂量什么，持续了几秒。

"速子科技。至少，是速子科技内部的某一股势力。通常他们运的是技术和资深技师。这一趟看着不一样。"

他双手交叠，摆出一副有耐心的样子，好把别的什么藏起来。

texts.en:
"We should have results within ten shifts or so," he says, then looks up. "Three days."

"Return to me soon. If these are what I think they are, Askonia is going to get interesting."
texts.zh:
"十轮班左右就该有结果了，\"他说着抬起头。\"也就是三天。"

"早点回来找我。如果这些真是我以为的东西，Askonia 就要热闹起来了。"

options.en: I have critical intel about the Sindrian Diktat. It is encrypted, however.
options.zh: 我手上有关于辛达强权的关键情报。不过它是加密的。

texts.en:
"Take it to Faro Inesis. Achaman. Magec system."

She doesn't bother to infuse her voice with even a pretense of interest.

"Next item."
texts.zh:
"把它交给 Faro Inesis。Achaman，Magec 星系。"

她连装都懒得装出一点兴趣。

"下一项。"

texts.en:
"Take it to my strategic analyst, name is Faro Inesis. Achaman Franchise Station, Magec system."

She doesn't bother to infuse her voice with even a pretense of interest.

"Next item."
texts.zh:
"交给我的战略分析师，叫 Faro Inesis。Achaman Franchise Station，Magec 星系。"

她连装都懒得装出一点兴趣。

"下一项。"

texts.en:
"Critical intel, you say? Hmm."

$PersonName closes $hisOrHer eyes, thinking for a moment.

"This sounds like something Fleet Intel should know about. I think I may know who will know what to do with this..."
texts.zh:
"关键情报，你是这么说的？嗯。"

$PersonName闭上$hisOrHer眼睛，沉吟片刻。

"这听起来像是舰队情报部该管的事。我想我知道该把它交给谁处置..."

texts.en:
Reynard considers your words as a felid might consider a shiproach. A smug grin appears.

"If this intel is encrypted how do you know it is as 'critical' as you so claim?"
texts.zh:
Reynard 掂量着你的话，像一只猫在掂量船上的蟑螂。随即浮起一丝得意的笑。

"这情报既然是加密的，你又怎么知道它真像你说的那么'关键'？"

texts.en:
"The Sindrian Diktat," Horus says, repeating your words. He thinks for a moment.

"The League has maintained a distasteful partnership with the Diktat against the Hegemony for many cycles. I do wonder, however..."
texts.zh:
"辛达强权，"Horus 重复着你的话，沉吟片刻。

"许多个周期以来，联盟一直与强权维持着一种令人不快的合作，共同对付霸主。不过我在想..."

texts.en:
"Decryption?" $HeOrShe smiles.

"That won't be a problem. No one beats Tri-Tachyon at data technology, and I'm sure we can come to a discreet arrangement... if you've got the credits."

$HeOrShe puts $hisOrHer hands together, eager to do business. "If you upload a sample of the files, I can give you a better idea of what level of... investment you're going to need.
texts.zh:
"解密？"$HeOrShe笑了。

"这不成问题。论数据技术，没人比得过速子科技，而且我相信我们能谈成一桩稳妥的安排...只要你的星币够。"

$HeOrShe把$hisOrHer双手一合，一副急于做生意的样子。"你先上传一份文件样本，我就能更准确地告诉你，这笔...投入大概要多大。"

texts.en:
For a moment, you see the eyes of the junior cadet glaze over, mask-like, setting shields against another lunatic who is convinced they have key intel that will 'help' the High Hegemon.

Then you see the question cross their face - you do, after all, hold a commission with the Hegemony. That must count for something.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. I am not authorized to receive, um, potentially confidential intelligence. May I forward your comms-link?"
texts.zh:
有那么一瞬，那名年轻学员的眼神就呆滞下去，像蒙上一层壳 —— 又在为一个坚信自己手里握着能'帮到'至高霸主的关键情报的疯子竖起屏障。

随即你看见那个疑问从对方脸上一掠而过 —— 毕竟你手里握着霸主的委任状。这总该算点什么。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。我无权接收，呃，可能属于机密的情报。可以让我把你的通讯链路转接上去吗？"

texts.en:
For a moment, you see the eyes of the junior cadet glaze over, mask-like, setting shields against another lunatic who is convinced they have key intel that will 'help' the High Hegemon.

They don't quite sigh as they put on a resigned air - what they're doing will be technically correct even if a superior officer is sure to be annoyed. Duty is duty.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. I am not authorized to receive, um, potentially confidential intelligence. May I forward your comms-link?"
texts.zh:
有那么一瞬，那名年轻学员的眼神就呆滞下去，像蒙上一层壳 —— 又在为一个坚信自己手里握着能'帮到'至高霸主的关键情报的疯子竖起屏障。

对方换上一副认命的神情，几乎要叹气 —— 他们要做的这件事在程序上无可挑剔，哪怕上级军官肯定会不高兴。职责就是职责。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。我无权接收，呃，可能属于机密的情报。可以让我把你的通讯链路转接上去吗？"

You watch $PersonRank $personLastName's face as $heOrShe skims the file headers of the report.

Seven names, seven Andradas. Seven blocks of heavily encrypted data. Skepticism is followed by concern.

$HeOrShe looks at you gravely. "Where did you get this?"

你注视着 $PersonRank $personLastName 的脸，$heOrShe 正一条条扫过报告的卷首信息。

$HeOrShe 神情凝重地看着你。"这东西你是从哪儿弄来的？"

"Interesting. Perhaps even useful," he says, "unless Dolos was just getting bored and wants to stir up trouble."

He taps at his comms interface and a transfer link appears.

"$TitleHeg," he prompts.
texts.zh:
"有意思。也许还用得上，\"他说，\"除非这只是 Dolos 闲得发慌，想搅点乱子。"

他在通讯界面上点了几下，一条传输链接弹了出来。

"$TitleHeg。"他提示道。

options.en: Is it for Special Agent Finlay Siyavong?

texts.en: "I- yes. Yes it is," $heOrShe says, looking surprised. "I guess you're better connected than I thought."
texts.zh: "我——对。是的，\"$heOrShe说道，神色有些意外，\"看来你的人脉比我以为的广。"

texts.en: "Well, good luck. Hope your find turns out to be something useful."
texts.zh: "那就祝你好运。希望你找到的东西真有点用处。"

texts.en:
You explain the situation. Macario's bizarre requests, the sudden interruption and the recovery from the skull of a courier killed in space by a merc on the edge of Askonia.

Reynard pretends to stifle a yawn.

"Fine, fine, perhaps it is something," he says. "Take it to Fleet Intelligence. Special Agent Finlay Siyavong."

A tap at his TriPad and a comms ID appears in your interface. Reynard sets his face, not giving a look of approval - or, for once, condescension.

"Off you go. I'll receive a report if it's anything."
texts.zh:
你解释了来龙去脉：Macario 那些古怪的要求、通讯的骤然中断，以及从一名信使的颅骨里取出的东西 —— 那信使是在 Askonia 边缘被雇佣兵杀死在太空里的。

Reynard 装模作样地压下一个哈欠。

"行，行，也许真有点东西，\"他说，\"送去舰队情报部。找特工 Finlay Siyavong。"

他在 TriPad 上一点，一个通讯识别码出现在你的界面上。Reynard 板着脸，既没有赞许的神色 —— 这一次也没有居高临下。

"去吧。要真有价值，我会收到报告的。"

texts.en:
He looks back to the feed.

"If this is 'critical intel', as you say, I can only hope for an opportunity to shake up the status quo established by Reynard Hannan. Considering the character of the Sindrian Diktat, any presumed intelligence data should prove... troublesome. Therefore it is important that it be presented objectively, and to do so we need it to get into the professional bureaucracy before it becomes 'handled' by a major gens."

"That includes Gens Yaribay," he says with a self-effacing look. "Your trust is appreciated, as a matter of course."
texts.zh:
他重新看向通讯画面。

"如果这真如你所说，是'关键情报'，那我倒希望能借此撼动 Reynard Hannan 立下的那套现状。以辛达强权的行事作风，任何被认定的情报恐怕都会相当...麻烦。所以关键在于让它以客观的面目呈上去；要做到这一点，就得赶在某个大氏族把它'处理'掉之前，送进职业官僚体系里。"

"这其中也包括 Yaribay 氏族，\"他带着几分自嘲说道，\"当然，你的信任我很领情。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Take the files to Fleet Intelligence," he says, a tone of aristocratic command entering his voice. "Special Agent Finlay Siyavong."

He taps at a TriPad and a comms ID appears in your interface.

"Gens Yaribay shall be watching the situation, captain."

He allows the hint of a smile, though there's worry in his eyes.
texts.zh:
"把文件送到舰队情报部去，\"他说，语调里带上了贵族式的命令口吻，\"特工 Finlay Siyavong。"

他在 TriPad 上点了几下，一个通讯识别码出现在你的界面上。

"Yaribay 氏族会盯着这件事的，舰长。"

他容许自己露出一丝笑意，眼里却藏着忧虑。

texts.en:
You watch $personLastName's eyes as $heOrShe skims the file header.

"This won't be cheap," $heOrShe says. "If this is what it looks like."
texts.zh:
你看着$personLastName的眼睛 —— $heOrShe正扫过文件的头部信息。

"这可不便宜，\"$heOrShe说道，\"如果它真是看上去的那样。"

options.en: What would you say this looks like?
Let's discuss credits.

texts.en: "It might be sensitive information of interest to... a commercial partner of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation," $heOrShe says with a slightly more strained smile.
texts.zh: "它可能是些敏感信息，或许会让...速子科技的一家商业伙伴感兴趣，"$heOrShe说道，笑容略微发僵。

options.en: The Sindrian Diktat is a partner of Tri-Tachyon?
options.zh: 辛达强权是速子科技的伙伴？

options.en: Then we'll be careful. Let's discuss credits.
options.zh: 那我们就谨慎些。谈谈星币吧。

texts.en:
"Ah," $heOrShe spreads his hands, thinks better of it, and puts $hisOrHer hands together again. "Every major faction in the Persean Sector is a commercial partner of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation! Even the Luddic Church. Isn't that something?"

"It is true that there are occasional conflicts - 'kinetic negotiations', if you will - which put profitable ventures on hold. But in the end everyone recognizes that the market is the ultimate driver of prosperity, whatever political rhetoric they claim to embrace."

"After the dust settles, Tri-Tachyon is always open for business." $HeOrShe produces a business-friendly smile.
texts.zh:
"啊，\"$heOrShe摊开双手，又觉得不妥，重新把$hisOrHer双手合拢，\"英仙座星域的每一个主要势力，都是速子科技的商业伙伴！连银河救赎教会也不例外。有意思吧？"

"偶尔确实会有冲突 —— 不妨称之为'动能谈判' —— 让赚钱的生意暂时搁置。但说到底，人人都明白市场才是繁荣的根本动力，无论他们嘴上信奉的是什么政治辞令。"

"尘埃落定之后，速子科技永远乐意做生意。"$HeOrShe露出一个对生意人最友善的笑容。

options.en: How inspiring. Let's discuss credits.
options.zh: 真叫人振奋。我们来谈谈星币吧。

texts.en: "As we discussed, for a 20,000 credit finders-fee I can forward you to someone who will take care of everything."
texts.zh: "如我们所谈，20,000 星币的介绍费，我就把你转荐给一位能打理一切的人。"

texts.en: "As we discussed," $heOrShe sighs, "I'll accept a 16,000 credit finders-fee then forward you to someone who will take care of everything."
texts.zh: "如我们所谈，\"$heOrShe叹了口气，\"16,000 星币的介绍费我收下，然后把你转荐给一位能打理一切的人。"

texts.en: "As we discussed," $heOrShe sighs, "I'll accept a 12,000 credit finders-fee then forward you to someone who will take care of everything."
texts.zh: "如我们所谈，\"$heOrShe叹了口气，\"12,000 星币的介绍费我收下，然后把你转荐给一位能打理一切的人。"

options.en: 20,000 credits. I accept.
16,000 credits. I accept.
12,000 credits. I accept.
Absurd! How about 10,000 credits?
I could just take this to Gargoyle. You know, the hacker?
options.zh: 我大可以拿去找 Gargoyle。你知道的，那个黑客？

options.en: I could probably just sell these files to another faction and make quite a profit.
options.zh: 我大概也能把这些文件卖给别的势力，赚上一笔。

options.en: I'll find someone else. (decline)

texts.en: $PersonName glances at a TriPad. "Payment received. Thank you, captain."
texts.zh: $PersonName瞥了眼 TriPad。"款已收到。谢谢你，舰长。"

texts.en: $HeOrShe gives you a 20,000 credit smile.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe朝你露出一个值 20,000 星币的笑容。

texts.zh: $HeOrShe朝你露出一个值 16,000 星币的笑容。

texts.en: $HeOrShe gives you a 12,000 credit smile.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe朝你露出一个值 12,000 星币的笑容。

texts.en: "Faro Inesis is your man. I'll forward you his contact information..."
texts.zh: "Faro Inesis 就是你要找的人。我把他的联系方式转给你..."

options.en: Thank you. I think.
I've already met Faro Inesis! What'd I pay you for?
options.zh: 我已经见过 Faro Inesis 了！我这钱花在哪儿了？

options.en: Thank you. I think.

texts.en:
"Thank me after you see some profits from this venture of yours," $heOrShe says.

"Now I ought to open a comms to my investment agent to talk about volatiles futures..."
texts.zh:
"等你在这桩买卖里见到收益，再来谢我，"$heOrShe说道。

"现在我得联络我的投资代理人，谈谈挥发物期货..."

texts.en:
"I'd call it a successful consultation to enhance efficiency in underutilized partner connections."

This line is delivered in complete earnestness.

"Thank me after you see some profits from this venture of yours," $heOrShe says with a wink. "Now I've got some volatiles futures to look into..."
texts.zh:
"我会称之为一次成功的咨询，提升了利用不足的伙伴关系的效率。"

这句话说得一本正经。

"等你在这桩买卖里见到收益，再来谢我，\"$heOrShe眨了眨眼，\"现在我得去看看几笔挥发物期货了..."

texts.en: "16,000 credits," $heOrShe shoots back.
texts.zh: "16,000 星币，"$heOrShe回敬道。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe licks $hisOrHer lips, consternated.

"16,000 credits," $heOrShe says.
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe舔了舔$hisOrHer嘴唇，一脸为难。

"16,000 星币，"$heOrShe说道。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe licks $hisOrHer lips, consternated.

"12,000 credits," $heOrShe says. "Take it or leave it."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe舔了舔$hisOrHer嘴唇，一脸为难。

"12,000 星币，\"$heOrShe说道，\"要就要，不要拉倒。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe licks $hisOrHer lips, consternated.

"Then see what you can get out of that anarchist," $heOrShe says. "You'll probably end up with a virus in your flagship for the trouble."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe舔了舔$hisOrHer嘴唇，一脸为难。

"那就去看看能从那个无政府主义者身上榨出什么，\"$heOrShe说道，\"到头来你的旗舰多半会中个病毒，算是这趟的报酬。"

texts.en: "You think you're the first spacer," $heOrShe says, "with a datacore full of noise claiming to have essential intel for sale?"
texts.zh: "你以为你是头一个，\"$heOrShe说道，\"抱着个塞满杂音的数据核心，声称手里有关键情报待售的太空人？"

texts.en: "But because I admire your spirit, I'll do 16,000 credits," $heOrShe says.
texts.zh: "不过看在你这份胆气的份上，16,000 星币，"$heOrShe说道。

texts.en: "Only because I admire your assertive negotiation, I'll do it for 12,000 credits," $heOrShe says. "Are you in or out?"
texts.zh: "纯粹是欣赏你这股强硬的谈法，12,000 星币，\"$heOrShe说道，\"做还是不做？"

texts.en: $HeOrShe crosses $hisOrHer arms. "Go on, try it. It'll be a waste of time, and time is credits."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe抱起$hisOrHer双臂。"去啊，试试看。白费时间，而时间就是星币。"

texts.en: "You'll be back," $heOrShe says, projecting confidence.
texts.zh: "你会回来的，"$heOrShe说道，刻意显出十足的信心。

texts.en:
"Affirmative, $playerSirOrMadam. One moment."

The comms-link image twitches into the crest of the Hegemony.
texts.zh:
"遵命，$playerSirOrMadam。请稍候。"

通讯画面一阵抖动，换成了霸主的徽记。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: After a few minutes, the comms flutter and stabilize.
texts.zh: 几分钟后，通讯闪了几下，稳定下来。

texts.en:
"Captain $playerLastName," $Rank $personLastName begins, with more than a touch of impatience.

"I'm told you have an important intelligence report to pass up the chain of command."
texts.zh:
"舰长 $playerLastName，"$Rank $personLastName开口道，语气里带着远不止一丝的不耐。

"我听说你有一份重要情报，要沿指挥链上报。"

options.en: Yes. I have unique intel concerning the Sindrian Mutiny. (send files)
options.zh: 是的。我有一份关于辛达叛乱的独家情报。 (发送文件)

texts.en: "I'm sorry, but the High Hegemon is unavailable." The cadet smiles blandly.
texts.zh: "不好意思，至高霸主事务繁忙。" 接待你的那名学员温和地微笑着。

texts.en:
This earns you an unusual expression - for a senior Hegemony officer, at least.

"I'm not sure I want to know how you got it." $HeOrShe holds up a finger, a warning. "And perhaps best if you didn't. There's a standing order which I believe applies to this case."
texts.zh:
这让你看到了一种少见的表情——至少，在一名霸主高级军官脸上是少见的。

"我倒不确定自己想知道你是怎么弄到的。\"$HeOrShe 竖起一根手指，是警告。\"而且你最好也别告诉我。有一道长期有效的命令，我想正适用于此案。"

texts.en: "Take this directly to Admiral Orcus Rao. His command is the Ragnar Complex, orbiting Ragnar in the Valhalla System."
texts.zh: "把这个直接送到 Orcus Rao 上将手上。他的辖区是 Ragnar 综合设施，环绕 Valhalla 星系的 Ragnar 运行。"

options.en: Orcus Rao. Got it.

texts.en:
"Item two, per that order," $heOrShe taps at an interface, and a view of $hisOrHer comms interface appears in the comms.

"I ask you to witness. I shall now delete the files I received from you."

$PersonLastName appears to delete the files, then runs a scrub of $hisOrHer comm system's temporary memory buffer.

With this done, $heOrShe nods to you. "Captain."
texts.zh:
"第二项，按那道命令的要求，"$heOrShe 在界面上点了几下，$hisOrHer 通讯界面的影像便嵌进了通讯链路里。

"我请你做个见证。现在，我将删除从你那里收到的文件。"

$PersonLastName 似乎删掉了那些文件，随后对 $hisOrHer 的通讯系统临时内存缓冲区做了一次擦除。

做完这些，$heOrShe 朝你点了点头。"舰长。"

options.en: Deletion witnessed.

texts.en: "Thank you," $heOrShe says. "We shall speak no more of this. Go to Rao."
texts.zh: "谢谢你，\"$heOrShe 说道。\"此事不必再提。去见 Rao 吧。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe raises an eyebrow.

"I see. There's a standing order which I believe applies to this situation."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 挑起一边眉毛。

"我明白了。有一道长期有效的命令，我想正适用于眼下的情况。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe raises an eyebrow.

"I see. Well, there's a standing order which I believe applies to this case... if this is what it appears to be."

Another skeptical look. "Could be another fake from the Spider. Well, this can be the old renegade's problem."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 挑起一边眉毛。

"我明白了。那么，有一道长期有效的命令，我想正适用于此案...如果这真是它看上去那样的话。"

又是一道怀疑的目光。"也可能是蜘蛛弄出来的又一份假货。行吧，那就让那位老叛逆去伤脑筋。"

options.en: Will you use AI cores to decrypt the files?
options.zh: 你会用 AI 核心来解密这些文件？

options.en: Upload the ANDRADA files
The merc you sent to intercept Macario's courier? That courier.
options.zh: 你派去拦截 Macario 信使的那个佣兵？就是那个信使。

options.en: They were intended for Dolos Macario.
options.zh: 这些文件本来是给 Dolos Macario 的。

options.en: I recovered them from a debris field in Askonia.
options.zh: 我从 Askonia 的一处残骸区里捞回来的。

options.en: I prefer not to reveal that information at this time.
options.zh: 这个来源，我暂时不想透露。

options.en: You hired the merc that made that debris field.
options.zh: 那片残骸区，就是你雇的佣兵做出来的。

options.en: So can you decrypt the files?
options.zh: 那么，这些文件你能解开吗？

texts.en: "You know better than to ask a question like that, $titleHeg."
texts.zh: "问这种问题，你不该不懂规矩，$titleHeg。"

texts.en:
You watch as Rao takes in the file headers.

"All or nothing, huh," he mutters. Then looks back up at you. "Where'd you get these?"
texts.zh:
你看着 Rao 一条条扫过那些文件抬头。

"要么全押，要么全无，是吧。\"他低声嘟囔，然后抬眼看向你。\"这些你是从哪儿弄来的？"

texts.en:
"Huh," he says, then stares off for a moment, thinking.

"Huh." He looks back at you. "Nice work."
texts.zh:
"嗯。"他应了一声，随即望向别处，思索片刻。

"嗯。\"他重新看向你。\"干得不错。"

texts.en: "Huh," he says, then stares off for a moment, thinking.
texts.zh: "嗯。"他应了一声，随即望向别处，思索片刻。

texts.en:
"Huh," he says, then stares off for a moment, thinking.

"Huh." He looks back at you. "Of course. I see. Nice work."
texts.zh:
"嗯。"他应了一声，随即望向别处，思索片刻。

"嗯。\"他重新看向你。\"当然。我明白了。干得不错。"

texts.en:
"$TitleHeg." He sounds disappointed.

"Let me be solid with you for just a moment - I'm not asking the question because I don't know the answer, or have a pretty good idea what it is, anyway. I'm asking as an exercise in trust."

"If you want to do this," he waves his hand, taking in the Hegemony itself, perhaps. Or at least this particular scheme involving his work against the Sindrian Diktat. "If you want to do this, you're going to have to be solid with me."
texts.zh:
"$TitleHeg。"他的声音里透着失望。

"我就跟你交个底吧——我问这个问题，不是因为我不知道答案，或者说，我心里其实已经有相当靠谱的猜测。我问，是为了看看能不能信得过你。"

"如果你想做成这件事，\"他挥了挥手，也许把整个霸主都划了进去，至少也划进了他针对辛达强权的这桩谋划。\"如果你想做成这件事，就得对我交底。"

texts.en: "Allegedly," he says.
texts.zh: "据说是这样。"他说。

options.en: So you knew a courier was transporting the files. Allegedly.
options.zh: 也就是说，你早就知道有一名信使在运这些文件。据说是。

texts.en:
He says nothing.

After a moment, he speaks. "Possibly transporting something unusual and important to Macario, anyway. Good thing he told you what to look for, isn't it."
texts.zh:
他一言不发。

片刻之后，他开口了。"至少，是在把某种不寻常、而且对 Macario 很重要的东西运过去。好在他告诉了你该找什么，不是吗。"

options.en: Where did this courier come from?

texts.en:
He looks at you, judging for a few seconds.

"Tri-Tachyon. An element within Tri-Tachyon, anyway. Usually it's technology and expert technicians. This one looked different."

He puts his hands together, a show of patience to hide anything but.
texts.zh:
他打量着你，像是在掂量什么，持续了几秒。

"速子科技。至少，是速子科技内部的某一股势力。通常他们运的是技术和资深技师。这一趟看着不一样。"

他双手交叠，摆出一副有耐心的样子，好把别的什么藏起来。

texts.en:
"We should have results within ten shifts or so," he says, then looks up. "Three days."

"Return to me soon. If these are what I think they are, Askonia is going to get interesting."
texts.zh:
"十轮班左右就该有结果了，\"他说着抬起头。\"也就是三天。"

"早点回来找我。如果这些真是我以为的东西，Askonia 就要热闹起来了。"

options.en: I have possibly critical intel about the Sindrian Diktat. It is encrypted, however.
options.zh: 我手上有一些可能至关重要的情报，关于辛达强权。不过它是加密的。

"Next item."

texts.en:
"Critical intel, you say? Hmm."

$PersonName closes $hisOrHer eyes, thinking for a moment.

"This sounds like something Fleet Intel should know about. I think I may know who will know what to do with this..."
texts.zh:
"关键情报，你是这么说的？嗯。"

$PersonName闭上$hisOrHer眼睛，沉吟片刻。

"这听起来像是舰队情报部该管的事。我想我知道该把它交给谁处置..."

texts.en:
Reynard considers your words as a felid might consider a shiproach. A smug grin appears.

"If this intel is encrypted how do you know it is as 'critical' as you so claim?"
texts.zh:
Reynard 掂量着你的话，像一只猫在掂量船上的蟑螂。随即浮起一丝得意的笑。

"这情报既然是加密的，你又怎么知道它真像你说的那么'关键'？"

texts.en:
"The Sindrian Diktat," Horus says, repeating your words. He thinks for a moment.

"The League has maintained a distasteful partnership with the Diktat against the Hegemony for many cycles. I do wonder, however..."
texts.zh:
"辛达强权，"Horus 重复着你的话，沉吟片刻。

"许多个周期以来，联盟一直与强权维持着一种令人不快的合作，共同对付霸主。不过我在想..."

texts.en:
"Decryption?" $HeOrShe smiles.

"That won't be a problem. No one beats Tri-Tachyon at data technology, and I'm sure we can come to a discreet arrangement... if you've got the credits."

$HeOrShe puts $hisOrHer hands together, eager to do business. "If you upload a sample of the files, I can give you a better idea of what level of... investment you're going to need.
texts.zh:
"解密？"$HeOrShe笑了。

"这不成问题。论数据技术，没人比得过速子科技，而且我相信我们能谈成一桩稳妥的安排...只要你的星币够。"

$HeOrShe把$hisOrHer双手一合，一副急于做生意的样子。"你先上传一份文件样本，我就能更准确地告诉你，这笔...投入大概要多大。"

texts.en:
For a moment, you see the eyes of the junior cadet glaze over, mask-like, setting shields against another lunatic who is convinced they have key intel that will 'help' the High Hegemon.

Then you see the question cross their face - you do, after all, hold a commission with the Hegemony. That must count for something.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. I am not authorized to receive, um, potentially confidential intelligence. May I forward your comms-link?"
texts.zh:
有那么一瞬，那名年轻学员的眼神就呆滞下去，像蒙上一层壳 —— 又在为一个坚信自己手里握着能'帮到'至高霸主的关键情报的疯子竖起屏障。

随即你看见那个疑问从对方脸上一掠而过 —— 毕竟你手里握着霸主的委任状。这总该算点什么。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。我无权接收，呃，可能属于机密的情报。可以让我把你的通讯链路转接上去吗？"

texts.en:
For a moment, you see the eyes of the junior cadet glaze over, mask-like, setting shields against another lunatic who is convinced they have key intel that will 'help' the High Hegemon.

They don't quite sigh as they put on a resigned air - what they're doing will be technically correct even if a superior officer is sure to be annoyed. Duty is duty.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. I am not authorized to receive, um, potentially confidential intelligence. May I forward your comms-link?"
texts.zh:
有那么一瞬，那名年轻学员的眼神就呆滞下去，像蒙上一层壳 —— 又在为一个坚信自己手里握着能'帮到'至高霸主的关键情报的疯子竖起屏障。

对方换上一副认命的神情，几乎要叹气 —— 他们要做的这件事在程序上无可挑剔，哪怕上级军官肯定会不高兴。职责就是职责。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。我无权接收，呃，可能属于机密的情报。可以让我把你的通讯链路转接上去吗？"

$HeOrShe looks at you gravely. "Where did you get this?"

texts.en: "Well, good luck. Hope your find turns out to be something useful."

texts.en:
You explain the situation. Macario's bizarre requests, the sudden interruption and the recovery from the skull of a courier killed in space by a merc on the edge of Askonia.

Reynard pretends to stifle a yawn.

"Fine, fine, perhaps it is something," he says. "Take it to Fleet Intelligence. Special Agent Finlay Siyavong."

A tap at his TriPad and a comms ID appears in your interface. Reynard sets his face, not giving a look of approval - or, for once, condescension.

"Off you go. I'll receive a report if it's anything."
texts.zh:
你解释了来龙去脉：Macario 那些古怪的要求、通讯的骤然中断，以及从一名信使的颅骨里取出的东西 —— 那信使是在 Askonia 边缘被雇佣兵杀死在太空里的。

Reynard 装模作样地压下一个哈欠。

"行，行，也许真有点东西，\"他说，\"送去舰队情报部。找特工 Finlay Siyavong。"

他在 TriPad 上一点，一个通讯识别码出现在你的界面上。Reynard 板着脸，既没有赞许的神色 —— 这一次也没有居高临下。

"去吧。要真有价值，我会收到报告的。"

texts.en:
He looks back to the feed.

"If this is 'critical intel', as you say, I can only hope for an opportunity to shake up the status quo established by Reynard Hannan. Considering the character of the Sindrian Diktat, any presumed intelligence data should prove... troublesome. Therefore it is important that it be presented objectively, and to do so we need it to get into the professional bureaucracy before it becomes 'handled' by a major gens."

"That includes Gens Yaribay," he says with a self-effacing look. "Your trust is appreciated, as a matter of course."
texts.zh:
他重新看向通讯画面。

"如果这真如你所说，是'关键情报'，那我倒希望能借此撼动 Reynard Hannan 立下的那套现状。以辛达强权的行事作风，任何被认定的情报恐怕都会相当...麻烦。所以关键在于让它以客观的面目呈上去；要做到这一点，就得赶在某个大氏族把它'处理'掉之前，送进职业官僚体系里。"

"这其中也包括 Yaribay 氏族，\"他带着几分自嘲说道，\"当然，你的信任我很领情。"

texts.en:
"Take the files to Fleet Intelligence," he says, a tone of aristocratic command entering his voice. "Special Agent Finlay Siyavong."

He taps at a TriPad and a comms ID appears in your interface.

"Gens Yaribay shall be watching the situation, captain."

He allows the hint of a smile, though there's worry in his eyes.

"Yaribay 氏族会盯着这件事的，舰长。"

他容许自己露出一丝笑意，眼里却藏着忧虑。

texts.en:
"Ah," $heOrShe spreads his hands, thinks better of it, and puts $hisOrHer hands together again. "Every major faction in the Persean Sector is a commercial partner of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation! Even the Luddic Church. Isn't that something?"

"It is true that there are occasional conflicts - 'kinetic negotiations', if you will - which put profitable ventures on hold. But in the end everyone recognizes that the market is the ultimate driver of prosperity, whatever political rhetoric they claim to embrace."

"After the dust settles, Tri-Tachyon is always open for business." $HeOrShe produces a business-friendly smile.
texts.zh:
"啊，\"$heOrShe摊开双手，又觉得不妥，重新把$hisOrHer双手合拢，\"英仙座星域的每一个主要势力，都是速子科技的商业伙伴！连银河救赎教会也不例外。有意思吧？"

"偶尔确实会有冲突 —— 不妨称之为'动能谈判' —— 让赚钱的生意暂时搁置。但说到底，人人都明白市场才是繁荣的根本动力，无论他们嘴上信奉的是什么政治辞令。"

"尘埃落定之后，速子科技永远乐意做生意。"$HeOrShe露出一个对生意人最友善的笑容。

options.en: How inspiring. Let's discuss credits.

"Affirmative, $playerSirOrMadam. One moment."

The comms-link image twitches into the crest of the Hegemony.

options.en: Continue

texts.en: After a few minutes, the comms flutter and stabilize.
texts.zh: 几分钟后，通讯闪了几下，稳定下来。

texts.en:
"Captain $playerLastName," $Rank $personLastName begins, with more than a touch of impatience.

"I'm told you have an important intelligence report to pass up the chain of command."
texts.zh:
"舰长 $playerLastName，"$Rank $personLastName开口道，语气里带着远不止一丝的不耐。

"我听说你有一份重要情报，要沿指挥链上报。"

options.en: Yes. I have unique intel concerning the Sindrian Mutiny. (send files)
options.zh: 是的。我有一份关于辛达叛乱的独家情报。 (发送文件)

texts.en: "I'm sorry, but the High Hegemon is unavailable." The cadet smiles blandly.
texts.zh: "不好意思，至高霸主事务繁忙。" 接待你的那名学员温和地微笑着。

texts.en:
This earns you an unusual expression - for a senior Hegemony officer, at least.

"I'm not sure I want to know how you got it." $HeOrShe holds up a finger, a warning. "And perhaps best if you didn't. There's a standing order which I believe applies to this case."
texts.zh:
这让你看到了一种少见的表情——至少，在一名霸主高级军官脸上是少见的。

"我倒不确定自己想知道你是怎么弄到的。\"$HeOrShe 竖起一根手指，是警告。\"而且你最好也别告诉我。有一道长期有效的命令，我想正适用于此案。"

texts.en: "Take this directly to Admiral Orcus Rao. His command is the Ragnar Complex, orbiting Ragnar in the Valhalla System."
texts.zh: "把这个直接送到 Orcus Rao 上将手上。他的辖区是 Ragnar 综合设施，环绕 Valhalla 星系的 Ragnar 运行。"

options.en: Orcus Rao. Got it.

texts.en:
"Item two, per that order," $heOrShe taps at an interface, and a view of $hisOrHer comms interface appears in the comms.

"I ask you to witness. I shall now delete the files I received from you."

$PersonLastName appears to delete the files, then runs a scrub of $hisOrHer comm system's temporary memory buffer.

With this done, $heOrShe nods to you. "Captain."
texts.zh:
"第二项，按那道命令的要求，"$heOrShe 在界面上点了几下，$hisOrHer 通讯界面的影像便嵌进了通讯链路里。

"我请你做个见证。现在，我将删除从你那里收到的文件。"

$PersonLastName 似乎删掉了那些文件，随后对 $hisOrHer 的通讯系统临时内存缓冲区做了一次擦除。

做完这些，$heOrShe 朝你点了点头。"舰长。"

options.en: Deletion witnessed.

texts.en: "Thank you," $heOrShe says. "We shall speak no more of this. Go to Rao."
texts.zh: "谢谢你，\"$heOrShe 说道。\"此事不必再提。去见 Rao 吧。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe raises an eyebrow.

"I see. There's a standing order which I believe applies to this situation."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 挑起一边眉毛。

"我明白了。有一道长期有效的命令，我想正适用于眼下的情况。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe raises an eyebrow.

"I see. Well, there's a standing order which I believe applies to this case... if this is what it appears to be."

Another skeptical look. "Could be another fake from the Spider. Well, this can be the old renegade's problem."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 挑起一边眉毛。

"我明白了。那么，有一道长期有效的命令，我想正适用于此案...如果这真是它看上去那样的话。"

又是一道怀疑的目光。"也可能是蜘蛛弄出来的又一份假货。行吧，那就让那位老叛逆去伤脑筋。"

options.en: Will you use AI cores to decrypt the files?
options.zh: 你会用 AI 核心来解密这些文件？

The merc you sent to intercept Macario's courier? That courier.

options.zh: 这些文件本来是给 Dolos Macario 的。

options.en: I recovered them from a debris field in Askonia.
options.zh: 我从 Askonia 的一处残骸区里捞回来的。

texts.en: "You know better than to ask a question like that, $titleHeg."
texts.zh: "问这种问题，你不该不懂规矩，$titleHeg。"

texts.en:
You watch as Rao takes in the file headers.

"All or nothing, huh," he mutters. Then looks back up at you. "Where'd you get these?"
texts.zh:
你看着 Rao 一条条扫过那些文件抬头。

"要么全押，要么全无，是吧。\"他低声嘟囔，然后抬眼看向你。\"这些你是从哪儿弄来的？"

texts.en:
"Huh," he says, then stares off for a moment, thinking.

"Huh." He looks back at you. "Nice work."
texts.zh:
"嗯。"他应了一声，随即望向别处，思索片刻。

"嗯。\"他重新看向你。\"干得不错。"

texts.en: "Huh," he says, then stares off for a moment, thinking.
texts.zh: "嗯。"他应了一声，随即望向别处，思索片刻。

texts.en:
"Huh," he says, then stares off for a moment, thinking.

"Huh." He looks back at you. "Of course. I see. Nice work."
texts.zh:
"嗯。"他应了一声，随即望向别处，思索片刻。

"嗯。\"他重新看向你。\"当然。我明白了。干得不错。"

texts.en:
"$TitleHeg." He sounds disappointed.

"Let me be solid with you for just a moment - I'm not asking the question because I don't know the answer, or have a pretty good idea what it is, anyway. I'm asking as an exercise in trust."

"If you want to do this," he waves his hand, taking in the Hegemony itself, perhaps. Or at least this particular scheme involving his work against the Sindrian Diktat. "If you want to do this, you're going to have to be solid with me."
texts.zh:
"$TitleHeg。"他的声音里透着失望。

"我就跟你交个底吧——我问这个问题，不是因为我不知道答案，或者说，我心里其实已经有相当靠谱的猜测。我问，是为了看看能不能信得过你。"

"如果你想做成这件事，\"他挥了挥手，也许把整个霸主都划了进去，至少也划进了他针对辛达强权的这桩谋划。\"如果你想做成这件事，就得对我交底。"

texts.en: "Allegedly," he says.
texts.zh: "据说是这样。"他说。

options.en: So you knew a courier was transporting the files. Allegedly.
options.zh: 也就是说，你早就知道有一名信使在运这些文件。据说是。

texts.en:
He says nothing.

After a moment, he speaks. "Possibly transporting something unusual and important to Macario, anyway. Good thing he told you what to look for, isn't it."
texts.zh:
他一言不发。

片刻之后，他开口了。"至少，是在把某种不寻常、而且对 Macario 很重要的东西运过去。好在他告诉了你该找什么，不是吗。"

options.en: Where did this courier come from?

texts.en:
He looks at you, judging for a few seconds.

"Tri-Tachyon. An element within Tri-Tachyon, anyway. Usually it's technology and expert technicians. This one looked different."

He puts his hands together, a show of patience to hide anything but.
texts.zh:
他打量着你，像是在掂量什么，持续了几秒。

"速子科技。至少，是速子科技内部的某一股势力。通常他们运的是技术和资深技师。这一趟看着不一样。"

他双手交叠，摆出一副有耐心的样子，好把别的什么藏起来。

texts.en:
"We should have results within ten shifts or so," he says, then looks up. "Three days."

"Return to me soon. If these are what I think they are, Askonia is going to get interesting."
texts.zh:
"十轮班左右就该有结果了，\"他说着抬起头。\"也就是三天。"

"早点回来找我。如果这些真是我以为的东西，Askonia 就要热闹起来了。"

options.en: Siyavong won't decrypt the files unless I have a Persean League commission...
options.zh: 除非我拿到英仙座联盟的委任状，不然 Siyavong 不会解密这些文件...

texts.en:
"Hmm," Horus rubs his chin. "A wise and necessary precaution, no doubt."

"I suppose you'll have to earn a commission with the League, granted by a senior official with that power," he continues. "I can help you find reputable work but it is up to you to prove yourself sufficient to that honor."
texts.zh:
"嗯，\"Horus 搓着下巴，\"毫无疑问，这是明智而必要的防范。"

"那么你恐怕得从联盟那里挣一份委任状 —— 得由有权授予的高级官员签发，\"他接着说，\"我可以帮你找些正经活计，但要配得上那份荣衔，得靠你自己去证明。"

options.en: I have an intel report concerning the Sindrian Mutiny.
options.zh: 我有一份关于辛达叛乱的情报。

texts.en:
"Take it to Faro Inesis. Achaman. Magec system."

She doesn't bother to infuse her voice with even a pretense of interest.

"Next item."
texts.zh:
"把它交给 Faro Inesis。Achaman，Magec 星系。"

她连装都懒得装出一点兴趣。

"下一项。"

texts.en:
"Take it to my strategic analyst, name is Faro Inesis. Achaman Franchise Station, Magec system."

She doesn't bother to infuse her voice with even a pretense of interest.

"Next item."
texts.zh:
"交给我的战略分析师，叫 Faro Inesis。Achaman Franchise Station，Magec 星系。"

她连装都懒得装出一点兴趣。

"下一项。"

texts.en:
"Critical intel, you say? Hmm."

$PersonName closes $hisOrHer eyes, thinking for a moment.

"This sounds like something Fleet Intel should know about. I think I may know who will know what to do with this..."
texts.zh:
"关键情报，你是这么说的？嗯。"

$PersonName闭上$hisOrHer眼睛，沉吟片刻。

"这听起来像是舰队情报部该管的事。我想我知道该把它交给谁处置..."

texts.en:
Reynard considers your words as a felid might consider a shiproach. A smug grin appears.

"If this intel is encrypted how do you know it is as 'critical' as you so claim?"
texts.zh:
Reynard 掂量着你的话，像一只猫在掂量船上的蟑螂。随即浮起一丝得意的笑。

"这情报既然是加密的，你又怎么知道它真像你说的那么'关键'？"

texts.en:
"The Sindrian Diktat," Horus says, repeating your words. He thinks for a moment.

"The League has maintained a distasteful partnership with the Diktat against the Hegemony for many cycles. I do wonder, however..."
texts.zh:
"辛达强权，"Horus 重复着你的话，沉吟片刻。

"许多个周期以来，联盟一直与强权维持着一种令人不快的合作，共同对付霸主。不过我在想..."

texts.en:
"Decryption?" $HeOrShe smiles.

"That won't be a problem. No one beats Tri-Tachyon at data technology, and I'm sure we can come to a discreet arrangement... if you've got the credits."

$HeOrShe puts $hisOrHer hands together, eager to do business. "If you upload a sample of the files, I can give you a better idea of what level of... investment you're going to need.
texts.zh:
"解密？"$HeOrShe笑了。

"这不成问题。论数据技术，没人比得过速子科技，而且我相信我们能谈成一桩稳妥的安排...只要你的星币够。"

$HeOrShe把$hisOrHer双手一合，一副急于做生意的样子。"你先上传一份文件样本，我就能更准确地告诉你，这笔...投入大概要多大。"

texts.en:
For a moment, you see the eyes of the junior cadet glaze over, mask-like, setting shields against another lunatic who is convinced they have key intel that will 'help' the High Hegemon.

Then you see the question cross their face - you do, after all, hold a commission with the Hegemony. That must count for something.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. I am not authorized to receive, um, potentially confidential intelligence. May I forward your comms-link?"
texts.zh:
有那么一瞬，那名年轻学员的眼神就呆滞下去，像蒙上一层壳 —— 又在为一个坚信自己手里握着能'帮到'至高霸主的关键情报的疯子竖起屏障。

随即你看见那个疑问从对方脸上一掠而过 —— 毕竟你手里握着霸主的委任状。这总该算点什么。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。我无权接收，呃，可能属于机密的情报。可以让我把你的通讯链路转接上去吗？"

texts.en:
For a moment, you see the eyes of the junior cadet glaze over, mask-like, setting shields against another lunatic who is convinced they have key intel that will 'help' the High Hegemon.

They don't quite sigh as they put on a resigned air - what they're doing will be technically correct even if a superior officer is sure to be annoyed. Duty is duty.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. I am not authorized to receive, um, potentially confidential intelligence. May I forward your comms-link?"
texts.zh:
有那么一瞬，那名年轻学员的眼神就呆滞下去，像蒙上一层壳 —— 又在为一个坚信自己手里握着能'帮到'至高霸主的关键情报的疯子竖起屏障。

对方换上一副认命的神情，几乎要叹气 —— 他们要做的这件事在程序上无可挑剔，哪怕上级军官肯定会不高兴。职责就是职责。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。我无权接收，呃，可能属于机密的情报。可以让我把你的通讯链路转接上去吗？"

You watch $PersonRank $personLastName's face as $heOrShe skims the file headers of the report.

Seven names, seven Andradas. Seven blocks of heavily encrypted data. Skepticism is followed by concern.

$HeOrShe looks at you gravely. "Where did you get this?"

你注视着 $PersonRank $personLastName 的脸，$heOrShe 正一条条扫过报告的卷首信息。

七个名字，七个 Andrada。七段重度加密的数据。怀疑过后，是忧虑。

$HeOrShe 神情凝重地看着你。"这东西你是从哪儿弄来的？"

He taps at his comms interface and a transfer link appears.

"$TitleHeg," he prompts.

"$TitleHeg。"他提示道。

texts.en: "I- yes. Yes it is," $heOrShe says, looking surprised. "I guess you're better connected than I thought."
texts.zh: "我——对。是的，\"$heOrShe说道，神色有些意外，\"看来你的人脉比我以为的广。"

texts.en: "Well, good luck. Hope your find turns out to be something useful."
texts.zh: "那就祝你好运。希望你找到的东西真有点用处。"

texts.en:
You explain the situation. Macario's bizarre requests, the sudden interruption and the recovery from the skull of a courier killed in space by a merc on the edge of Askonia.

Reynard pretends to stifle a yawn.

"Fine, fine, perhaps it is something," he says. "Take it to Fleet Intelligence. Special Agent Finlay Siyavong."

A tap at his TriPad and a comms ID appears in your interface. Reynard sets his face, not giving a look of approval - or, for once, condescension.

"Off you go. I'll receive a report if it's anything."
texts.zh:
你解释了来龙去脉：Macario 那些古怪的要求、通讯的骤然中断，以及从一名信使的颅骨里取出的东西 —— 那信使是在 Askonia 边缘被雇佣兵杀死在太空里的。

Reynard 装模作样地压下一个哈欠。

"行，行，也许真有点东西，\"他说，\"送去舰队情报部。找特工 Finlay Siyavong。"

他在 TriPad 上一点，一个通讯识别码出现在你的界面上。Reynard 板着脸，既没有赞许的神色 —— 这一次也没有居高临下。

"去吧。要真有价值，我会收到报告的。"

texts.en:
He looks back to the feed.

"If this is 'critical intel', as you say, I can only hope for an opportunity to shake up the status quo established by Reynard Hannan. Considering the character of the Sindrian Diktat, any presumed intelligence data should prove... troublesome. Therefore it is important that it be presented objectively, and to do so we need it to get into the professional bureaucracy before it becomes 'handled' by a major gens."

"That includes Gens Yaribay," he says with a self-effacing look. "Your trust is appreciated, as a matter of course."
texts.zh:
他重新看向通讯画面。

"如果这真如你所说，是'关键情报'，那我倒希望能借此撼动 Reynard Hannan 立下的那套现状。以辛达强权的行事作风，任何被认定的情报恐怕都会相当...麻烦。所以关键在于让它以客观的面目呈上去；要做到这一点，就得赶在某个大氏族把它'处理'掉之前，送进职业官僚体系里。"

"这其中也包括 Yaribay 氏族，\"他带着几分自嘲说道，\"当然，你的信任我很领情。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Take the files to Fleet Intelligence," he says, a tone of aristocratic command entering his voice. "Special Agent Finlay Siyavong."

He taps at a TriPad and a comms ID appears in your interface.

"Gens Yaribay shall be watching the situation, captain."

He allows the hint of a smile, though there's worry in his eyes.
texts.zh:
"把文件送到舰队情报部去，\"他说，语调里带上了贵族式的命令口吻，\"特工 Finlay Siyavong。"

他在 TriPad 上点了几下，一个通讯识别码出现在你的界面上。

"Yaribay 氏族会盯着这件事的，舰长。"

他容许自己露出一丝笑意，眼里却藏着忧虑。

texts.en:
You watch $personLastName's eyes as $heOrShe skims the file header.

"This won't be cheap," $heOrShe says. "If this is what it looks like."
texts.zh:
你看着$personLastName的眼睛 —— $heOrShe正扫过文件的头部信息。

"这可不便宜，\"$heOrShe说道，\"如果它真是看上去的那样。"

options.en: What would you say this looks like?
Let's discuss credits.

texts.en: "It might be sensitive information of interest to... a commercial partner of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation," $heOrShe says with a slightly more strained smile.
texts.zh: "它可能是些敏感信息，或许会让...速子科技的一家商业伙伴感兴趣，"$heOrShe说道，笑容略微发僵。

options.en: The Sindrian Diktat is a partner of Tri-Tachyon?
options.zh: 辛达强权是速子科技的伙伴？

options.en: Then we'll be careful. Let's discuss credits.
options.zh: 那我们就谨慎些。谈谈星币吧。

texts.en:
"Ah," $heOrShe spreads his hands, thinks better of it, and puts $hisOrHer hands together again. "Every major faction in the Persean Sector is a commercial partner of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation! Even the Luddic Church. Isn't that something?"

"It is true that there are occasional conflicts - 'kinetic negotiations', if you will - which put profitable ventures on hold. But in the end everyone recognizes that the market is the ultimate driver of prosperity, whatever political rhetoric they claim to embrace."

"After the dust settles, Tri-Tachyon is always open for business." $HeOrShe produces a business-friendly smile.
texts.zh:
"啊，\"$heOrShe摊开双手，又觉得不妥，重新把$hisOrHer双手合拢，\"英仙座星域的每一个主要势力，都是速子科技的商业伙伴！连银河救赎教会也不例外。有意思吧？"

"偶尔确实会有冲突 —— 不妨称之为'动能谈判' —— 让赚钱的生意暂时搁置。但说到底，人人都明白市场才是繁荣的根本动力，无论他们嘴上信奉的是什么政治辞令。"

"尘埃落定之后，速子科技永远乐意做生意。"$HeOrShe露出一个对生意人最友善的笑容。

options.en: How inspiring. Let's discuss credits.
options.zh: 真叫人振奋。我们来谈谈星币吧。

texts.en: "As we discussed, for a 20,000 credit finders-fee I can forward you to someone who will take care of everything."
texts.zh: "如我们所谈，20,000 星币的介绍费，我就把你转荐给一位能打理一切的人。"

texts.en: "As we discussed," $heOrShe sighs, "I'll accept a 16,000 credit finders-fee then forward you to someone who will take care of everything."
texts.zh: "如我们所谈，\"$heOrShe叹了口气，\"16,000 星币的介绍费我收下，然后把你转荐给一位能打理一切的人。"

texts.en: "As we discussed," $heOrShe sighs, "I'll accept a 12,000 credit finders-fee then forward you to someone who will take care of everything."
texts.zh: "如我们所谈，\"$heOrShe叹了口气，\"12,000 星币的介绍费我收下，然后把你转荐给一位能打理一切的人。"

options.en: 20,000 credits. I accept.
16,000 credits. I accept.
12,000 credits. I accept.
Absurd! How about 10,000 credits?
I could just take this to Gargoyle. You know, the hacker?
options.zh: 我大可以拿去找 Gargoyle。你知道的，那个黑客？

options.en: I could probably just sell these files to another faction and make quite a profit.
options.zh: 我大概也能把这些文件卖给别的势力，赚上一笔。

options.en: I'll find someone else. (decline)

texts.en: $PersonName glances at a TriPad. "Payment received. Thank you, captain."
texts.zh: $PersonName瞥了眼 TriPad。"款已收到。谢谢你，舰长。"

texts.en: $HeOrShe gives you a 20,000 credit smile.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe朝你露出一个值 20,000 星币的笑容。

texts.zh: $HeOrShe朝你露出一个值 16,000 星币的笑容。

texts.en: $HeOrShe gives you a 12,000 credit smile.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe朝你露出一个值 12,000 星币的笑容。

texts.en: "Faro Inesis is your man. I'll forward you his contact information..."
texts.zh: "Faro Inesis 就是你要找的人。我把他的联系方式转给你..."

options.en: Thank you. I think.
I've already met Faro Inesis! What'd I pay you for?
options.zh: 我已经见过 Faro Inesis 了！我这钱花在哪儿了？

options.en: Thank you. I think.

texts.en:
"Thank me after you see some profits from this venture of yours," $heOrShe says.

"Now I ought to open a comms to my investment agent to talk about volatiles futures..."
texts.zh:
"等你在这桩买卖里见到收益，再来谢我，"$heOrShe说道。

"现在我得联络我的投资代理人，谈谈挥发物期货..."

texts.en:
"I'd call it a successful consultation to enhance efficiency in underutilized partner connections."

This line is delivered in complete earnestness.

"Thank me after you see some profits from this venture of yours," $heOrShe says with a wink. "Now I've got some volatiles futures to look into..."
texts.zh:
"我会称之为一次成功的咨询，提升了利用不足的伙伴关系的效率。"

这句话说得一本正经。

"等你在这桩买卖里见到收益，再来谢我，\"$heOrShe眨了眨眼，\"现在我得去看看几笔挥发物期货了..."

texts.en: "16,000 credits," $heOrShe shoots back.
texts.zh: "16,000 星币，"$heOrShe回敬道。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe licks $hisOrHer lips, consternated.

"16,000 credits," $heOrShe says.
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe舔了舔$hisOrHer嘴唇，一脸为难。

"16,000 星币，"$heOrShe说道。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe licks $hisOrHer lips, consternated.

"12,000 credits," $heOrShe says. "Take it or leave it."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe舔了舔$hisOrHer嘴唇，一脸为难。

"12,000 星币，\"$heOrShe说道，\"要就要，不要拉倒。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe licks $hisOrHer lips, consternated.

"Then see what you can get out of that anarchist," $heOrShe says. "You'll probably end up with a virus in your flagship for the trouble."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe舔了舔$hisOrHer嘴唇，一脸为难。

"那就去看看能从那个无政府主义者身上榨出什么，\"$heOrShe说道，\"到头来你的旗舰多半会中个病毒，算是这趟的报酬。"

texts.en: "You think you're the first spacer," $heOrShe says, "with a datacore full of noise claiming to have essential intel for sale?"
texts.zh: "你以为你是头一个，\"$heOrShe说道，\"抱着个塞满杂音的数据核心，声称手里有关键情报待售的太空人？"

texts.en: "But because I admire your spirit, I'll do 16,000 credits," $heOrShe says.
texts.zh: "不过看在你这份胆气的份上，16,000 星币，"$heOrShe说道。

texts.en: "Only because I admire your assertive negotiation, I'll do it for 12,000 credits," $heOrShe says. "Are you in or out?"
texts.zh: "纯粹是欣赏你这股强硬的谈法，12,000 星币，\"$heOrShe说道，\"做还是不做？"

texts.en: $HeOrShe crosses $hisOrHer arms. "Go on, try it. It'll be a waste of time, and time is credits."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe抱起$hisOrHer双臂。"去啊，试试看。白费时间，而时间就是星币。"

texts.en: "You'll be back," $heOrShe says, projecting confidence.
texts.zh: "你会回来的，"$heOrShe说道，刻意显出十足的信心。

texts.en:
"Affirmative, $playerSirOrMadam. One moment."

The comms-link image twitches into the crest of the Hegemony.
texts.zh:
"遵命，$playerSirOrMadam。请稍候。"

通讯画面一阵抖动，换成了霸主的徽记。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: After a few minutes, the comms flutter and stabilize.
texts.zh: 几分钟后，通讯闪了几下，稳定下来。

texts.en:
"Captain $playerLastName," $Rank $personLastName begins, with more than a touch of impatience.

"I'm told you have an important intelligence report to pass up the chain of command."
texts.zh:
"舰长 $playerLastName，"$Rank $personLastName开口道，语气里带着远不止一丝的不耐。

"我听说你有一份重要情报，要沿指挥链上报。"

options.en: Yes. I have unique intel concerning the Sindrian Mutiny. (send files)
options.zh: 是的。我有一份关于辛达叛乱的独家情报。 (发送文件)

texts.en: "I'm sorry, but the High Hegemon is unavailable." The cadet smiles blandly.
texts.zh: "不好意思，至高霸主事务繁忙。" 接待你的那名学员温和地微笑着。

texts.en:
This earns you an unusual expression - for a senior Hegemony officer, at least.

"I'm not sure I want to know how you got it." $HeOrShe holds up a finger, a warning. "And perhaps best if you didn't. There's a standing order which I believe applies to this case."
texts.zh:
这让你看到了一种少见的表情——至少，在一名霸主高级军官脸上是少见的。

"我倒不确定自己想知道你是怎么弄到的。\"$HeOrShe 竖起一根手指，是警告。\"而且你最好也别告诉我。有一道长期有效的命令，我想正适用于此案。"

texts.en: "Take this directly to Admiral Orcus Rao. His command is the Ragnar Complex, orbiting Ragnar in the Valhalla System."
texts.zh: "把这个直接送到 Orcus Rao 上将手上。他的辖区是 Ragnar 综合设施，环绕 Valhalla 星系的 Ragnar 运行。"

options.en: Orcus Rao. Got it.

texts.en:
"Item two, per that order," $heOrShe taps at an interface, and a view of $hisOrHer comms interface appears in the comms.

"I ask you to witness. I shall now delete the files I received from you."

$PersonLastName appears to delete the files, then runs a scrub of $hisOrHer comm system's temporary memory buffer.

With this done, $heOrShe nods to you. "Captain."
texts.zh:
"第二项，按那道命令的要求，"$heOrShe 在界面上点了几下，$hisOrHer 通讯界面的影像便嵌进了通讯链路里。

"我请你做个见证。现在，我将删除从你那里收到的文件。"

$PersonLastName 似乎删掉了那些文件，随后对 $hisOrHer 的通讯系统临时内存缓冲区做了一次擦除。

做完这些，$heOrShe 朝你点了点头。"舰长。"

options.en: Deletion witnessed.

texts.en: "Thank you," $heOrShe says. "We shall speak no more of this. Go to Rao."
texts.zh: "谢谢你，\"$heOrShe 说道。\"此事不必再提。去见 Rao 吧。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe raises an eyebrow.

"I see. There's a standing order which I believe applies to this situation."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 挑起一边眉毛。

"我明白了。有一道长期有效的命令，我想正适用于眼下的情况。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe raises an eyebrow.

"I see. Well, there's a standing order which I believe applies to this case... if this is what it appears to be."

Another skeptical look. "Could be another fake from the Spider. Well, this can be the old renegade's problem."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 挑起一边眉毛。

"我明白了。那么，有一道长期有效的命令，我想正适用于此案...如果这真是它看上去那样的话。"

又是一道怀疑的目光。"也可能是蜘蛛弄出来的又一份假货。行吧，那就让那位老叛逆去伤脑筋。"

options.en: Will you use AI cores to decrypt the files?
options.zh: 你会用 AI 核心来解密这些文件？

options.en: Upload the ANDRADA files
The merc you sent to intercept Macario's courier? That courier.
options.zh: 你派去拦截 Macario 信使的那个佣兵？就是那个信使。

options.en: They were intended for Dolos Macario.
options.zh: 这些文件本来是给 Dolos Macario 的。

options.en: I recovered them from a debris field in Askonia.
options.zh: 我从 Askonia 的一处残骸区里捞回来的。

options.en: I prefer not to reveal that information at this time.
options.zh: 这个来源，我暂时不想透露。

options.en: You hired the merc that made that debris field.
options.zh: 那片残骸区，就是你雇的佣兵做出来的。

options.en: So can you decrypt the files?
options.zh: 那么，这些文件你能解开吗？

texts.en: "You know better than to ask a question like that, $titleHeg."
texts.zh: "问这种问题，你不该不懂规矩，$titleHeg。"

texts.en:
You watch as Rao takes in the file headers.

"All or nothing, huh," he mutters. Then looks back up at you. "Where'd you get these?"
texts.zh:
你看着 Rao 一条条扫过那些文件抬头。

"要么全押，要么全无，是吧。\"他低声嘟囔，然后抬眼看向你。\"这些你是从哪儿弄来的？"

texts.en:
"Huh," he says, then stares off for a moment, thinking.

"Huh." He looks back at you. "Nice work."
texts.zh:
"嗯。"他应了一声，随即望向别处，思索片刻。

"嗯。\"他重新看向你。\"干得不错。"

texts.en: "Huh," he says, then stares off for a moment, thinking.
texts.zh: "嗯。"他应了一声，随即望向别处，思索片刻。

texts.en:
"Huh," he says, then stares off for a moment, thinking.

"Huh." He looks back at you. "Of course. I see. Nice work."
texts.zh:
"嗯。"他应了一声，随即望向别处，思索片刻。

"嗯。\"他重新看向你。\"当然。我明白了。干得不错。"

texts.en:
"$TitleHeg." He sounds disappointed.

"Let me be solid with you for just a moment - I'm not asking the question because I don't know the answer, or have a pretty good idea what it is, anyway. I'm asking as an exercise in trust."

"If you want to do this," he waves his hand, taking in the Hegemony itself, perhaps. Or at least this particular scheme involving his work against the Sindrian Diktat. "If you want to do this, you're going to have to be solid with me."
texts.zh:
"$TitleHeg。"他的声音里透着失望。

"我就跟你交个底吧——我问这个问题，不是因为我不知道答案，或者说，我心里其实已经有相当靠谱的猜测。我问，是为了看看能不能信得过你。"

"如果你想做成这件事，\"他挥了挥手，也许把整个霸主都划了进去，至少也划进了他针对辛达强权的这桩谋划。\"如果你想做成这件事，就得对我交底。"

texts.en: "Allegedly," he says.
texts.zh: "据说是这样。"他说。

options.en: So you knew a courier was transporting the files. Allegedly.
options.zh: 也就是说，你早就知道有一名信使在运这些文件。据说是。

texts.en:
He says nothing.

After a moment, he speaks. "Possibly transporting something unusual and important to Macario, anyway. Good thing he told you what to look for, isn't it."
texts.zh:
他一言不发。

片刻之后，他开口了。"至少，是在把某种不寻常、而且对 Macario 很重要的东西运过去。好在他告诉了你该找什么，不是吗。"

options.en: Where did this courier come from?

texts.en:
He looks at you, judging for a few seconds.

"Tri-Tachyon. An element within Tri-Tachyon, anyway. Usually it's technology and expert technicians. This one looked different."

He puts his hands together, a show of patience to hide anything but.
texts.zh:
他打量着你，像是在掂量什么，持续了几秒。

"速子科技。至少，是速子科技内部的某一股势力。通常他们运的是技术和资深技师。这一趟看着不一样。"

他双手交叠，摆出一副有耐心的样子，好把别的什么藏起来。

texts.en:
"We should have results within ten shifts or so," he says, then looks up. "Three days."

"Return to me soon. If these are what I think they are, Askonia is going to get interesting."
texts.zh:
"十轮班左右就该有结果了，\"他说着抬起头。\"也就是三天。"

"早点回来找我。如果这些真是我以为的东西，Askonia 就要热闹起来了。"

texts.en: "And don't worry, $titleHeg," he says. "My... people are still working on that Sindrian intel."
texts.zh: "别担心，$titleHeg，\"他说。\"我手下那些人...还在啃那份辛达情报。"

texts.en:
After a short wait spent watching propaganda blurbs scroll past the crest of the Hegemony navy, the comm-link connects you with the office of Admiral Rao.

"$TitleHeg," he says. "We have some intel to discuss."
texts.zh:
你等了一小会儿，看着宣传短片在霸主海军徽记旁一条条滚过，通讯链路终于接通了 Rao 上将的办公室。

"$TitleHeg。\"他说。\"有些情报要谈。"

options.en: The ANDRADA files.

texts.en:
"Yes." A slow smile appears.

"I would like you to confirm these reports. Personally."

"The Hegemony is a blunt instrument, intelligence services included. If we started an official investigation, everyone will soon know why."
texts.zh:
"没错。"一个缓慢的笑容浮了上来。

"我希望由你去核实这些报告。亲自去。"

"霸主是件钝器，情报部门也一样。我们要是正式立案调查，所有人很快就会明白是为了什么。"

texts.en: "It'd be convenient if you held a Hegemony commission, and may soon become necessary. Makes it easier to pay you, too. Consider it. I'll even help with the paperwork."
texts.zh: "你手上要是有份霸主委任状，事情会方便得多，而且恐怕很快非有不可。付你钱也名正言顺些。考虑一下。文书我可以帮你办。"

texts.en:
"Before I get ahead of myself," he says, "you should review the reports."

He taps an interface and your comms pings a file transfer.
texts.zh:
"我别把话扯太远，\"他说。\"你该先看看这些报告。"

他在界面上点了一下，你的通讯器响起文件传输的提示音。

texts.en:
You pull up the ANDRADA files. There are seven archives filled with timestamped data: Names, locations, status reports, receipts, medical analysis, surveillance.

The data has been processed and analyzed by an intelligence team, possibly over many cycles. You are able to rapidly glean essential details from the prepared summaries.

This archive is stored in your TriPad in a secure workspace and remains accessible through your mission intel entry.
texts.zh:
你调出 ANDRADA 文件。七个档案，塞满了带时间戳的数据：姓名、地点、状态报告、收据、医学分析、监视记录。

这些数据已经过一个情报小组的处理与分析，也许花了许多个星历年。你得以从整理好的摘要里迅速拣出要点。

这份档案存放在你 TriPad 上的加密工作区里，仍可从任务情报条目中访问。

texts.en: You now have a list of places of interest, mostly small planets, a couple minor asteroids, and the Galatia Academy station. All within the core worlds.
texts.zh: 你手上现在有了一份地点清单：多数是小型行星，另有一两处小行星，还有 Galatia 学院空间站 —— 全都在核心世界之内。
