texts.en:
Perseus "Saturnian".

Nomios, Arcadia system. Medical reports green. Biochemistry reports. Electrostim muscular and neurological development regimen, equipment and technician fees.

Cheerful progress reports; costly procurement receipt - inventory referred to by codewords. Doctor Cydonia "proceeding with operation". Updates suddenly cease at $sd7s_cydoniaDate.

Alarmed finger-pointing reports. Cydonia gone dark, then reported present at Kanta's Den. Case referred to the Ministry of Internal Security, something called EXCISION-RED.
texts.zh:
Perseus，代号 "Saturnian"。

Nomios，Arcadia 星系。医学报告全部正常。生化检测报告。电刺激肌肉与神经发育方案，设备与技术员费用。

进度报告笔调轻快；昂贵的采购收据 —— 清单上的物件只用代号指称。Cydonia 医生【手术进行中】。所有更新在 $sd7s_cydoniaDate 骤然中断。

随后是惊慌的相互推责报告。Cydonia 失联，之后有报告称其出现在 Kanta's Den。案子转交内部安全部，落到一个叫 EXCISION-RED 的名目下。

Anonymous donation to Nova Maxios orphanage, records altered. Excellent creche scores. Conflict with peers. Multiple MuniSec reports as adolescent.

Accepted to Galatia Academy with full scholarship under Gens Kato-sponsored charity program. Excellent induction-cycle scores.

Conflicting reports regarding necessity of bribery action due to subject's academic achievement. Observation team key agent failed check-in. Concerns about credits allocated to action NARRA-AULD missing. Case forwarded to Ministry of Internal Security, EXCISION-RED, new personnel requested.

Culann. Fees paid to Tri-Tachyon "Cybescence Betterment" charity school; focus on early-age cybernetic interfacing (non-intrusive). Peer altercations, fines charged sponsoring front corporation. Budget allocation under action DALGAN-SIG. Fees paid for social-stability counselling.

Tri-Tachyon Customer Awareness (access via DALGAN-SIG) reports subject purchased unlicensed transport to Qaras, Yma system.

Culann。学费付给速子科技旗下的 "Cybescence Betterment" 慈善学校；主攻幼龄期义体接驳 (非侵入式)。与同龄人发生冲突，罚款记在出面赞助的空壳公司账上。预算列在行动 DALGAN-SIG 项下。另有社会稳定性辅导的费用支出。

Contract with Neurozenith Cybernetic Solutions Group (NCSG) for an extended program, anonymous package. Additional contracts with numbered fronts registered in various polities. Manifests imply regular site resupply. Accounting suggests unusually high cost.

与 Neurozenith Cybernetic Solutions Group (NCSG) 签订长期项目合同，以匿名形式打包。另有若干合同，对方是注册在各政体下的编号空壳。货运清单显示该处有定期补给。账目也显示费用高得不寻常。

采购两名承包商提供专门服务，以代号 CRASIS、AUREOLIN 指称，合约十个星历年。两次续约费用已预先付清。

"I don't have a reputation for being stickler for regulations, but I need you to hold a Hegemony commission before we have operational discussions concerning these matters."

He lets a hand drop on his desk.

texts.en:
"Find them," he says. "Didn't I say that already?"

"I don't think this is a pack of lies from Dolos Macario, not this time. But confirmation doesn't hurt. And I'd prefer it if someone with a little more subtlety than the Hegemony's usual 'finest' poking around in," he picks up the datapad and gives it a distasteful look, "this list of backwaters."
texts.zh:
"找出他们，\"他说，\"我不是已经说过了？"

"我不觉得这是 Dolos Macario 编的一整套谎话，这次不像。不过确认一下也没有坏处。而且我更希望派个比霸主一贯的'精锐'稍微懂点分寸的人去查，\"他拿起数据板，嫌恶地看了一眼，\"去查这一串穷乡僻壤。"

texts.en: He considers for a moment, then says "I believe we've discussed everything. For now."
texts.zh: 他沉吟片刻，然后说："我想该谈的都谈过了。就目前而言。"

texts.en:
"You've done good work for the Hegemony," he says, and taps at his datapad. "For your trouble."

"And you're going to see a lot more trouble before this is over, $TitleHeg $PlayerLastName. Watch your back."
texts.zh:
"你为霸主干得不错，\"他说着，在数据平板上敲了几下。\"这是给你的酬劳。"

"而在这件事了结之前，你还会碰上更多麻烦，$TitleHeg $PlayerLastName。多留个心眼。"

texts.en:
"You've served the Hegemony," he says, and taps the datapad. "For your trouble."

"You're going to see a lot more trouble before this is over, $TitleHeg $PlayerLastName. Watch your back."
texts.zh:
"你为霸主效过力，\"他说着，敲了敲数据平板。\"这是给你的酬劳。"

"在这件事了结之前，你还会碰上更多麻烦，$TitleHeg $PlayerLastName。多留个心眼。"

texts.en:
"Ragnar Complex," he corrects you. "I'm not posted here to enjoy myself, captain."

"This place," he gestures toward his surroundings, "has certain advantages. Foremost being that none of my former contingent from the Eventide class are particularly interested in taking this dishonorable post, nor are they asking to be invited for an official inspection of a fleet of mildly radioactive hulks."

He stares off into what you assume is a bulkhead, for a moment. Considering his alternatives, perhaps.

"Enough about me," he says finally.
texts.zh:
"是 Ragnar 综合设施，\"他纠正你，\"我被派到这儿可不是来享乐的，舰长。"

"这地方，\"他朝四周示意，\"有它的好处。最主要的是，我原先带的、从 Eventide 那个阶层出身的那批人，没谁特别想接这个不光彩的差事，也没谁主动要求被请来对一支轻度放射性的废船舰队做正式视察。"

他朝某个方向望了一会儿 —— 你猜那是一道舱壁。也许是在掂量自己还有别的什么出路。

"不说我了，"他最后说。

texts.en:
You explain about the automated defenses and the personalized, pre-recorded messages. Your name could have been subbed into his speeches by an algorithm, but you suspect this was meant for you.

Rao nods, listening.

"Think he's Macario's pick?"
texts.zh:
你讲了那些自动防御系统，以及那些针对个人预先录好的讯息。你的名字也许只是被算法替换进了他的演讲，但你怀疑那本是说给你听的。

Rao 点着头，听你说完。

"你觉得他是 Macario 选中的人？"

options.en: Probably. Hector seems to believe everything Macario told him.
options.zh: 多半是。Macario 说的每一句，Hector 似乎都信。

options.en: I'm not sure. Hector talks like a true believer in Andradism.
options.zh: 我不确定。Hector 说话的样子，像是个真心信仰 Andrada 主义的信徒。

options.en: I don't think so. Hector seems sheltered. How could he lead an empire?

texts.en: "Just imagine," he says, then shakes his head.
texts.zh: "想想那会成什么样。"他说着，摇了摇头。

texts.en:
"If Macario had direct control over every aspect of his upbringing, and ensured that everything he knows is what Macario wishes for him to know... and never more than Macario himself."

Rao returns his speculative look to meet yours.

"This is good. We'll work with it."
texts.zh:
"如果 Macario 直接控制了他成长的每一个方面，确保他所知的一切都是 Macario 希望他知道的...而且绝不超过 Macario 本人所知的范围。"

Rao 收回审视的目光，与你对上视线。

"这很好。我们就按这个来做。"

options.en: How is this good?

texts.en:
"Put some kid raised in an asteroid eating nothing but Andradaism in charge of an empire?"

He smiles. Like someone who's seen their opponent's force disposition - and has a plan.

"Good work, $titleHeg."
texts.zh:
"让一个在小行星上长大、从小只吃 Andrada 主义那一套的孩子去掌管一个帝国？"

他笑了。像是已经看清了对手的兵力部署 —— 而且心里有了主意。

"干得好，$titleHeg。"

texts.en: "Would that not serve?" His tone is rhetorical.
texts.zh: "那样岂不更好？"他的语气是反问。

texts.en: "With the help of Dolos Macario, I expect," he says.
texts.zh: "我猜，是在 Dolos Macario 的扶助之下。"他说。

texts.en:
Rao grunts acknowledgement.

"From the sounds of it they've had that one in their pocket for a great many cycles. Fortuna Kato might have had Fleet Intel help at the start, might have not... It's not the worst case we anticipated, but it's close."

He idly squeezes one hand into a fist.

"Remember, $titleHeg, we don't want any Andrada on any throne. No Supreme Executor, no Sindrian Diktat. We are going to wipe the mutineer from history."
texts.zh:
Rao 哼了一声，表示知道了。

"听这情形，他们把那东西攥在手里已经很多个星历年了。Fortuna Kato 一开始也许得到过舰队情报部的协助，也许没有...这还不是我们预料中最糟的情况，但也差不远了。"

他随手攥紧一只拳头。

"记住，$titleHeg，我们不要任何 Andrada 坐上任何王座。不要最高元首，也不要辛达强权。我们要把这个叛徒从历史里抹掉。"

texts.en:
"Could be the right hand doesn't know what the left is hiding."

Rao rubs his chin.

"At least he's off the board. Probably wasn't leadership material anyway."

"At least he's off the board."

"At least the kid is off the board. Probably wasn't leadership material anyway."

He glances at his datapad.

"I'd prefer that you hadn't. He is," his look shifts to you for a moment, "or was, useful."

texts.en:
"Find them," he says.

"I don't think this is the usual pack of lies from Dolos Macario. Not this time. But we need confirmation, and I'd prefer it be done with more subtlety than the Hegemony's usual 'finest' poking around in," he picks up the datapad and gives it a distasteful look, "this list of backwaters."

He looks you over with a lingering look of disapproval.

"We should make sure you're prepared."
texts.zh:
"找到他们。"他说。

"我不认为这又是 Dolos Macario 那套惯常的谎话。这次不像。但我们需要确证，而且我希望办得比霸主那些惯常的【精锐】更讲究些，\"他拿起数据平板，厌恶地看了一眼，\"别让他们在这串穷乡僻壤里到处乱戳。"

他上下打量你，目光里留着久久不散的不满。

"我们得确保你准备妥当。"

texts.en:
Rao glances at his datapad, taps out some commands.

"My quartermaster will provide you with fuel and supplies. They're in a bay on Ragnar Complex I've assigned to you."

He puts the datapad down. "That's it. Find all those clones, sons, whatever they are."
texts.zh:
Rao 瞥了一眼数据平板，敲下几条指令。

"我的军需官会给你补给燃料和物资。东西放在 Ragnar 综合设施的一个泊位里，我划给你了。"

他放下数据平板。"就这样。把那些克隆体、儿子，随他们是什么，全都找出来。"

texts.en: He considers for a moment, then says "I believe we've discussed everything. For now."

他移开了目光。

"还有不少内容牵涉到...各氏族。我还有个会要赴，请恕我唐突。"

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，"他说着，伸手去按通讯切断键。

texts.en:
He looks away and clears his throat.

"And much which will concern Gens Yaribay, I suspect," he says pointedly. "I have... a meeting to attend, if you'll pardon my abruptness."

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," he says, then reaches for the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
他移开目光，清了清嗓子。

"而且据我揣测，还有不少内容会牵涉到 Yaribay 氏族，\"他意味深长地说。\"我还有个会要赴，请恕我唐突。"

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，"他说着，伸手去按通讯切断键。

texts.en:
He looks away.

"And much which concerns Gens Hannan - or shall I say, the Prime Demarchon. I have... a meeting to attend, if you'll pardon my abruptness."

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," he says, then reaches for the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
他移开了目光。

"还有不少内容牵涉到 Hannan 氏族 —— 或者我该说，牵涉到大统领。我还有个会要赴，请恕我唐突。"

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，"他说着，伸手去按通讯切断键。

texts.en:
You pull up the ANDRADA files. There are seven archives filled with timestamped data: Names, locations, status reports, receipts, medical analysis, surveillance.

The data has been processed and analyzed by an intelligence team, possibly over many cycles. You are able to rapidly glean essential details from the prepared summaries.

This archive is stored in your TriPad in a secure workspace and remains accessible through your mission intel entry.
texts.zh:
你调出 ANDRADA 文件。七个档案，塞满了带时间戳的数据：姓名、地点、状态报告、收据、医学分析、监视记录。

这些数据已经过一个情报小组的处理与分析，也许花了许多个星历年。你得以从整理好的摘要里迅速拣出要点。

这份档案存放在你 TriPad 上的加密工作区里，仍可从任务情报条目中访问。

texts.en: You now have a list of places of interest, mostly small planets, a couple minor asteroids, and the Galatia Academy station. All within the core worlds.
texts.zh: 你手上现在有了一份地点清单：多数是小型行星，另有一两处小行星，还有 Galatia 学院空间站 —— 全都在核心世界之内。

texts.en:
Perseus "Saturnian".

Nomios, Arcadia system. Medical reports green. Biochemistry reports. Electrostim muscular and neurological development regimen, equipment and technician fees.

Cheerful progress reports; costly procurement receipt - inventory referred to by codewords. Doctor Cydonia "proceeding with operation". Updates suddenly cease at $sd7s_cydoniaDate.

Alarmed finger-pointing reports. Cydonia gone dark, then reported present at Kanta's Den. Case referred to the Ministry of Internal Security, something called EXCISION-RED.
texts.zh:
Perseus，代号 "Saturnian"。

Nomios，Arcadia 星系。医学报告全部正常。生化检测报告。电刺激肌肉与神经发育方案，设备与技术员费用。

进度报告笔调轻快；昂贵的采购收据 —— 清单上的物件只用代号指称。Cydonia 医生【手术进行中】。所有更新在 $sd7s_cydoniaDate 骤然中断。

随后是惊慌的相互推责报告。Cydonia 失联，之后有报告称其出现在 Kanta's Den。案子转交内部安全部，落到一个叫 EXCISION-RED 的名目下。

texts.en:
Hercules "Cyrino"

Anonymous donation to Nova Maxios orphanage, records altered. Excellent creche scores. Conflict with peers. Multiple MuniSec reports as adolescent.

Accepted to Galatia Academy with full scholarship under Gens Kato-sponsored charity program. Excellent induction-cycle scores.

Conflicting reports regarding necessity of bribery action due to subject's academic achievement. Observation team key agent failed check-in. Concerns about credits allocated to action NARRA-AULD missing. Case forwarded to Ministry of Internal Security, EXCISION-RED, new personnel requested.

Applied and accepted to Post-Collapse History department. Department committee approval of assistant academician status.
texts.zh:
Hercules，代号 "Cyrino"。

向 Nova Maxios 孤儿院的匿名捐款，记录经过涂改。育幼院考评优异。与同龄人屡有冲突。少年时期有多份 MuniSec 报告。

经 Kato 氏族赞助的慈善项目，以全额奖学金被 Galatia 学院录取。入学阶段考评优异。

因其学业成绩出众，是否仍需执行贿赂行动，各方报告相互矛盾。观察组关键特工未按时报到。行动 NARRA-AULD 名下的拨款下落不明，引起关注。案子转交内部安全部，EXCISION-RED，已申请新人手。

申请并获准进入大崩塌后历史系。系委员会已批准其助理院士身份。

Jason "Korin"

Culann. Fees paid to Tri-Tachyon "Cybescence Betterment" charity school; focus on early-age cybernetic interfacing (non-intrusive). Peer altercations, fines charged sponsoring front corporation. Budget allocation under action DALGAN-SIG. Fees paid for social-stability counselling.

Psych report update, subject: anti-company outbursts. Unauthorized absence from Cybescence Betterment. MuniSec records of vandalism, theft. Front corporation allocated additional credits under DALGAN-SIG to suppress records. Tri-Tachyon Customer Awareness (access via DALGAN-SIG) reports subject purchased unlicensed transport to Qaras, Yma system.

Observation team re-assigned. Subject associated with ANTI-associated agents, Kanta gang connections. Permission to extract subject awaiting confirmation.
texts.zh:
Jason，代号 "Korin"。

Culann。学费付给速子科技旗下的 "Cybescence Betterment" 慈善学校；主攻幼龄期义体接驳 (非侵入式)。与同龄人发生冲突，罚款记在出面赞助的空壳公司账上。预算列在行动 DALGAN-SIG 项下。另有社会稳定性辅导的费用支出。

心理报告更新，事由：屡次发表反公司言论。未经许可离开 Cybescence Betterment。MuniSec 有故意毁坏与盗窃的记录。空壳公司在 DALGAN-SIG 项下追加拨款，用以压下记录。速子科技客户关注部门 (经 DALGAN-SIG 取得权限) 报告：对象购得一趟无照运输，前往 Yma 星系的 Qaras。

观察组已改派。对象与反公司势力的代理人往来，并与 Kanta 的帮派有联系。提取对象的许可仍在等待批准。

Record of property purchase from numbered holding incorporate, Hybrasil system. Orbital coordinates attached, missing schematics; registry name 58966 Elysium.

Supply, staff procurement through TT subsidiaries. Medical report green. List of private tutors, CVs attached, assigned to ELYSIUM. Receipts of payment; shortest term one shift, longest one and a half cycles.

Accounting for period contains fees for medical evac (cryo-stabilized), multiple instances. Details redacted. Psych assessment missing from file.
texts.zh:
Hector，代号 "Palatin"。

有资产购入记录，卖方为 Hybrasil 星系一家以编号注册的控股公司。附有轨道坐标，图纸缺失；登记名为 58966 Elysium。

补给与人员招募均经速子科技下属公司办理。医学报告全部正常。附私人教师名单与简历，皆派驻 ELYSIUM。付款收据齐备；聘期最短的只有一个轮班，最长的一个半星历年。

该期间的账目中含有医疗后送费用 (低温稳定处理)，且不止一次。细目已删节。心理评估报告不在卷内。

Achilles "Kalian".

Early body of data is tagged planet Madeira. Creche committee bribed, exowomb records altered. Parents: naval logistics/senior AM tech.

Exceptional creche scores despite conflict with peers. Medical reports green. Fleet Cadets program, commendation. Bribe to naval committee (action codename PORPHYRA). Application to Kazeron Academy. Graduation with full honors.

Offered piracy patrol, unexpectedly rescinded. Re-assigned to Yesod, Zagan system, awaiting assignment. Observation program disrupted by PL Fleet Intelligence; intel insufficient, request additional detail. Yesod MuniSec reports involvement in altercation, spacer bar; news suppressed by Fleet Intelligence.
texts.zh:
Achilles，代号 "Kalian"。

早期数据一律标在 Madeira 行星名下。育幼委员会被买通，体外子宫记录经过涂改。父母：一方在海军后勤，一方是资深反物质技师。

育幼院考评极优，尽管与同龄人屡有冲突。医学报告全部正常。舰队候补军官计划，获嘉奖。向海军委员会行贿 (行动代号 PORPHYRA)。申请 Kazeron 学院。以最高荣誉毕业。

已获派剿盗巡逻任务，却意外被撤销。改派至 Zagan 星系的 Yesod，等待分配。观察计划被英仙座联盟舰队情报部打乱；情报不足，请求补充细节。Yesod 的 MuniSec 报告其卷入一场斗殴，地点是太空船员酒吧；消息已被舰队情报部压下。

Leonidas "Esculus"

Cethlan commerce court: purchase of cometary body in Duzakh system, price reduced due to dispute over recognition of exploitation rights.

Project codename IRKALLA, refurbishment contract: NDAs, list of tech specs, unusual bio-support equipment, re-orbit to L4-point of Duzahk fringe jump-point.

Contract with Neurozenith Cybernetic Solutions Group (NCSG) for an extended program, anonymous package. Additional contracts with numbered fronts registered in various polities. Manifests imply regular site resupply. Accounting suggests unusually high cost.

Procurement of two contractors, specialized services, referred to by codenames CRASIS, AUREOLIN for 10-cycle period. Two term extensions paid upfront.
texts.zh:
Leonidas，代号 "Esculus"。

Cethlan 商事法庭：购入 Duzakh 星系内一具彗星体，因开采权认定存在争议，成交价被压低。

项目代号 IRKALLA，改造合同：保密协议、技术规格清单、非常规生命维持设备、重新入轨至 Duzahk 边缘跳跃点的 L4 点。

与 Neurozenith Cybernetic Solutions Group (NCSG) 签订长期项目合同，以匿名形式打包。另有若干合同，对方是注册在各政体下的编号空壳。货运清单显示该处有定期补给。账目也显示费用高得不寻常。

采购两名承包商提供专门服务，以代号 CRASIS、AUREOLIN 指称，合约十个星历年。两次续约费用已预先付清。

It opens.

Nothing. It's blank.

Then text appears, one character after another. As if they carried a sense of their own volition.

什么也没有。一片空白。

然后文字浮现出来，一个字符接一个字符。仿佛它们各有自己的意志。

texts.en:
One by one, the characters disappear. The note closes itself and disappears from your TriPad.

You take a deep breath waiting for what happens next.

Nothing.
texts.zh:
字符又一个一个地消失。那条便笺自行关闭，从你的 TriPad 上不见了。

你深吸一口气，等着看接下来会发生什么。

什么也没有。

texts.en:
Pericles "Aventine"

Records of ongoing payment to mercenary captain Maues Moroz based out of Orthrus, in the Samarra System. Medical reports green. Creche reports exceptional.

Eventide section, private academy: flight training, navigation, tactics, mathematics. Subject expelled for altercation with heir of REDACTED, a leading family of Eventide. Combat sim records good-to-exceptional.

Record of fleet operations, merc jobs in core worlds and near-fringe. Associated with incorporated body owned by 'Moroz' who holds lease on several warehouses, two private docks on Orthrus.
texts.zh:
Pericles，代号 "Aventine"。

有持续付款记录，收款人为盘踞在 Samarra 星系 Orthrus 的雇佣兵头目 Maeus Moroz。医学报告全部正常。育幼院考评极优。

Eventide 城区，私立学院：飞行训练、导航、战术、数学。对象因与【已删节】家族的继承人发生冲突而被开除 —— 那是 Eventide 的望族之一。战斗模拟记录从良好到极优。

有舰队作战记录，在核心世界与近边缘地带接过雇佣任务。与一家法人实体有关联，其所有者【Moroz】租用着 Orthrus 上的几处仓库和两个私人船坞。

I'm told you can help me crack some encrypted files.
options.zh: 我听说你能帮我破解一些加密文件。

texts.en:
"Is that so?" He looks upon you indulgently.

"I'm afraid I couldn't even begin to discuss matters of factional security with someone who is not a member of the Persean League, nor even bears a commission in its good name."

He folds his hands together.
texts.zh:
"是吗？"他宽和地看着你。

"恐怕我没法跟一个既不是英仙座联盟成员、也没有在联盟名下领过委任状的人，谈论任何涉及势力安全的事。"

他双手交叠在一起。

texts.en:
"Is that so?" He looks upon you indulgently.

"For me to begin an official investigation with FIS resources these files would have to contain information of great concern to the interfactional security interests of the Persean League."

You'd swear his half-smile has intensified somehow, despite looking exactly the same.
texts.zh:
"是吗？"他宽和地看着你。

"要我动用舰队情报部的资源启动正式调查，这些文件里就得装着关乎英仙座联盟势力间安全利益的重大情报。"

你几乎可以肯定他那半笑更浓了些，尽管看上去毫无变化。

options.en: They concern the Sindrian Diktat. Dolos Macario... misplaced them. (explain)
options.zh: 它们与辛达强权有关。Dolos Macario...把它们放丢了。 (解释)

texts.en:
You explain the situation; your recovery of the data, the file headers, the dates.

He blinks, not allowing any look of surprise to cross his face.
texts.zh:
你说明了情况：你如何找回这些数据、文件头、日期。

他眨了下眼，没让一丝惊讶浮上脸。

texts.en: "Interesting," he says after a moment. "The office of Horus Yaribay told me to expect you, of course. And if all of this is what it looks like, then I expect you've met my conditions."
texts.zh: "有意思，\"他停了片刻才说，\"当然，Horus Yaribay 的办公室知会过我，说你会来。如果这一切当真如表象所示，那我想你已经满足了我的条件。"

texts.en: "Interesting," he says after a moment. "The office of the Prime Demarchon told me to expect you, of course. And if all of this is what it looks like, then I expect you've met my conditions."
texts.zh: "有意思，\"他停了片刻才说，\"当然，大统领办公室知会过我，说你会来。如果这一切当真如表象所示，那我想你已经满足了我的条件。"

texts.en: "Interesting," he says after a moment. "If what you say is true, then I expect these files fulfill the conditions I've laid out."
texts.zh: "有意思，\"他停了片刻才说，\"如果你说的是真的，那我想这些文件已经满足了我提出的条件。"

texts.en:
He taps something, and an upload prompt appears in your comms interface.

"If you please."
texts.zh:
他点了下什么，你的通讯界面上弹出一个上传提示。

"请吧。"

options.en: The files are heavily encrypted. Do you have access to AI cores?
options.zh: 这些文件加密得很严。你能接触到 AI 核心吗？

options.en: If I provide these to you, I will require a decrypted copy.
options.zh: 如果我把这些交给你，我要一份解密后的副本。

options.en: And how does Fleet Intelligence view covert League support for the Sindrian Diktat?
options.zh: 那么舰队情报部怎么看联盟对辛达强权的暗中支持？

options.en: Upload the ANDRADA files to Siyavong
options.zh: 把 ANDRADA 文件上传给 Siyavong

texts.en:
Siyavong raises an eyebrow.

"I wouldn't worry about about that if I were you, captain."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 挑起一边眉毛。

"换作是我，就不会为这个操心，舰长。"

texts.en:
"You'll have it."

He puts his hands together. A pledge.

"It is the least we can do to ensure you don't imagine you would need to take a copy of these elsewhere, you see."
texts.zh:
"你会拿到的。"

他双手合拢。一个承诺。

"我们至少得做到这一步：让你不至于以为还得另找地方再复制一份，你明白吧。"

texts.en:
"An interesting question, captain," he says, pleasantly evasive.

"However it is not my place, nor that of Fleet Intelligence, to dictate policy. We serve by the direction given us by the League Council, headed by the Prime Demarchon, and in doing so fulfill our mission to protect the constituents of the Persean League from outside threats."

His half-smile is re-asserted.

"It would not be my place to openly contradict policy."
texts.zh:
"是个有意思的问题，舰长，"他说，语气讨喜地回避着。

"不过这既不是我的位置，也不是舰队情报部的位置，去决定政策。我们依照联盟议会 —— 由大统领领导 —— 给出的指示行事，以此完成我们的使命：保护英仙座联盟的成员不受外来威胁。"

他那半笑又回来了。

"公开顶撞政策，不是我的位置该做的事。"

options.en: If these files are what they appear to be, what do you want me to do?
options.zh: 如果这些文件当真如表象所示，你希望我怎么做？

options.en: If I seek to undermine the Sindrian Diktat, will you try to stop me?
options.zh: 如果我要拆辛达强权的台，你会设法拦我吗？

options.en: If I support the authority of the Sindrian Diktat, will you try to stop me?
options.zh: 如果我要支持辛达强权的权威，你会设法拦我吗？

texts.en: He considers this for a moment.
texts.zh: 他思量了片刻。

texts.en:
"Fleet Intelligence will be in contact if your cooperation is needed in light of... shifting outcome scenarios."

The half-smile reappears.

"We appreciate your patriotism in this matter, $titlePL."
texts.zh:
"如果...形势走向有变、需要你配合，舰队情报部会联系你。"

那半笑又浮上来。

"这件事上，我们很感念你的爱国之心，$titlePL。"

texts.en: Siyavong taps his chin, just twice, as he considers this.
texts.zh: Siyavong 用指节在颏上敲了两下，思量着。

texts.en: Siyavong taps his chin, just twice, as he considers this.
texts.zh: Siyavong 用指节在颏上敲了两下，思量着。

texts.en:
Siyavong nods acknowledgement, then taps away at his datapad for a minute.

Finally, he says "Hm." Then looks up at you. "This will take some time. Perhaps four days, $titlePL?"
texts.zh:
Siyavong 点头致意，然后在数据板上敲了足足一分钟。

最后他"嗯"了一声，抬头看你。"这得花些时间。大概四天吧，$titlePL？"

options.en: I'll return then, Special Agent.
options.zh: 那我到时候再来，特别探员。

options.en: Why four days?

"I'll see you soon," he says.

"You're always in the center of something interesting, aren't you."

With that, Siyavong reaches for the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:

"你总是站在有意思的事情正中央，不是吗。"

说完，Siyavong 伸手切断通讯。

texts.en:
"I'm afraid I couldn't even begin to discuss matters of factional security with someone who is not a member of the Persean League, nor even bears a commission in its good name."

He gives you a meaningful look, then folds his hands together.
texts.zh:
"恕我直言，凡不属英仙座联盟成员、也未以联盟之名领受委任的人，我连谈一谈势力安全事务的门都无从谈起。"

他意味深长地看了你一眼，双手交叠。

texts.en:
His knowing half-smile appears.

"What concerns you, $titlePL?"
texts.zh:
他那了然于心的半笑浮了上来。

"你关心的是什么，$titlePL？"

texts.en:

options.en: Yes?

texts.en:
"My organization... would like to ensure that you are able to investigate these files." He pauses, picking up a datapad. "As a free agent, naturally, under no particular orders from Fleet Intelligence."

"To those ends, I must inform you that we have discovered a storage bay - under your name - which contains supplies and fuel."

He sets the datapad down and puts his hands together, the very image of professionalism.
texts.zh:
"我所在的机构...希望确保你有条件去查清这些文件。\"他顿了顿，拿起一块数据板。\"当然是以自由行动者的身份，不受舰队情报部的任何具体指令。"

"为此，我必须告知你：我们发现了一个登记在你名下的储藏舱，里面备有补给与燃料。"

他放下数据板，双手交叠，一副十足的职业做派。

texts.en: "Before we continue," he says, "there's a small matter..."
texts.zh: "在继续之前，\"他说，\"还有一件小事..."

options.en: Yes?
You say there'll be war? With who?
options.zh: 你说会有一场战争？和谁打？

options.zh: 你暗示过，解密文件之后你见过 Horus Yaribay...

options.en: You implied that you met with Reynard Hannan after you decrypted the files...
options.zh: 你暗示过，解密文件之后你见过 Reynard Hannan...

options.zh: 我看过那些文件了。我该怎么做？

options.en: Achilles Andrada. Or 'Kalian'. It says he's a Persean League officer.
options.zh: Achilles Andrada。或者叫 'Kalian'。文件里说他是英仙座联盟的军官。

options.zh: 我相信有人 —— 某个势力 —— 正在暗杀 Andrada 的克隆体。

options.zh: 我们得谈谈 Achilles 和 Kato 氏族。

options.en: I found Hector. He seems to be under Macario's influence. (explain)
options.zh: 我找到 Hector 了。他好像正受 Macario 摆布。 (解释)

options.en: I found Hercules Andrada at the Galatia Academy.
options.zh: 我在 Galatia 学院找到了 Hercules Andrada。

options.en: Let's talk about something else.

texts.en:
"Hector and..." He pauses, and makes a small gesture with one hand.

"And whoever will stand against him. Askonia will suffer, again. One hopes it will not spread."
texts.zh:
"Hector 还有..."他顿了顿，一只手做了个不大的手势。

"还有所有会站出来对抗他的人。Askonia 又要遭难了。但愿这场祸事不会蔓延。"

options.en: Are you doing something to stop it?
options.zh: 你们在做些什么来阻止它吗？

options.en: Can it be stopped?
If there's a war, I intend to win it.
options.zh: 若真有战争，我要赢下它。

texts.en:
His half-smile dims.

"At this point I believe that stopping it is beyond the range of scenarios we shall see play out. But trust that all my efforts shall be to the security and safety of the Persean League - and, indeed, the entire Sector."

"Whether you believe that," his expression is ironic, "depends on many things, of course. But I must content myself with saying so."
texts.zh:
他的半笑淡了下去。

"到了这一步，我认为阻止它已不在我们所能看到的那些可能之内。但请相信，我所做的一切都是为了英仙座联盟的安全 —— 也是为了整个星域。"

"你信不信这话，\"他神情带着讥诮，\"自然取决于许多东西。但我只能把话说到这里。"

texts.en:
Siyavong raises an eyebrow, his amused half-smile firmly in place.

"A spirited assertion, but that may not be up to you. War is a sort of negotiation, $titlePL, and direct force is but one aspect."

He gives you an indulgent look. "But you don't need me to tell you that. You are successful and... potent."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 挑了挑眉，那副带着玩味的半笑稳稳挂着。

"说得有气势，可这恐怕不由你说了算。战争是一种谈判，$titlePL，直接动武只是其中一个方面。"

他宽容地看了你一眼。"不过这话不必我来告诉你。你的事业有成，而且...手段了得。"

texts.en:
"I implied no such thing, $titlePL."

The angle of his head adjusts ever so slightly.

"I would not wish to bias an objective accounting of the facts of the matter with any implication that I was coordinating with one of the Gens to reveal intelligence in a manner which might favor one or another special interest. I serve the Persean League."
texts.zh:
"我并没有暗示过什么，$titlePL。"

他脑袋偏着的角度稍稍调整了一点。

"我不愿让任何暗示干扰对事实的客观陈述 —— 仿佛我在与某个氏族协同，以某种可能偏袒某一方特殊利益的方式泄露情报。我为英仙座联盟效力。"

options.en: I see. Glad to hear it.
options.zh: 明白了。听你这么说我就放心了。

texts.en: He raises an eyebrow fractionally.
texts.zh: 他微微挑起一侧眉毛。

texts.en:
"I implied no such thing, $titlePL."

The angle of his head adjusts ever so slightly.

"I would not wish to bias an objective accounting of the facts of the matter with any implication that I was coordinating with one of the Gens to reveal intelligence in a manner which might favor one or another special interest. I serve the Persean League - and the Prime Demarchon is the foremost executive servant of the League, and it is to him I report concerning certain... critical matters."

"It is my duty," he concludes, somewhat crisply.
texts.zh:
"我并没有暗示过什么，$titlePL。"

他脑袋偏着的角度稍稍调整了一点。

"我不愿让任何暗示干扰对事实的客观陈述 —— 仿佛我在与某个氏族协同，以某种可能偏袒某一方特殊利益的方式泄露情报。我为英仙座联盟效力 —— 而大统领是联盟最高层的行政长官，某些...关键事务，我正是向他汇报。"

"这是我的职责，"他收尾时语气颇为干脆。

options.en: I see. Glad to hear it.
options.zh: 明白了。听你这么说我就放心了。

texts.en:
"Officially," he says, "I shall make no recommendation regarding your involvement into the alleged contents of these files in accordance with present Persean League policy of non-intervention in matters regarding... certain trade partners, as guided by our executive leadership."

He puts his hands together, clearing his throat, and pauses for a moment. Then looks up at you.
texts.zh:
"就官方而言，\"他说，\"对你是否介入这些文件所称的内容，我不作任何建议。按英仙座联盟现行政策，凡涉及...某些贸易伙伴之事，一律不予干预 —— 此为我们的行政领导层所定。"

他双手交叠，清了清嗓子，停了一停，然后抬眼看你。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"You have made a career of taking independent initiative. With provocative results. I will follow your actions with great interest and assist in defending the stability and security of the Persean League now and in the future."

The holo flickers for a moment, but you'd swear he winked.
texts.zh:
"你这一路走来，靠的就是自行其是。结果也足够惹眼。我会密切关注你的行动，并为捍卫英仙座联盟眼下与将来的稳定和安全提供协助。"

全息影像闪了一下，但你敢发誓，他眨了下眼。

options.en: I think I understand.

texts.en:
"That is alleged."

Siyavong's expression tightens.
texts.zh:
"那只是指控。"

Siyavong 的神情绷紧了。

options.en: It says you - your organization - knows about him. And intervened.
options.zh: 文件里说，你 —— 你的机构 —— 知道他的事，而且插了手。

texts.en:
"How interesting," he says as if he isn't interested at all.

"I will only comment that, in general terms, it is my duty to protect citizens of the Persean League." A pause. "Whatever their alleged genetic source."
texts.zh:
"有意思，"他说这话时仿佛一点也不觉得有意思。

"我只说一点，泛泛而论：保护英仙座联盟的公民是我的职责。\"一顿。\"无论他们所称的基因来源是什么。"

options.en: I'm going to find him and speak with him.
So he's safe?
I'll ask no more about him. For now.
options.zh: 关于他的事我不再多问。至少现在不问。

texts.en: "I will not stand in the way of the free association of citizens of the Persean League," he says.
texts.zh: "我不会妨碍英仙座联盟公民之间的自由交往，"他说。

texts.en: Saying nothing, he nods very slowly.
texts.zh: 他什么也没说，只是极缓地点了点头。

texts.en: "Good."
texts.zh: "很好。"

texts.en:
"I suspect you are correct, captain," Siyavong says. He is not overtly worried about the notion, by all appearances.

"And even if we did not see evidence, it is the first reaction I would anticipate from... many interested parties."
texts.zh:
"我猜你说得对，舰长，"Siyavong 说。从表面上看，他并不为这个念头担忧。

"就算我们看不到证据，这也是我能想到的...许多有关各方的第一反应。"

texts.en: "If that satisfaction might quell your insistence, then I suppose we must," he says, looking unimpressed.
texts.zh: "如果这点满足能让你不再坚持，那我想我们也只能如此，"他说，看起来并不买账。

texts.en:
He coughs, falsely. "Now this was an illuminating aside," Siyavong says with a distinct undercurrent of annoyance.

"Let's move toward a less gruesome topic, shall we?"
texts.zh:
他假咳了一声。"这一岔话倒真是让人长了见识，"Siyavong 说，底下明显压着一层恼意。

"我们换个不那么血腥的话题，好吗？"

options.en: Do you know who is doing it?
Do you want me to confront Admiral Rao?
options.zh: 你要我去当面质问 Rao 上将？

options.en: Is League Fleet Intelligence targeting Andradas?
options.zh: 是联盟舰队情报部在针对 Andrada 家的人？

options.en: Would you like me to take out the Andradas?
options.zh: 要不要我把 Andrada 家的人一个个除掉？

options.en: Let's talk about something else.

texts.en:
"Specifically? In some cases. There are many assassins and mere murderers-for-hire in the Persean Sector."

"Who sees that they are paid, and by whom, and who allows it? Those are more difficult questions with more complex answers."

He raises a palm at you.

"Allow me to draw a hypothetical."
texts.zh:
"具体而言？有些是。英仙座星域里从来不缺刺客，也不缺只图钱的杀手。"

"谁负责付钱、付给谁、谁又默许这一切？这些问题更难，答案也更复杂。"

他朝你抬起一只手。

"让我假设一种情形。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"The Hegemony considers the Sindrian Diktat as fundamentally criminal in the highest degree - Philip Andrada is mutiny embodied. Agents of the Hegemony - and those who gives orders to said agents, say one Orcus Rao who is busier by far than an admiral assigned to a holding-before-retirement posting ought to be - will seek to undermine Andradism by any means available."

"Ideally they'd put Andrada on trial, have a full show of 'legitimacy' of the laws of the Human Domain and so forth."

"Not so easily arranged, as you may imagine. And now Andrada has produced clones to inherit his mutinous polity?" Siyavong shakes his head in mock-sympathy. "A clone is not guilty of the father's crimes. And yet..."
texts.zh:
"在霸主看来，辛达强权从根子上就是最高等级的犯罪 —— Philip Andrada 本身就是叛乱的化身。霸主的特工，以及给这些特工下命令的人 —— 比如那位 Orcus Rao，他忙得远超过一个被安排到退休前闲置职位上的上将该有的程度 —— 会想尽一切手段挖空 Andrada 主义。"

"最理想的做法是把 Andrada 送上法庭，把人之领律法的【合法性】好好演上一场，诸如此类。"

"当然，这事没那么容易办成，你大概也想得到。况且如今 Andrada 还造出了克隆体，要继承他那个叛逆的政体？\"Siyavong 装出一副同情的样子摇了摇头。\"克隆体并没有犯下父亲的罪。可话又说回来..."

options.en: You're suggesting that Orcus Rao has ordered illegal assassinations?
options.zh: 你是在说 Orcus Rao 下令进行非法暗杀？

texts.en:
"Clearly he has," Siyavong says, matter-of-fact, "ever."

"Of our Andrada clones, however? I could not provide you with hard evidence of it."

"Could he? Would he? Yes and yes. Did he?"

His knowing smile reforms.
texts.zh:
"显然有，\"Siyavong 说，语气平淡，\"从来都有。"

"不过说到我们这些 Andrada 克隆体？我拿不出确凿的证据。"

"他做得到吗？他会做吗？两个问题的答案都是肯定的。那他做了吗？"

他那副心知肚明的笑容又挂了起来。

texts.en:
His brow furrows.

"Would you not, please? It is... unnecessary."
texts.zh:
他皱起眉头。

"能不能请你别去？这...没有必要。"

options.en: I understand.
If you insist, then I won't confront Orcus Rao. (lie)
options.zh: 既然你坚持，那我就不去质问 Orcus Rao 了。 (说谎)

texts.en: He gives you a look meant to hide a vast skepticism.
texts.zh: 他看了你一眼，那眼神是要掩住满腹的怀疑。

texts.en: He gives you a concerned look.
texts.zh: 他有些担忧地看了你一眼。

texts.en:
"Fleet Intelligence? No."

He gives you a warning look.

"And it would be impolitic for me to participate in speculation about certain other parties within the Persean League. Whatever you may choose to believe, I am bound by certain legal strictures as concerns citizens of the Persean League."
texts.zh:
"舰队情报部？不是。"

他给了你一个警告的眼神。

"再者，参与对英仙座联盟内某些其他势力的揣测，对我而言并不明智。不管你愿意相信什么，凡涉及英仙座联盟公民，我都要受某些法律条文的约束。"

options.en: But the Gens are not?

texts.en:
He drops his hint of a smile.

"I said no such thing and I would thank you not to share irresponsible 'deductions' of this sort."

"Perhaps another topic interests you, captain?"
texts.zh:
他连那点笑意也收了起来。

"我没说过这种话。这类不负责任的【推断】，还请你别到处去讲。"

"也许你更想聊点别的，舰长？"

texts.en:
"No, thank you," he says, uncomfortably. "I don't believe that would be helpful at this juncture."

He produces a strained smile.

"It was thoughtful of you to ask before... anything."
texts.zh:
"不了，谢谢，\"他说，有些不自在。\"我不认为在目前这个节骨眼上，那样做会有什么好处。"

他挤出一个勉强的笑。

"你能在做任何事之前先来问一声... 想得很周到。"

texts.en: "Please," he says.
texts.zh: "拜托了，"他说。

texts.en:
"We don't," Siyavong says. "The word you'll find for the situation is 'fraught' due, as per our previous conversation, various factors."

He gives you a cool look.

"Have patience."
texts.zh:
"我们不知道，\"Siyavong 说。\"你会用来形容这局面的词是【棘手】—— 原因嘛，如我们上次所谈，种种因素叠加。"

他冷冷地看了你一眼。

"耐心些。"

options.en: Patience for what?
For Achilles to make his move?

texts.en:
"You'll know."

He re-asserts his half-smile, though it feels more strained than before.
texts.zh:
"到时候你就知道。"

他重新摆出那副半笑，可比先前更勉强了。

texts.en:
He says nothing.

Then re-asserts his half-smile, though it feels more strained than before.
texts.zh:
他什么也没说。

然后重新摆出那副半笑，可比先前更勉强了。

texts.en:
You elaborate about the palatial asteroid, Hector's words, and the trap he left for you.

"So Hector is his pick." He nods to himself. "And how long has it been so, I wonder, with all the recent... stirrings."

He puts his hands together, polite and collected. "I do not imagine Macario's influence has improved Hector's character. There'll be a war before this is over, that much is clear."
texts.zh:
你把那座宫殿般的岩质小行星、Hector 的话，还有他给你设下的那个圈套，都讲了一遍。

"所以 Hector 才是他的选择。\"他自顾自地点了点头。\"我倒想知道，最近这些...骚动之下，这种局面已经持续多久了。"

他把双手叠在一起，礼貌而镇定。"我不觉得 Macario 的插手会让 Hector 的品性变好。这事了结之前必有一战，这一点很清楚。"

texts.en:
"We know about this," he says. "Perhaps more than you."

"You understand there was an attack? Several assassins. Armed."
texts.zh:
"这件事我们清楚，\"他说。\"也许比你知道得还多。"

"你该明白，那是一次袭击。好几名刺客，全副武装。"

texts.en:
"We know about this," he says.

"It could have gone rather worse, don't you think? Poor timing, nonetheless."
texts.zh:
"这件事我们清楚，"他说。

"本来可能会糟得多，你不觉得吗？话虽如此，这时机实在不巧。"

texts.en:
"We know," he says. "It could not have gone much worse, I would say. Very poor timing on your part."

Siyavong watches you.

"At least you survived the attack."
texts.zh:
"我们知道，\"他说。\"依我看，事情糟得不能再糟了。你挑的时机实在不巧。"

Siyavong 看着你。

"至少你在那场袭击里活了下来。"

options.en: Um. Is he alright?
At least that.
Are you implying I was involved?
options.zh: 你是在暗示这事跟我有关？

options.en: That's one less Andrada clone to menace the Sector.
options.zh: 星域里少了一个祸害人的 Andrada 克隆体。

texts.en:
He says nothing for a couple seconds. Then looks away.

"No. He is not." His eyes meet yours. "The details are considered classified. But you may assume that he is not relevant to the crisis growing in Askonia."
texts.zh:
他沉默了几秒，然后把目光移开。

"不。他不好。\"他直视你的眼睛。\"细节属于机密。不过你可以认为，他已与 Askonia 日益扩大的危机无关了。"

texts.en:
"Indeed. I won't say that the chief of security was especially forthcoming, particularly in light of the heavy Hegemony intelligence presence in and around the Galatia Academy. But Provost Baird appreciates that some interfactional cooperation is required to maintain the Galatia Academy's ostensibly neutral status despite distressing events of this nature."

He puts his hands together neatly.
texts.zh:
"的确。我不能说安全主管把话说得格外坦率，尤其考虑到 Galatia 学院内外都有霸主情报部门的重兵在场。但 Baird 院长明白，尽管出了这样令人不安的事，要维持 Galatia 学院表面上中立的名分，势力之间总得有些合作。"

他把双手规规矩矩地叠在一起。

texts.en:
"More than that, $playerSirOrMadam. Because of course you were involved - you were right beside Hercules as he was killed."

Then he lets it go.

"But no, we understand the situation. I won't say that the chief of security was especially forthcoming, particularly in light of the heavy Hegemony intelligence presence in and around the Galatia Academy. But Provost Baird appreciates that some interfactional cooperation is required to maintain the Galatia Academy's ostensibly neutral status despite distressing events of this nature."

He puts his hands together neatly.
texts.zh:
"不止如此，$playerSirOrMadam。因为你当然牵涉其中 —— Hercules 被杀的时候，你就在他旁边。"

然后他松了口。

"不过算了，我们了解情况。我不能说安全主管把话说得格外坦率，尤其考虑到 Galatia 学院内外都有霸主情报部门的重兵在场。但 Baird 院长明白，尽管出了这样令人不安的事，要维持 Galatia 学院表面上中立的名分，势力之间总得有些合作。"

他把双手规规矩矩地叠在一起。

texts.en:
"That is one way of looking at it," he says with frictionless self-control. "I was relieved, of course, to hear you were entirely unharmed."

"I won't say that the chief of security was especially forthcoming about the details of the situation, particularly given the Hegemony intelligence presence in and around the Galatia Academy..."

He puts his hands together neatly. "In any case, Provost Baird appreciates that interfactional cooperation is required to maintain the Galatia Academy's ostensibly neutral status despite distressing events of this nature."
texts.zh:
"也可以这么说，\"他说，克制得滴水不漏。\"听说你毫发无伤，我当然松了口气。"

"我不能说安全主管把事情的细节讲得格外坦率，尤其考虑到 Galatia 学院内外都有霸主情报部门的人在场..."

他把双手规规矩矩地叠在一起。"无论如何，Baird 院长明白，尽管出了这样令人不安的事，要维持 Galatia 学院表面上中立的名分，势力之间总得有些合作。"

options.en: I told him to trust Provost Baird.
options.zh: 我让他去信 Baird 院长。

options.en: I let Provost Baird take care of him.
options.zh: 我把他交给 Baird 院长照看。

options.en: I told Hercules the Persean League would protect him. Did he contact you?
options.zh: 我告诉 Hercules，英仙座联盟会保护他。他联系过你们吗？

options.en: I told him to talk to the hacker, Gargoyle, to help him escape.
options.zh: 我让他去找那个黑客 Gargoyle，想办法脱身。

options.en: I offered him asylum on my own colony.
options.zh: 我提出可以让他在我自己的殖民地上避难。

options.en: I gave him credits to help him escape.
options.zh: 我给了他一笔星币，帮他逃走。

options.en: Well. Hope he's doing okay...

texts.en:
Siyavong does something halfway between taking a deep breath and a sigh.

"Interesting," he says after a moment.
texts.zh:
Siyavong 做了个介于深吸气与叹气之间的动作。

"有意思，"他过了一会才说。

options.en: Why is that interesting?

texts.en: "I don't know, captain," he says with exacting neutrality. "I'm sure we'll find out before long. Perhaps."
texts.zh: "我不知道，舰长，\"他说，语气中立得一丝不苟。\"我想不用多久就会知道了。也许吧。"

texts.en:
Siyavong's half-smile fades somewhat.

"No. He's disappeared."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 脸上那点半笑淡了下去。

"不。他不见了。"

options.en: Disappeared as in dead, or...

texts.en: He looks at you for a long moment. You can see the wrinkles at the corners of his eyes.
texts.zh: 他久久地看着你。你能看见他眼角的皱纹。

texts.en: "I couldn't say."
texts.zh: "我说不好。"

texts.en:
Something small breaks. Finlay's smile drops.

"Hercules is dead, captain. Targeted killing. He made it as far as Ancyra. Same organization as the first attempt - behind the proverbial trigger, that is. The identity of the client is less certain."
texts.zh:
某样很小的东西碎了。Finlay 的笑容落了下去。

"Hercules 死了，舰长。是定点清除。他一路逃到了 Ancyra。还是同一个组织，和第一次动手的那批人一样 —— 扣下扳机的那些。至于委托人是谁，就不那么确定了。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
He rubs one of his eyes.

"I liked him. Hercules. He seemed like a thoughtful young man."
texts.zh:
他揉了揉一只眼睛。

"我挺喜欢他。Hercules。看着像个有想法的年轻人。"

options.en: Why are you telling me this?
He was an Andrada.
I liked him too.

texts.en:
Siyavong taps something on his console, then adjusts his posture, sitting up straight, putting his hands in front of him.

"I don't believe I said anything. Now, where we were?"
texts.zh:
Siyavong 在控制台上点了点什么，然后调整坐姿，坐直身子，把双手放到身前。

"我想我什么也没说过。那么，我们刚才说到哪儿了？"

texts.en:
"Indeed."

Siyavong adjusts his posture, sitting up straight, putting his hands in front of him.

"Where were we?"
texts.zh:
"的确。"

Siyavong 调整坐姿，坐直身子，把双手放到身前。

"我们刚才说到哪儿了？"

texts.en:
He nods, looking down.

"So. Where were we."
texts.zh:
他点了点头，垂着眼。

"那么。我们刚才说到哪儿了。"

texts.en:
Siyavong raises an eyebrow.

"Interesting."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 挑了挑眉。

"有意思。"

options.en: Interesting? Why?

texts.en:
"It explains why we can't find Hercules."

He raises a finger halfway.

"It would be unprofessional to elaborate on the methods used by Fleet Intelligence, so you need not inquire. We must simply leave it at that."
texts.zh:
"这解释了为什么我们找不到 Hercules。"

他抬起一根手指，只抬到一半。

"细说舰队情报部所用的手段并不合职业规矩，所以你也不必问。这事只能到此为止。"

texts.en:
Siyavong raises an eyebrow.

"Interesting."
texts.zh:
Siyavong 挑了挑眉。

"有意思。"

options.en: Interesting why?

texts.en:
"It explains why he booked transport to where he did."

He raises a finger halfway.

"It would be unprofessional to elaborate on the methods used by Fleet Intelligence, so you need not inquire. We must simply leave it at that."
texts.zh:
"这解释了为什么他订了去那个地方的船票。"

他抬起一根手指，只抬到一半。

"细说舰队情报部所用的手段并不合职业规矩，所以你也不必问。这事只能到此为止。"

texts.en: "Ah." Siyavong's eyes light up. "That explains it."
texts.zh: "啊。\"Siyavong 的眼睛亮了起来。\"这就说得通了。"

options.en: That explains what?

texts.en:
"Yes," Siyavong says with no particular emphasis.

He watches you closely.
texts.zh:
"是，"Siyavong 说，语气听不出任何强调。

他紧紧地看着你。

options.en: I'm told you can help me decrypt some sensitive files.
options.zh: 听说你能帮我解密一些敏感文件。

texts.en:
An automatic smile.

"It would be my pleasure to provide that service for a reasonable fee. May I perform a cursory analysis of the files in order to determine the charge?"

An upload prompt appears. His hands didn't move.
texts.zh:
一个自动浮现的笑容。

"能为你提供这项服务是我的荣幸，收费合理。我可以先对文件做一次粗略分析，好确定价钱吗？"

一个上传请求弹了出来。他的双手一动没动。

options.en: You'd be gaining a copy of very valuable intel. I should like a fee from you.
options.zh: 你会拿到一份极有价值的情报副本。我希望能从你这里收取一笔费用。

options.en: May I be assured of your discretion concerning these files?
options.zh: 关于这些文件，你能保证守口如瓶吗？

options.en: Will you be using AI cores to decrypt these files?
options.zh: 你会用 AI 核心来解密这些文件吗？

options.en: Upload the ANDRADA files

texts.en:
He laughs, delighted.

"I applaud your enterprise, $playerSirOrMadam! Nonetheless, I must confirm the value of these files before I would be authorized to transfer you a payment."

"And before you ask - look at it like this," he says. "I won't simply take the files. I'm invested in you, and I'm invested in you because you discover and create opportunities for long-term profit. I anticipate being rewarded for being trustworthy and friendly in my dealings with you, so that is how I act."

A warm smile appears on his face.
texts.zh:
他笑得很开心。

"$playerSirOrMadam，我欣赏你的进取心！不过，我得先确认这些文件的价值，才有权向你支付款项。"

"还有，免得你先问——不妨这么看，\" 他说，\"我不会白拿走这些文件。我看重的是你这个人，因为你能发现并创造长期获利的机会。我期待着凭自己在你这里守信、友善的行事得到回报，所以我才这样做事。"

他脸上浮现出一个温暖的笑容。

options.en: I understand. Now about the files...
options.zh: 我明白。那么关于这些文件...

options.en: So you're just being nice because I can make you credits?
options.zh: 所以你对我这么客气，只是因为我能替你赚星币？

options.en: A few credits would be a good start to your... investment.
options.zh: 先付几个星币，就算你这笔...投资的好开端了。

texts.en: "I have access to top-level expertise in decryption. I would have to perform a cursory analysis, but it is likely I can have your files for you with little delay."
texts.zh: "我能调用最高水准的解密专才。得先做一次粗略分析，但很可能用不了多久就能把你的文件交给你。"

texts.en:
"Of course. Nothing wrong with that." He resumes the smile with practiced perfection. "You see? I imagined you'd appreciate my honesty in saying so."

He folds his hands together, neatly.
texts.zh:
"当然。这没什么不对。\"他重新挂起那副演练得无可挑剔的笑容。\"你看？我就料想你会欣赏我这份坦白。"

他把双手整齐地叠在一起。

texts.en:
"Your focus on financial gain is laudable, but have patience- there is a world to earn!"

He folds his hands together, neatly.
texts.zh:
"你这份盯着利益的劲头值得称许，不过别急 —— 世上的钱还多着呢！"

他把双手整齐地叠在一起。

texts.en:
"Please, captain." He produces an expression which looks almost embarrassed for you while maintaining a customer-reassuring warmth.

He definitely practices this.

"As an agent of the company, a key indicator of the value I create for Tri-Tachyon is your satisfaction with my work."
texts.zh:
"拜托，舰长。"他脸上摆出一个几乎像是在替你难为情的神情，同时又维持着让客户安心的温和。

这套表情他一定练过。

"作为公司的代理人，我为速子科技创造价值的关键指标，就是你对我的工作是否满意。"

texts.en:
He gives you a stern look.

"I assure you, captain, that the Tri-Tachyon corporation is fully compliant with the terms of the treaty of Crom Cruach."

"We take our dedication to operating within the Persean Sector legal consensus very seriously, which is why Tri-Tachyon donates to several foundations pursuing the study of ethical dynamics involved in the complex challenges faced by post-Domain corporate leadership."

You could swear he just winked, but he didn't.
texts.zh:
他严肃地看了你一眼。

"我向你保证，舰长，速子科技公司完全遵守 Crom Cruach 条约的各项条款。"

"我们非常认真地对待在英仙座星域法律共识范围内经营这件事，正因如此，速子科技才会向几家基金会提供捐助，资助它们研究后人之领时代企业领导层所面对的复杂挑战中涉及的伦理动因。"

你几乎要发誓他刚刚朝你眨了下眼 —— 可他并没有。

texts.en: "Received." His eyes twitch. "Ah. Of course."
texts.zh: "已收到。\"他眼睛抽动了一下。\"啊。当然。"

options.en: You recognize the files?

texts.en:
"I recognize the encryption."

He produces his pleasant smile again. "And the implications of the file headers are... well, this may take a couple days."

"We should have an answer for you within 48 hours."
texts.zh:
"我认得这个加密方式。"

他又挂起那副愉快的笑容。"至于文件头意味着什么...嗯，这大概要花上几天。"

"四十八小时内，我们应该能给你一个答复。"

options.en: And what's this going to cost?

texts.en: "Let's discuss the fee after 48 hours," he says as if it's perfectly routine for the Tri-Tachyon corporation to defer payment.
texts.zh: "费用的事，四十八小时之后再谈。"他说得轻描淡写，仿佛速子科技公司推迟收款是天经地义的事。

options.en: I need your help to decrypt some sensitive files.
options.zh: 我需要你帮忙解密一些敏感文件。

texts.en:
The comms snap crisply open.

"We haven't forgotten about your files," Inesis says without bothering with a greeting. "I'll have them for you very soon."

His smile is uncannily reassuring.
texts.zh:
通讯以一声清脆的响动接通。

"你的文件我们没忘，\"Inesis 连句问候都省了，\"很快就能交到你手上。"

他的笑容有种让人莫名安心的魔力。

texts.en:
The comm-link instantly connects you with Faro Inesis.

"Your files are ready for you, captain." He smiles pleasantly. "You will find the contents fascinating, I think."
texts.zh:
通讯链路立刻接通，另一头是 Faro Inesis。

"你的文件已经备好了，舰长。\"他笑容可掬。\"我想，里面的内容会让你大感兴趣。"

options.en: So what's this cost?
You read the files? What happened to discretion?
options.zh: 你读过文件了？说好的谨慎呢？

options.en: Wait, are you working with Macario?
options.zh: 等等，你在替 Macario 做事？

texts.en: "The fee has been waived," Inesis says warmly, making a little brush-away motion.
texts.zh: "费用已经免了。"Inesis 语气热络，随手做了个挥开的动作。

options.en: Why would you waive the fee?
Good, thank you.

texts.en: "It was decided that your investigation of the contents of the files will be a sufficient."
texts.zh: "上面已经决定，你对文件内容的调查，就足以抵作报酬。"

options.en: I haven't yet agreed to do anything, much less a job for Tri-Tachyon.
options.zh: 我还没答应要做任何事，更别说替速子科技做事。

options.en: And what if I choose not to 'investigate' these files further?
options.zh: 那如果我选择不再深入调查这些文件呢？

options.en: If you think I'm going to do something worth credits, then I want an advance.
options.zh: 你要是觉得我接下来要做的事值钱，那我要先拿一笔预付款。

texts.en: "Of course not," he says. "But if you'd like to keep in contact, I may be able to arrange some well-compensated opportunities to create value."
texts.zh: "当然不，\"他说道，\"不过你要是愿意保持联络，我或许能安排几个报酬可观的机会，让你创造价值。"

texts.en:
"In the meantime, you may wish to do some reading. If not, I recommend using the algorithmic agent built into your TriPad TriOS Executive Suite to create a summary of the files. Tri-Tachyon software is proven to increase the efficiency of common tasks which is why more than nine out of ten executive officers throughout the Persean Sector choose Tri-Tachyon."

He sets his client-facing smile firmly in place.
texts.zh:
"在此期间，你或许愿意读点东西。若不想读，我建议用你 TriPad 上 TriOS 商务套件内置的算法代理，给这些文件生成一份摘要。速子科技的软件已被证明能提升日常任务的效率 —— 这也是英仙座星域每十位高管里就有九位以上选择速子科技的原因。"

他把那副面向客户的笑容稳稳地摆好。

options.en: Accept the file transfer request in your comms interface
options.zh: 在通讯界面接受文件传输请求

texts.en: You transfer the files to a secure workspace accessible via your TriPad, and Inesis closes the comms with a couple polite words.
texts.zh: 你把文件转存到 TriPad 可访问的一处安全空间，Inesis 客套了两句，便切断了通讯。

texts.en:
You pull up the ANDRADA files. There are seven archives filled with timestamped data: Names, locations, status reports, receipts, medical analysis, surveillance.

The data has been processed and analyzed by an intelligence team, possibly over many cycles. You are able to rapidly glean essential details from the prepared summaries.

This archive is stored in your TriPad in a secure workspace and remains accessible through your mission intel entry.
texts.zh:
你调出 ANDRADA 文件。七个档案，塞满了带时间戳的数据：姓名、地点、状态报告、收据、医学分析、监视记录。

这些数据已经过一个情报小组的处理与分析，也许花了许多个星历年。你得以从整理好的摘要里迅速拣出要点。

这份档案存放在你 TriPad 上的加密工作区里，仍可从任务情报条目中访问。

texts.en: You now have a list of places of interest, mostly small planets, a couple minor asteroids, and the Galatia Academy station. All within the core worlds.
texts.zh: 你手上现在有了一份地点清单：多数是小型行星，另有一两处小行星，还有 Galatia 学院空间站 —— 全都在核心世界之内。

texts.en:
Perseus "Saturnian".

Nomios, Arcadia system. Medical reports green. Biochemistry reports. Electrostim muscular and neurological development regimen, equipment and technician fees.

Cheerful progress reports; costly procurement receipt - inventory referred to by codewords. Doctor Cydonia "proceeding with operation". Updates suddenly cease at $sd7s_cydoniaDate.

Alarmed finger-pointing reports. Cydonia gone dark, then reported present at Kanta's Den. Case referred to the Ministry of Internal Security, something called EXCISION-RED.
texts.zh:
Perseus，代号 "Saturnian"。

Nomios，Arcadia 星系。医学报告全部正常。生化检测报告。电刺激肌肉与神经发育方案，设备与技术员费用。

进度报告笔调轻快；昂贵的采购收据 —— 清单上的物件只用代号指称。Cydonia 医生【手术进行中】。所有更新在 $sd7s_cydoniaDate 骤然中断。

随后是惊慌的相互推责报告。Cydonia 失联，之后有报告称其出现在 Kanta's Den。案子转交内部安全部，落到一个叫 EXCISION-RED 的名目下。

texts.en:
Hercules "Cyrino"

Anonymous donation to Nova Maxios orphanage, records altered. Excellent creche scores. Conflict with peers. Multiple MuniSec reports as adolescent.

Accepted to Galatia Academy with full scholarship under Gens Kato-sponsored charity program. Excellent induction-cycle scores.

Conflicting reports regarding necessity of bribery action due to subject's academic achievement. Observation team key agent failed check-in. Concerns about credits allocated to action NARRA-AULD missing. Case forwarded to Ministry of Internal Security, EXCISION-RED, new personnel requested.

Applied and accepted to Post-Collapse History department. Department committee approval of assistant academician status.
texts.zh:
Hercules，代号 "Cyrino"。

向 Nova Maxios 孤儿院的匿名捐款，记录经过涂改。育幼院考评优异。与同龄人屡有冲突。少年时期有多份 MuniSec 报告。

经 Kato 氏族赞助的慈善项目，以全额奖学金被 Galatia 学院录取。入学阶段考评优异。

因其学业成绩出众，是否仍需执行贿赂行动，各方报告相互矛盾。观察组关键特工未按时报到。行动 NARRA-AULD 名下的拨款下落不明，引起关注。案子转交内部安全部，EXCISION-RED，已申请新人手。

申请并获准进入大崩塌后历史系。系委员会已批准其助理院士身份。

texts.en:
Jason "Korin"

Culann. Fees paid to Tri-Tachyon "Cybescence Betterment" charity school; focus on early-age cybernetic interfacing (non-intrusive). Peer altercations, fines charged sponsoring front corporation. Budget allocation under action DALGAN-SIG. Fees paid for social-stability counselling.

Psych report update, subject: anti-company outbursts. Unauthorized absence from Cybescence Betterment. MuniSec records of vandalism, theft. Front corporation allocated additional credits under DALGAN-SIG to suppress records. Tri-Tachyon Customer Awareness (access via DALGAN-SIG) reports subject purchased unlicensed transport to Qaras, Yma system.

Observation team re-assigned. Subject associated with ANTI-associated agents, Kanta gang connections. Permission to extract subject awaiting confirmation.
texts.zh:
Jason，代号 "Korin"。

Culann。学费付给速子科技旗下的 "Cybescence Betterment" 慈善学校；主攻幼龄期义体接驳 (非侵入式)。与同龄人发生冲突，罚款记在出面赞助的空壳公司账上。预算列在行动 DALGAN-SIG 项下。另有社会稳定性辅导的费用支出。

心理报告更新，事由：屡次发表反公司言论。未经许可离开 Cybescence Betterment。MuniSec 有故意毁坏与盗窃的记录。空壳公司在 DALGAN-SIG 项下追加拨款，用以压下记录。速子科技客户关注部门 (经 DALGAN-SIG 取得权限) 报告：对象购得一趟无照运输，前往 Yma 星系的 Qaras。

观察组已改派。对象与反公司势力的代理人往来，并与 Kanta 的帮派有联系。提取对象的许可仍在等待批准。

texts.en:
Hector "Palatin"

Record of property purchase from numbered holding incorporate, Hybrasil system. Orbital coordinates attached, missing schematics; registry name 58966 Elysium.

Supply, staff procurement through TT subsidiaries. Medical report green. List of private tutors, CVs attached, assigned to ELYSIUM. Receipts of payment; shortest term one shift, longest one and a half cycles.

Accounting for period contains fees for medical evac (cryo-stabilized), multiple instances. Details redacted. Psych assessment missing from file.
texts.zh:
Hector，代号 "Palatin"。

有资产购入记录，卖方为 Hybrasil 星系一家以编号注册的控股公司。附有轨道坐标，图纸缺失；登记名为 58966 Elysium。

补给与人员招募均经速子科技下属公司办理。医学报告全部正常。附私人教师名单与简历，皆派驻 ELYSIUM。付款收据齐备；聘期最短的只有一个轮班，最长的一个半星历年。

该期间的账目中含有医疗后送费用 (低温稳定处理)，且不止一次。细目已删节。心理评估报告不在卷内。

texts.en:
Achilles "Kalian".

Early body of data is tagged planet Madeira. Creche committee bribed, exowomb records altered. Parents: naval logistics/senior AM tech.

Exceptional creche scores despite conflict with peers. Medical reports green. Fleet Cadets program, commendation. Bribe to naval committee (action codename PORPHYRA). Application to Kazeron Academy. Graduation with full honors.

Offered piracy patrol, unexpectedly rescinded. Re-assigned to Yesod, Zagan system, awaiting assignment. Observation program disrupted by PL Fleet Intelligence; intel insufficient, request additional detail. Yesod MuniSec reports involvement in altercation, spacer bar; news suppressed by Fleet Intelligence.
texts.zh:
Achilles，代号 "Kalian"。

早期数据一律标在 Madeira 行星名下。育幼委员会被买通，体外子宫记录经过涂改。父母：一方在海军后勤，一方是资深反物质技师。

育幼院考评极优，尽管与同龄人屡有冲突。医学报告全部正常。舰队候补军官计划，获嘉奖。向海军委员会行贿 (行动代号 PORPHYRA)。申请 Kazeron 学院。以最高荣誉毕业。

已获派剿盗巡逻任务，却意外被撤销。改派至 Zagan 星系的 Yesod，等待分配。观察计划被英仙座联盟舰队情报部打乱；情报不足，请求补充细节。Yesod 的 MuniSec 报告其卷入一场斗殴，地点是太空船员酒吧；消息已被舰队情报部压下。

texts.en:
Leonidas "Esculus"

Cethlan commerce court: purchase of cometary body in Duzakh system, price reduced due to dispute over recognition of exploitation rights.

Project codename IRKALLA, refurbishment contract: NDAs, list of tech specs, unusual bio-support equipment, re-orbit to L4-point of Duzahk fringe jump-point.

Contract with Neurozenith Cybernetic Solutions Group (NCSG) for an extended program, anonymous package. Additional contracts with numbered fronts registered in various polities. Manifests imply regular site resupply. Accounting suggests unusually high cost.

Procurement of two contractors, specialized services, referred to by codenames CRASIS, AUREOLIN for 10-cycle period. Two term extensions paid upfront.
texts.zh:
Leonidas，代号 "Esculus"。

Cethlan 商事法庭：购入 Duzakh 星系内一具彗星体，因开采权认定存在争议，成交价被压低。

项目代号 IRKALLA，改造合同：保密协议、技术规格清单、非常规生命维持设备、重新入轨至 Duzahk 边缘跳跃点的 L4 点。

与 Neurozenith Cybernetic Solutions Group (NCSG) 签订长期项目合同，以匿名形式打包。另有若干合同，对方是注册在各政体下的编号空壳。货运清单显示该处有定期补给。账目也显示费用高得不寻常。

采购两名承包商提供专门服务，以代号 CRASIS、AUREOLIN 指称，合约十个星历年。两次续约费用已预先付清。

texts.en: And a flashing indicator. Attached message, timestamp: now.
texts.zh: 还有一处闪动的标记。附带一条消息，时间戳：此刻。

texts.en:
It opens.

Nothing. It's blank.

Then text appears, one character after another. As if they carried a sense of their own volition.
texts.zh:
它打开了。

什么也没有。一片空白。

然后文字浮现出来，一个字符接一个字符。仿佛它们各有自己的意志。

texts.en: $PlayerName - please give kindness to Crasis and Aureolin.
texts.zh: $PlayerName - please give kindness to Crasis and Aureolin.

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
One by one, the characters disappear. The note closes itself and disappears from your TriPad.

You take a deep breath waiting for what happens next.

Nothing.
texts.zh:
字符又一个一个地消失。那条便笺自行关闭，从你的 TriPad 上不见了。

你深吸一口气，等着看接下来会发生什么。

什么也没有。

texts.en:
Pericles "Aventine"

Records of ongoing payment to mercenary captain Maues Moroz based out of Orthrus, in the Samarra System. Medical reports green. Creche reports exceptional.

Eventide section, private academy: flight training, navigation, tactics, mathematics. Subject expelled for altercation with heir of REDACTED, a leading family of Eventide. Combat sim records good-to-exceptional.

Record of fleet operations, merc jobs in core worlds and near-fringe. Associated with incorporated body owned by 'Moroz' who holds lease on several warehouses, two private docks on Orthrus.
texts.zh:
Pericles，代号 "Aventine"。

有持续付款记录，收款人为盘踞在 Samarra 星系 Orthrus 的雇佣兵头目 Maeus Moroz。医学报告全部正常。育幼院考评极优。

Eventide 城区，私立学院：飞行训练、导航、战术、数学。对象因与【已删节】家族的继承人发生冲突而被开除 —— 那是 Eventide 的望族之一。战斗模拟记录从良好到极优。

有舰队作战记录，在核心世界与近边缘地带接过雇佣任务。与一家法人实体有关联，其所有者【Moroz】租用着 Orthrus 上的几处仓库和两个私人船坞。

texts.en: "As an official representative of the Tri-Tachyon corporation, I hold the utmost respect for your personal choice."
texts.zh: "作为速子科技公司的正式代表，我对你的个人选择怀有最高的尊重。"

texts.en:
He laughs.

"I like how you think, captain. Let's keep in contact. I'd like to arrange for more specific opportunities for you to earn those credits."
texts.zh:
他笑出声来。

"我喜欢你这种想法，舰长。我们保持联系吧。我想给你安排些更具体的机会，让你挣到那些星币。"

texts.en:
He smiles.

"It was decided that your investigation of the contents of the files will be sufficient."
texts.zh:
他笑了。

"上面已经决定，你对文件内容的调查就足以抵作报酬。"

options.en: I haven't yet agreed to do anything, much less a job for Tri-Tachyon.
options.zh: 我还没答应要做任何事，更别说替速子科技做事。

options.en: And what if I choose not to 'investigate' these files further?
options.zh: 那如果我选择不再深入调查这些文件呢？

options.en: If you think I'm going to do something worth credits, then I want an advance.
options.zh: 你要是觉得我接下来要做的事值钱，那我要先拿一笔预付款。

texts.en: "Not as such, $playerSirOrMadam," he says. "I am, however, incidentally aware of the general essence of the contents."
texts.zh: "不能这么说，$playerSirOrMadam，\"他说道，\"不过那些内容的大意，我碰巧是知道的。"

texts.en:
"No, captain," he says, smiling reassuringly. "I am not working for Dolos Macario. I am honored to be a loyal employee of the Tri-Tachyon corporation, and shareholder as well."

"I suggest you read your files, then we may speak further."
texts.zh:
"不是的，舰长，\"他笑着，一副让人放心的样子。\"我不为 Dolos Macario 做事。我很荣幸是速子科技公司的忠诚雇员 —— 同时也是股东。"

"我建议你先读读你的文件，之后我们再谈。"

options.en: Let's talk about the ANDRADA files.
options.zh: 谈谈那些 ANDRADA 文件吧。

texts.en:
"What would you like to discuss, captain?"

He speaks with a pleasant blandness that feels out of place with his occupation.
texts.zh:
"你想谈什么，舰长？"

他说话的语气和善而平淡，跟他这一行当格格不入。

options.en: You'd be gaining a copy of very valuable intel. I should like a fee from you.
options.zh: 你会拿到一份极有价值的情报副本。我希望能从你这里收取一笔费用。

options.en: May I be assured of your discretion concerning these files?
options.zh: 关于这些文件，你能保证守口如瓶吗？

options.en: Will you be using AI cores to decrypt these files?
options.zh: 你会用 AI 核心来解密这些文件吗？

options.en: Upload the ANDRADA files

texts.en:
He laughs, delighted.

"I applaud your enterprise, $playerSirOrMadam! Nonetheless, I must confirm the value of these files before I would be authorized to transfer you a payment."

"And before you ask - look at it like this," he says. "I won't simply take the files. I'm invested in you, and I'm invested in you because you discover and create opportunities for long-term profit. I anticipate being rewarded for being trustworthy and friendly in my dealings with you, so that is how I act."

A warm smile appears on his face.
texts.zh:
他笑得很开心。

"$playerSirOrMadam，我欣赏你的进取心！不过，我得先确认这些文件的价值，才有权向你支付款项。"

"还有，免得你先问——不妨这么看，\" 他说，\"我不会白拿走这些文件。我看重的是你这个人，因为你能发现并创造长期获利的机会。我期待着凭自己在你这里守信、友善的行事得到回报，所以我才这样做事。"

他脸上浮现出一个温暖的笑容。

options.en: I understand. Now about the files...
options.zh: 我明白。那么关于这些文件...

options.en: So you're just being nice because I can make you credits?
options.zh: 所以你对我这么客气，只是因为我能替你赚星币？

options.en: A few credits would be a good start to your... investment.
options.zh: 先付几个星币，就算你这笔...投资的好开端了。

texts.en: "I have access to top-level expertise in decryption. I would have to perform a cursory analysis, but it is likely I can have your files for you with little delay."
texts.zh: "我能调用最高水准的解密专才。得先做一次粗略分析，但很可能用不了多久就能把你的文件交给你。"

texts.en:
"Of course. Nothing wrong with that." He resumes the smile with practiced perfection. "You see? I imagined you'd appreciate my honesty in saying so."

He folds his hands together, neatly.
texts.zh:
"当然。这没什么不对。\"他重新挂起那副演练得无可挑剔的笑容。\"你看？我就料想你会欣赏我这份坦白。"

他把双手整齐地叠在一起。

texts.en:
"Your focus on financial gain is laudable, but have patience- there is a world to earn!"

He folds his hands together, neatly.
texts.zh:
"你这份盯着利益的劲头值得称许，不过别急 —— 世上的钱还多着呢！"

他把双手整齐地叠在一起。

texts.en:
"Please, captain." He produces an expression which looks almost embarrassed for you while maintaining a customer-reassuring warmth.

He definitely practices this.

"As an agent of the company, a key indicator of the value I create for Tri-Tachyon is your satisfaction with my work."
texts.zh:
"拜托，舰长。"他脸上摆出一个几乎像是在替你难为情的神情，同时又维持着让客户安心的温和。

这套表情他一定练过。

"作为公司的代理人，我为速子科技创造价值的关键指标，就是你对我的工作是否满意。"

texts.en:
He gives you a stern look.

"I assure you, captain, that the Tri-Tachyon corporation is fully compliant with the terms of the treaty of Crom Cruach."

"We take our dedication to operating within the Persean Sector legal consensus very seriously, which is why Tri-Tachyon donates to several foundations pursuing the study of ethical dynamics involved in the complex challenges faced by post-Domain corporate leadership."

You could swear he just winked, but he didn't.
texts.zh:
他严肃地看了你一眼。

"我向你保证，舰长，速子科技公司完全遵守 Crom Cruach 条约的各项条款。"

"我们非常认真地对待在英仙座星域法律共识范围内经营这件事，正因如此，速子科技才会向几家基金会提供捐助，资助它们研究后人之领时代企业领导层所面对的复杂挑战中涉及的伦理动因。"

你几乎要发誓他刚刚朝你眨了下眼 —— 可他并没有。

texts.en: "Received." His eyes twitch. "Ah. Of course."
texts.zh: "已收到。\"他眼睛抽动了一下。\"啊。当然。"

options.en: You recognize the files?

texts.en:
"I recognize the encryption."

He produces his pleasant smile again. "And the implications of the file headers are... well, this may take a couple days."

"We should have an answer for you within 48 hours."
texts.zh:
"我认得这个加密方式。"

他又挂起那副愉快的笑容。"至于文件头意味着什么...嗯，这大概要花上几天。"

"四十八小时内，我们应该能给你一个答复。"

options.en: And what's this going to cost?

texts.en: "Let's discuss the fee after 48 hours," he says as if it's perfectly routine for the Tri-Tachyon corporation to defer payment.
texts.zh: "费用的事，四十八小时之后再谈。"他说得轻描淡写，仿佛速子科技公司推迟收款是天经地义的事。

options.en: Let's talk about the ANDRADA files.
options.zh: 谈谈那些 ANDRADA 文件吧。

texts.en: "Of course. What would you like to discuss?"
texts.zh: "当然。你想谈些什么？"

options.en: How much do you know about the contents of these files?
options.zh: 关于这些文件的内容，你知道多少？

options.en: If you're not working with Macario, how do you know the contents of these files?
options.zh: 既然你不替 Macario 做事，那你怎么会知道这些文件的内容？

options.en: I found Hector Andrada in the Hybrasil system... (explain)
options.zh: 我在 Hybrasil 星系找到了 Hector Andrada... (解释)

options.en: I found Achilles Andrada. He's working with Gens Kato... (explain)
options.zh: 我找到了 Achilles Andrada。他正跟 Kato 氏族 合作... (解释)

options.en: I found Leonidas Andrada. And two AI cores... (explain)
options.zh: 我找到了 Leonidas Andrada。还有两个 AI 核心... (解释)

options.en: I'm getting the impression that Tri-Tachyon has been assisting the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: 我的感觉是，速子科技一直在协助辛达强权。

options.en: I'd like to talk about something else.

texts.en:
"Tri-Tachyon does business with every faction in the Persean Sector, captain. And it is my business to... how to put it." He puts a finger on his chin, looking thoughtful.

"Watch the big picture. I facilitate the evaluation of the sum of business dealings with various factions to take a guess, if you will, at their intentions and future actions. This allows Tri-Tachyon to anticipate upcoming market conditions as well as customer needs as well as what we might call 'unexpected business-impacting events'."

He gives you a quick look to check in. You get the impression that he is genuinely enthusiastic about the subject.
texts.zh:
"速子科技和英仙座星域里的每一个势力都做生意，舰长。而我的差事，就是...该怎么说呢。"他把一根手指抵在下巴上，若有所思。

"看大局。我负责汇总各方势力的生意往来，做个评估，再据此猜一猜 —— 姑且算是猜 —— 他们的意图和下一步动作。这样速子科技就能预判即将到来的市场行情、客户需求，以及我们所说的【影响商业的意外事件】。"

他飞快地瞥了你一眼，看你是否在听。你觉得他对这个话题是真心的热衷。

options.en: So how does economic forecasting mean you know about the Diktat's secret plots?
options.zh: 那么，经济预测怎么就让你知道了强权的秘密图谋？

texts.en:
He chuckles. There's no other word for it.

"Our economy is a web of relationships, of supply chains, the bringing together of parts and pieces and skills to enable specific tasks which add value - or are believed to add value - to one's enterprise."

"There are few secrets in the Persean Sector if you pay enough attention. Does the Sindrian Diktat directly contract with Tri-Tachyon and wholly owned subsidiaries? Of course! But inferring aims and intentions goes well beyond any direct relationship held by certain subsections of Tri-Tachyon have with various ministries of the Sindrian Diktat."
texts.zh:
他轻笑起来。没有更贴切的词了。

"我们的经济是一张网 —— 关系网、供应链网，把零件、部件与技艺凑到一起，去完成能为企业增加价值、或者被认为能增加价值的特定工作。"

"只要你足够留心，英仙座星域里没什么秘密。辛达强权会直接跟速子科技及其全资子公司签约吗？当然会！但要推断目的与意图，光靠速子科技某些部门与辛达强权各部委之间的直接关系，远远不够。"

options.en: You're saying a lot without giving me a direct answer.
options.zh: 你说了一大堆，就是没给我一个正面回答。

texts.en:
He nods, conceding your point. It's almost as if he's pleased you've called him out.

"I'm afraid, captain, that this will have to suffice. I am paid very well for my loyalty, and in more than mere credits."

He wears a glowing smile.
texts.zh:
他点点头，认了你这一问。看他那样子，倒像是很高兴被你当面点破。

"恐怕只能说到这儿了，舰长。我的忠诚酬劳很丰厚，而且不止是星币。"

他脸上泛着笑意。

texts.en:
You summarize the situation you discovered and its result.

Inesis wears a look of concern as he speaks. "I am pleased, of course, that you came out of this relatively unharmed, captain. It is upsetting, of course, that you would have such an experience in the Hybrasil system. This Hector Andrada- it sounds like Macario has turned his opinion against you?"

He shakes his head at the injustice of it.
texts.zh:
你把查到的情况与结果扼要讲了一遍。

Inesis 说话时一脸关切。"你这次能大体无恙地脱身，我自然欣慰，舰长。你在 Hybrasil 星系竟遇上这种事，实在令人不安。这位 Hector Andrada —— 听上去，是 Macario 让他转而敌视你了？"

他为这份不公摇了摇头。

options.en: I must ask, is Tri-Tachyon connected to this?
options.zh: 我必须问一句，速子科技跟这事有关吗？

options.en: And right in Tri-Tachyon's backyard. I feel like Macario must have had official approval.
options.zh: 而且就在速子科技的后院。我总觉得 Macario 一定拿到了官方许可。

texts.en:
Inesis nods along as you explain. He doesn't look surprised to hear any of this.

"Yes," he says once you're finished, "Market analysis of Gens Kato assets which would suggest such a move. I've adjusted my own investment portfolio, of course," he says with a quick smile.
texts.zh:
你说话时，Inesis 一路点头。听到这些，他脸上没有半点意外。

"是的，"等你说完，他开口道，"对 Kato 氏族 资产的行情分析，本来就指向这样的动作。当然，我自己的投资组合也调整过了，"他飞快地笑了一下。

texts.en:
"Fascinating," Inesis says as you lay out the situation.

"And I must, of course, express our disapproval of the unregulated use of AI cores in such a manner. It is, of course, official Tri-Tachyon policy to coordinate with the Hegemony authorities to investigate all potential breaches of AI core regulation as set out by the Treaty of Crom Cruach."

He puts on a look of sufficient but not overwhelming concern.
texts.zh:
你把情形摊开来讲，Inesis 只说了句"有意思"。

"当然，我也必须表明，我们不赞成以这种方式无监管地使用 AI 核心。速子科技的官方政策，当然是与霸主当局协作，调查一切涉嫌违反 Crom Cruach 条约所定 AI 核心管理规定的行为。"

他摆出一副关切的神情，恰如其分，又不至于过分。

texts.en:
"'Helping' is an interesting word," he says thoughtfully. "It implies a... a charity which is not present. Are elements of the Sindrian Diktat a customer to subsidiaries and initiatives in which Tri-Tachyon holds a stake? Absolutely. Tri-Tachyon is committed to market principles."

He shrugs. "Business is business."
texts.zh:
"【协助】这个词很有意思，\"他若有所思，\"它暗示着一种...并不存在的慈善。辛达强权的某些部门，是速子科技持股的子公司与项目的客户吗？当然。速子科技恪守市场原则。"

他耸耸肩。"生意就是生意。"

options.en: I guess that's your business.
options.zh: 我猜那就是你们的生意。

options.en: It's all about the credits, that's what I say.
options.zh: 要我说，全都是为了星币。

options.en: But their business is operating an oppressive dictatorship!
options.zh: 可他们的生意，是经营一个压迫人的独裁政权！

texts.en: "It's a tumultuous market, captain," he says. "In part thanks to your work. You might consider moving some commodities futures around - this is a great time to do some speculation!"
texts.zh: "市场正翻腾得厉害，舰长，"他说道，"其中也有你一份功劳。你或许可以考虑动一动商品期货 —— 现在正是做投机的好时候！"

texts.en:
"I couldn't agree more, captain. And the work you're doing shows all signs of provoking a dynamic restructuring of elements of the Askonian economy with ripple effects across all the core worlds."

He leans in, a little. "It's very exciting. You might consider moving some commodities futures around - this is a great time to do some speculation."
texts.zh:
"我完全同意，舰长。而且你正在做的事，处处显示出要引发 Askonia 经济某些层面的剧烈重组，余波会荡及所有核心世界。"

他稍稍凑近了些。"这非常令人兴奋。你或许可以考虑动一动商品期货 —— 现在正是做投机的好时候。"

texts.en:
"It's a difficult situation," he says, nodding.

"However Tri-Tachyon has enjoyed a great deal of success in working with the Sindrian Diktat to promote market-based partnerships - they have a great deal of underutilized capital and labor, you see! It's small steps, but every one made is progress, captain. More than the Hegemony's hardline policies have yielded; our analysis is very clear on that point."

He beams, genuinely proud.
texts.zh:
"局面确实棘手，"他点头道。

"不过，速子科技在与辛达强权合作、推动市场化伙伴关系方面颇有成效 —— 你要知道，他们手上有大量未被充分利用的资本与劳动力！步子虽小，但每迈一步都是进展，舰长。比霸主那套强硬政策换来的东西多得多；这一点，我们的分析非常清楚。"

他喜形于色，是真心感到自豪。

texts.en:
"I- confirming..." $HeOrShe looks conflicted, then something gives. "Received and acknowledged."

"If this is legitimate, then I order you to break off pursuit immediately. I am bound to secrecy and I invoke, by your oath and commission, your own pledge of unquestioning loyalty. This is not your business, captain."

"Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!" $heOrShe shouts.
texts.zh:
"我 —— 正在核实...\"$HeOrShe 面露挣扎，随后某种东西松动了。\"已收到，确认完毕。"

"若这身份属实，我命令你立刻中止追击。我身负保密之责，并依你的誓言与委任，要求你履行无条件效忠的承诺。此事与你无关，舰长。"

"荣耀归于辛达强权！"$heOrShe 喊道。

I need to speak with you about an academician.
