texts.en: You told Fortuna Kato you would help her back Achilles' claim. You're both enemies of Macario so your interests are aligned.
texts.zh: 你答应过 Fortuna Kato，会帮她支持 Achilles 的继承主张。你们两人都是 Macario 的敌人，利益自然一致。

texts.en: You told Fortuna Kato you would help her back Achilles' claim - for credits. You're both enemies of Macario so your interests are aligned.
texts.zh: 你答应过 Fortuna Kato，会帮她支持 Achilles 的继承主张——为了星币。你们两人都是 Macario 的敌人，利益自然一致。

texts.en: Finlay Siyavong might lend the assistance of the FIS, provided it somehow benefitted the Persean League.
texts.zh: Finlay Siyavong 或许能让舰队情报部出手相助——前提是这件事多少对英仙座联盟有利。

texts.en: Faro Inesis might be convinced to use his intelligence network and contacts to support your efforts... if he could profit without risking his position in Tri-Tachyon.
texts.zh: 也许能说服 Faro Inesis，动用他的情报网络与人脉来支持你的行动...前提是他能从中获利，又不至于危及自己在速子科技的地位。

texts.en: Although averse to your schemes as a rule, Rayan Arroyo might be persuaded to help by the promise of safe profits.
texts.zh: Rayan Arroyo 素来讨厌你那些算计，但若能许他一笔稳妥的利润，也许能说服他帮忙。

texts.en: Oxana Hyder seems to trust you. And you know how much she hates Macario.
texts.zh: Oxana Hyder 似乎信得过你。而你也知道她有多恨 Macario。

texts.en: Oxana Hyder may not entirely trust you, but you know how much she hates Macario.
texts.zh: Oxana Hyder 未必完全信得过你，可你也知道她有多恨 Macario。

texts.en: You've sown a seed of distrust between Horacio Caden and Macario. Perhaps it's time to see if it will bear bloody fruit.
texts.zh: 你已在 Horacio Caden 与 Macario 之间埋下了猜忌的种子。也许该看看它会不会结出见血的果实了。

texts.en: You've sown a seed of trust with Horacio Caden. With your shared loyalty to Philip Andrada's vision, surely you can find a way to save the Sindrian Diktat.
texts.zh: 你已在 Horacio Caden 心中埋下了信任的种子。既然你们都忠于 Philip Andrada 的构想，总能找到一条拯救辛达强权的路。

texts.en:
Events around Askonia are progressing rapidly.

Hector must make his move soon, to say nothing of Achilles.

With Rao's help, with the assets of the Hegemony behind you, you'll find your opening. There may be other potential allies as well...
texts.zh:
Askonia 周围的局势正迅速推进。

Hector 必须尽快出手，更不用说 Achilles 了。

有 Rao 相助，有霸主的资源在背后支撑，你会找到突破口。也许还有别的潜在盟友...

texts.en:
You take a deep breath.

And open your eyes.
texts.zh:
你深吸一口气。

然后睁开了眼睛。

Hector must make his move soon, to say nothing of Achilles.

With the help of Inesis - and it might take a little negotiation or, failing that, bribery - you'll be able to identify an opening. There may be other potential allies as well...
texts.zh:
Askonia 周围的局势正迅速推进。

Hector 必须尽快出手，更不用说 Achilles 了。

有 Inesis 相助——这或许要费些口舌，实在不行还得花钱打点——你就能找到一个突破口。也许还有别的潜在盟友...

texts.en:

Hector must make his move soon, to say nothing of Achilles.

With the help of Arroyo - and it might take a little negotiation or, failing that, bribery - you'll be able to identify an opening. There may be other potential allies as well...
texts.zh:
Askonia 周围的局势正迅速推进。

Hector 必须尽快出手，更不用说 Achilles 了。

有 Arroyo 相助——这或许要费些口舌，实在不行还得花钱打点——你就能找到一个突破口。也许还有别的潜在盟友...

texts.en:
Events around Askonia are progressing rapidly. Hector must make his move, and soon - then Achilles will follow.

With Hyder in command of the Sindrian Diktat navy, her backing may make all the difference. And she may be willing to leave Macario exposed. There may be other potential allies as well...
texts.zh:
Askonia 周围的局势正迅速推进。Hector 必须出手，而且要快——然后 Achilles 才会跟上。

有 Hyder 统率辛达强权海军，她的支持或许会起决定作用。而且她也许愿意让 Macario 露出破绽。也许还有别的潜在盟友...

texts.en: You recall telling Macario that Hyder wanted to install herself as Supreme Executor. He may move against her sooner than later.
texts.zh: 你想起自己曾对 Macario 说，Hyder 想把自己推上最高元首之位。他也许很快就会对她动手。

texts.en: You recall telling Caden that Hyder wants to become Supreme Executor. He dismissed it at the time...
texts.zh: 你想起自己曾对 Caden 说，Hyder 想当最高元首。他当时没当回事...

texts.en: You recall telling Macario that Hyder wants to defect to the Hegemony. He might take action against her.
texts.zh: 你想起自己曾对 Macario 说，Hyder 想叛投霸主。他也许会因此对她采取行动。

texts.en: You recall telling Caden that Macario backs Hyder, surely leading to some resentment on Caden's part...
texts.zh: 你想起自己曾对 Caden 说，Macario 在背后支持 Hyder——这想必让 Caden 生出几分怨恨...

texts.en: You recall telling Macario contradictory 'facts' about Hyder's intentions, which did not endear you to him. but will he act against Hyder nonetheless based on any of it?
texts.zh: 你想起自己曾对 Macario 讲过关于 Hyder 意图的种种自相矛盾的'事实'，这并没让你在他那里讨到好。可他会不会仍然依据其中某一条，对 Hyder 下手？

options.en: But how do I contact Hyder if I am shoot-on-sight?
options.zh: 可我一露面就会遭到攻击，怎么联系 Hyder？

texts.en:
There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindrian Diktat military network.

Then you could talk to Hyder and explain the situation.
texts.zh:
Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支轻快而隐蔽的舰队可以潜入，黑进中继站，直接与辛达强权的军用网络建立通讯链路。

然后你就能和 Hyder 通话，向她说明情况。

options.en: It'll have to do

texts.en:
Events around Askonia are progressing rapidly. Hector must make his move, and soon - then Achilles will follow.

With Caden in command of the Lion's Guard fleet and paramilitary forces his backing may make all the difference to Hector's success - and, in turn, Macario's.

There may be other potential allies as well...
texts.zh:
Askonia 周围的局势正迅速推进。Hector 必须出手，而且要快——然后 Achilles 才会跟上。

有 Caden 统率狮心卫队舰队与准军事部队，他的支持或许会决定 Hector 的成败——反过来，也会决定 Macario 的成败。

也许还有别的潜在盟友...

options.en: But how do I contact Caden if I am shoot-on-sight?
options.zh: 可我一露面就会遭到攻击，怎么联系 Caden？

texts.en:
There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindrian Diktat military network.

Then you could talk to Caden. Give his fanaticism a push in the right (or wrong) direction.
texts.zh:
Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支轻快而隐蔽的舰队可以潜入，黑进中继站，直接与辛达强权的军用网络建立通讯链路。

然后你就能和 Caden 通话了。给他那份狂热推一把，推向正确 (或者错误) 的方向。

options.en: It'll have to do

texts.en:
Events around Askonia are progressing rapidly.

Hector must make his move soon, to say nothing of Achilles.

You'll find your opening.
texts.zh:
Askonia 周围的局势正迅速推进。

Hector 必须尽快出手，更不用说 Achilles 了。

你会找到突破口的。

texts.en:
Are you loyal to the Sindrian Diktat?

Without your commission, declared a terrorist and target of a kill-on-sight order, how can you demonstrate your support for the next Supreme Executor?
texts.zh:
你忠于辛达强权吗？

没了委任状，又被宣布为恐怖分子、成了格杀勿论令的目标，你还怎么向下一任最高元首表明你的支持？

options.en: I am loyal to the Sindrian Diktat! There must be a way.
options.zh: 我忠于辛达强权！总有办法的。

options.en: None of that matters to me.
options.zh: 那些对我来说都无所谓。

texts.en:
Macario is a faithless manipulator who believes in nothing but his own power. He never cared for Andrada's vision, however faded it became in those final cycles. A true heir to Philip Andrada must stand and take up the mantle, throw off Macario's web of lies, and usher in a new age.

Not as a puppet. As a leader.
texts.zh:
Macario 是个没有信念的操纵者，除了自己的权力，他什么都不信。Andrada 的愿景在最后那些星历年里无论褪色到什么地步，他也从未真正在意过。Philip Andrada 真正的继承人必须站出来，接过这份衣钵，挣脱 Macario 的谎言之网，开启一个新的时代。

不是当傀儡。是当领袖。
effects: #SetTooltip sdse_introMacarioSDchooseSelf "Those clones are bloodless copies of a great man. They have not proven themselves through glory, ambition, and battle... as you have."

options.zh: 必须除掉 Macario；辛达强权该由 Hector 来领导

texts.en:
Hector must lead the Sindrian Diktat - and not as Macario's puppet.

It won't be easy, because Macario has already poisoned Hector's opinion of you, judging by the recordings you experienced at 58966 Elysium.

But, surely, the transcendent philosophy of Philip Andrada will prevail.

The Blood of Andrada MUST prevail.
texts.zh:
Hector 必须领导辛达强权——而且不能做 Macario 的傀儡。

这不会容易，因为从你在 58966 Elysium 经历过的那些录像来看，Macario 已经在 Hector 心里把对你的看法毒化了。

但是，Philip Andrada 那套超凡的哲学终将胜出。

Andrada 的血脉必须胜出。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
But how?

If you could smash through the fleets and capture Macario, you'd leave the pride of the Sindrian Diktat scattered and demoralized.

The one polity which embodies Andrada's Transcendent Ideology would be left vulnerable to invasion!

By the Hegemony. Or the Persean League. Or Luddic infiltrators...

Another war, another occupation. Industry razed, ships and stations blazing like short-lived stars; hundreds of thousands, possibly millions, left dead.
texts.zh:
可怎么做？

就算你能一路击穿那些舰队、抓住 Macario，你也会让辛达强权的骄傲四散溃逃、士气尽失。

那个唯一承载着 Andrada 超凡意识形态的政体，将被暴露在入侵之下！

来自霸主。或者英仙座联盟。或者卢德派的渗透者...

又一场战争，又一次占领。工业被夷平，舰船与空间站像短命的星辰一样燃烧；数十万人，也许数百万人，就此死去。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Besides, as soon as your fleet secured an orbit, he'd scurry away by one escape route or another to the safe houses he must have on half the worlds of the Persean Sector.

You have to be more subtle. You consider options and allies. Whoever you speak to first will send a signal about which faction you favor.
texts.zh:
再说，你的舰队一旦进入轨道，他就会从某条退路溜走，躲进他在英仙座星域半数星球上都备着的安全屋。

你得做得更隐蔽些。你权衡着手里的选项与潜在的盟友。你先去找谁，就等于向各方表明你偏向哪一边。

texts.en:
You decide that Achilles must lead the Sindrian Diktat.

He is not a puppet of Macario, and and he's much more than a weak echo of the worst side of Philip Andrada.

There is, of course, the matter of Fortuna Kato.

She intends to manipulate Achilles through her support of his cause. She claims he's a willing partner in the arrangement, but her goals are to recenter of power in the Persean League, perhaps even making Askonia a full League member...
texts.zh:
你决定，辛达强权必须由 Achilles 来领导。

他不是 Macario 的傀儡，也远不只是 Philip Andrada 最坏那一面的软弱回声。

当然，还有 Fortuna Kato 这一桩。

她打算借着支持他的事业来操纵他。她声称他在这桩安排里是自愿的伙伴，可她的目标是把权力重心重新搬回英仙座联盟，甚至可能让 Askonia 成为联盟的正式成员...

options.en: And that's fine, Fortuna's plan for Achilles is the best outcome
options.zh: 那也无妨，Fortuna 为 Achilles 安排的路就是最好的结果

options.en: Fortuna Kato's plans must be thwarted as well
options.zh: Fortuna Kato 的算盘也必须打掉

options.en: Wait and see - first Achilles needs to beat Hector
options.zh: 静观其变——Achilles 得先打赢 Hector

texts.en:
Fortuna Kato will do what is best for her - and for the Sector. She'll do her best to see that Achilles prevails.

The fact remains: Macario must be destroyed.
texts.zh:
Fortuna Kato 会做对她自己、也对星域最有利的事。她会尽力让 Achilles 胜出。

事实不变：Macario 必须被摧毁。

texts.en:
Fortuna Kato must be stopped as well. But how?

Undermine her position within the League through the machinations of the other gens, Hannan and Yaribay? Or by ensuring that Achilles has an independent base of support - enough that he need not answer to Fortuna's beck and call?

A direct approach could undermine Achilles. You'll have to be clever.
texts.zh:
Fortuna Kato 也必须被拦住。可怎么拦？

借另外两个氏族——Hannan 与 Yaribay——的算计来动摇她在联盟里的地位？还是确保 Achilles 有一块独立的支持基础——大到他不必听凭 Fortuna 呼来喝去？

直接动手可能会害了 Achilles。你得聪明些。

options.en: The fact remains - Macario must be destroyed
options.zh: 事实不变——Macario 必须被摧毁

texts.en:
Internal conflicts can and should be set aside; they're a distraction from what's important. Achilles has a war to win.

And Macario must be destroyed.
texts.zh:
内部的纷争可以、也应该先搁到一边；那只会让人从要紧的事上分心。Achilles 还有一场战争要打赢。

而 Macario 必须被摧毁。

texts.en:
What loyalty you had to the Sindrian Diktat is as void and null as your former commission. It is the natural consequence of betrayal.

This brings you to the second problem.
texts.zh:
你对辛达强权曾有过的忠诚，已和你从前的委任状一样归于无效。这是背叛的必然结果。

这就引出了第二个问题。

options.en: Macario is sitting safe behind the combined warfleets of the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: Macario 安稳地坐在辛达强权联合舰队的屏障之后。

texts.en:
You'll tear down his Spider's web and free the Persean Sector from his ruthless manipulation.

They will all thank you when he is gone.

There's one big problem, to begin with.
texts.zh:
你要拆掉他这张蜘蛛网，把英仙座星域从他冷酷的操纵中解放出来。

等他倒了，所有人都会感谢你。

首先就有一个大问题。

texts.en:
You've told Fortuna Kato you'll back Achilles Andrada's bid to become Supreme Executor. By doing so, he'll tear down the Spider's web and free the Persean Sector from Macario's ruthless manipulation.

They will thank you when he is gone.

There's one big problem, to begin with.
texts.zh:
你已经告诉 Fortuna Kato，你会支持 Achilles Andrada 争夺最高元首之位。这样一来，他就能拆掉他这张蜘蛛网，把英仙座星域从 Macario 冷酷的操纵中解放出来。

等他倒了，他们会感谢你的。

首先就有一个大问题。

texts.en:
You'll tear down his Spider's web and free the Persean Sector from his ruthless manipulation.

You've even told Fortuna Kato that you'll back Achilles Andrada's bid to become Supreme Executor so long as she makes it worth your time. Her first payment was but a taste.

If Achilles wins, you get paid. If Achilles wins, Macario loses. What's not to like?

There's one big problem, to begin with.
texts.zh:
你要拆掉他这张蜘蛛网，把英仙座星域从他冷酷的操纵中解放出来。

你甚至已经告诉 Fortuna Kato，只要她出的价对得起你的时间，你就会支持 Achilles Andrada 争夺最高元首之位。她付的第一笔，不过是个开头。

Achilles 赢了，你拿钱。Achilles 赢了，Macario 就输了。有什么不好？

首先就有一个大问题。

texts.en:
You'll tear down his Spider's web and free the Persean Sector from his ruthless manipulation. You did deny Fortuna Kato's request to back Achilles' bid to become Supreme Executor, even if his victory would implicitly remove Macario from power.

You'll just have to ensure it happens by some other means.

And there's one big problem, to begin with.
texts.zh:
你要拆掉他这张蜘蛛网，把英仙座星域从他冷酷的操纵中解放出来。你确实拒绝了 Fortuna Kato 要你支持 Achilles 争夺最高元首之位的请求，尽管他的胜利会顺带让 Macario 失去权力。

你只能另想办法，确保这件事发生。

而首先，就有个大问题。

options.en: Macario is sitting safe behind the combined warfleets of the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: Macario 安稳地坐在辛达强权联合舰队的屏障之后。

texts.en:
Macario is a faithless manipulator who believes in nothing but his own power to play games with the lives of those around him. He'll cause more chaos and death before the end, unless someone can truly take charge of the Sindrian Diktat.

Not a puppet - a leader.

The true heir to Philip Andrada must rise.
texts.zh:
Macario 是个毫无信义的操弄者，除了自己那点玩弄他人性命的本事，他什么都不信。除非有人能真正接手辛达强权，否则在一切结束之前，他还会制造更多的混乱与死亡。

不是傀儡——是领袖。

Philip Andrada 真正的继承人必须站出来。

texts.en:
Macario is a faithless manipulator who believes in nothing, who wants nothing but to play cruel games with the lives of those in his power.

He'll cause more chaos and death - unless someone takes charge of the Sindrian Diktat and frees it from his corrupting influence.
texts.zh:
Macario 是个没有信念的操纵者，什么都不信，只想拿那些落到他手里的人的性命，玩残酷的游戏。

他会造出更多的混乱与死亡——除非有人接管辛达强权，把它从他腐蚀性的影响中解救出来。

options.en: Macario must be removed; Achilles should lead the Sindrian Diktat
options.zh: 必须除掉 Macario；辛达强权该由 Achilles 来领导

options.en: Macario must be removed; Hector should lead the Sindrian Diktat
options.zh: 必须除掉 Macario；辛达强权该由 Hector 来领导

options.en: It doesn't matter right now - Macario must be removed
options.zh: 现在这些都无所谓——必须除掉 Macario

texts.en: You decide that whatever happens, you need to remove Macario. Who will lead the Sindrian Diktat can be decided later.
texts.zh: 你决定，无论之后如何，Macario 都必须先除掉。至于谁来领导辛达强权，可以以后再说。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
You are a believer in the Sindrian Diktat, after all. Your bear a commission - or did until Macario declared it away.

Macario must be reminded of the power of loyalty - your own, above all - and his own to Andrada's vision. The pomp and intellectualization of the transcendent ideology is superstructure upon the fundamental fact that power flows to those who possess the will to seize and master it.
texts.zh:
毕竟，你信仰辛达强权。你持有它的委任状——至少在 Macario 宣布作废之前还持有。

必须让 Macario 想起忠诚的分量——尤其是你的忠诚——以及他对 Andrada 构想的忠诚。那套超凡意识形态的排场与高谈阔论，不过是上层建筑；底下那个根本事实是：权力归于那些有意志去夺取并驾驭它的人。

texts.en:
You are a believer in the power of the Sindrian Diktat, after all. Macario would wield that power, but he's a fool to try to discard his best ally in attaining power - perhaps even his better.

As satisfying as it would be to prove this to him by smashing down his office doors at the head of a squad of marines, this is a matter that requires opening with a round of negotiation.

Establishing a direct line of communication will be difficult. You cannot approach Sindria without being attacked, and if you prevailed against the defense fleets, wasting the power of the Diktat in senseless fighting does not serve your purpose.
texts.zh:
毕竟，你信仰辛达强权的力量。Macario 想驾驭这份力量，可若他在夺权的路上抛弃自己最好的盟友，那他就是个蠢货——那位盟友或许还比他更胜一筹。

带着一队陆战队砸开他办公室的大门、当面向他证明这一点，固然痛快，但这件事得先以一轮谈判开场。

建立一条直通线路会很困难。你一靠近 Sindria 就会遭到攻击；就算你压过了防御舰队，让强权的力量耗在无谓的厮杀里也达不到你的目的。

options.en: Continue
There must be another way...

texts.en: Establishing a direct line of communication will be difficult, however. You cannot approach Sindria without being attacked, and if you prevailed against the defense fleets, wasting the power of the Diktat in senseless fighting would undermine your cause.
texts.zh: 不过，建立一条直通线路会很困难。你一靠近 Sindria 就会遭到攻击；就算你压过了那些防御舰队，让强权的力量耗在这种无谓的厮杀里，也只会削弱你自己的事业。

options.en: There must be another way...

texts.en:
One comes to mind.

There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindria network. Then you could explain to Macario the mistake he's made and set everything right.
texts.zh:
有一个办法浮上心头。

Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支轻快而隐蔽的舰队可以潜入，黑进中继站，直接与 Sindria 的网络建立通讯链路。然后你就能向 Macario 说明他犯下的错误，把一切拨回正轨。

texts.en:
One comes to mind.

There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindria network. Then you could explain to Macario the mistake he's made and give him one last chance to correct himself before you show him the true meaning of power.
texts.zh:
有一个办法浮上心头。

Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支轻快而隐蔽的舰队可以潜入，黑进中继站，直接与 Sindria 的网络建立通讯链路。然后你就能向 Macario 说明他犯下的错误，在他见识到权力的真正含义之前，给他最后一次改过的机会。

options.en: I must confront Macario and make him recognize his error
options.zh: 我必须当面质问 Macario，让他认清自己的错误

options.en: It must be done. Macario must be shown the error of his ways
options.zh: 必须这么做。必须让 Macario 看清他错在哪里

texts.en:
He's put you in a tough spot and made himself your problem. Perhaps you can avoid Macario and the fallout from his schemes.

But Macario did declare you a psychotic, murderous terrorist in front of the entire Persean Sector, and the number one enemy of the Sindrian Diktat.

It won't be easy to ignore.
texts.zh:
他把你逼进一个难堪的境地，也把自己变成了你的麻烦。也许你可以避开 Macario，避开他那些算计带来的余波。

可 Macario 毕竟当着整个英仙座星域宣布你是个嗜血的疯子恐怖分子，是辛达强权的头号敌人。

想置之不理，没那么容易。

options.en: I'll just have to do my best

texts.en: It takes a moment for the bartender to realize who the shout came from - then they leap to obey, cowering apologetically.
texts.zh: 酒保花了一会儿才意识到喊声来自谁——然后他们连忙照办，畏缩着道歉。

texts.en:
You leave the bar flanked by bodyguards. Most of the patrons know better than to gawk at the executive leader of their present polity.

The corridors are quiet. Nonetheless, a squad of MuniSec joins your party, less from fear of a mob than the desire of the local section enforcer to earn your esteem.
texts.zh:
你在保镖的簇拥下离开酒吧。大多数顾客都知道不该盯着他们当前政体的行政首脑看。

走廊里很安静。尽管如此，一队市政安全兵加入了你的队伍，与其说是怕暴民，不如说是想...

texts.en:
"...with a co-conspirator, a high-level traitor within the very government of the Sindrian Diktat whose treachery sunk to supplying $playerName with one of the sacred Executors, a battleship designed by the Supreme Executor himself."

He looks down for a moment, as if steeling himself against the weight of the hurt and shame of this vile act.

"I shall not recklessly name her... or him, until my investigation is complete, but rest assured that justice shall be swift and sure. There will be..."

Then, from a couple tables over, another spacer turns to look toward you.
texts.zh:
"...还有一名同谋，一个就藏在辛达强权政府内部的高层叛徒，此人的背叛已堕落到向 $playerName 提供一艘神圣的 Executor 级战舰——那是最高元首亲手设计的战列舰。"

他低下头片刻，仿佛在硬扛这桩恶行带来的伤痛与羞辱。

"在调查完成之前，我不会轻率地点出她...或者他的名字，但请放心，正义必将迅速而确凿。接下来还会有..."

随后，隔了两张桌子，又一名太空人转头望向你。

texts.en:
"...with a co-conspirator, a high-level traitor within the very government of the Sindrian Diktat whose treachery sunk to supplying $playerName with one of the sacred Executors, a battleship designed by the Supreme Executor himself."

He looks down for a moment, as if steeling himself against the weight of the hurt and shame of this vile act.

"I shall not recklessly name her... or him, until my investigation is complete, but rest assured that justice shall be swift and sure. There will be..."

Then, from a couple tables over, another spacer turns to look toward you.
texts.zh:
...与一位同谋，辛达强权政府内部的一名高层叛徒——其背叛行径甚至到了向 $playerName 提供一台神圣 “执行者” 战舰的地步，那是一艘由最高执行者本人设计的战列舰。

他低头看着...

options.en: Time to leave
Enough, shut that off!
It appears to be time to leave

texts.en: "Shh." A spacer at the next table shushes you without looking away from the projection.
texts.zh: "嘘。"邻桌的一个太空人嘘了你一声，目光始终没离开投影。

texts.en:
The spacer at the next table turns, finally. "Hey, I'm trying to watch..."

They squint at you, then look back at the holo - it's cut away from your face. The spacer gives you one more skeptical look then return their attention to the holo-cast.
texts.zh:
邻桌的太空人终于转过头来。"喂，我正看着呢..."

他眯起眼打量你，随后回头看向全息影像——画面已经从你脸上切走了。那太空人又带着怀疑看了你一眼，便把注意力收回全息直播上。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: "Shh." A spacer at the next table shushes you without looking away from the projection.
texts.zh: "嘘。"邻桌的一个太空人嘘了你一声，目光始终没离开投影。

texts.en:
Your outcry is covered by another loud, jarring tone meant to contribute to the threatening image of you being constructed in holo-projectors across the Sector.

There's a quick aside about strange experiments being carried out in the Galatia system related to the recent jump-point disruption. A tenuous link is implied via reference to (mostly) redacted port logs which may - or may not - contain your fleet's ident-codes released by the Hegemony recovery and reconciliation committee.
texts.zh:
你的喊声被又一声刺耳的巨响盖过——那声响是刻意加进来的，好让全星域的全息投影共同塑造出的这个凶险的你，更显得可怖。

接着是一段简短的插叙：Galatia 星系正在进行的诡异实验，与最近的跳跃点中断有关。片中引用了一批 (大部分已涂黑的) 港口日志，借此暗示出一条脆弱的关联：那些日志里或许有、或许没有你舰队的识别码，而这些识别码正是霸主恢复与和解委员会放出的。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
The holo-stream at the center of the bar catches your eye as you spot a familiar face.

Your own.
texts.zh:
酒吧中央的全息流吸引了你的目光，你在上面看见一张熟面孔。

你自己的。

options.en: Hey, turn it up!
Just watch
Lean back into the shadow a little more, and watch
options.zh: 再往阴影里靠一靠，静静看着

texts.en: The bartender dutifully acknowledges your shout with a gesture, and the volume increases noticeably.
texts.zh: 酒保尽职地抬手应了你的喊声，音量明显调高了。

texts.en:
Your face in the holo is replaced by that of one 'Syzygy Nane', a holo-star out of Westernesse - notable as a striking example of cosmetic modification achieving a mode of avant-garde which doesn't quite dip into outlandishness, but, at least, orbits it.

And they're talking about you.

"-from those official Sindrian holos, then I have a space elevator to sell you!"

Laughter. Audience reaction shot - assembled by software in what must have been real-time from viewers within reasonable lightspeed delay, the crowd demonstrates a peculiar mix of fashion and holo-avatars.
texts.zh:
你在全息影像里的脸被换成了"Syzygy Nane"——一位来自 Westernesse 的全息明星，堪称整容改造的醒目范例：那副前卫做派始终没真滑向怪诞，但至少绕着它打转。

而且他们正在谈论你。

"——这些话要是出自辛达的官方全息片，那我这儿还有台太空电梯要卖给你！"

笑声。观众反应镜头——想必是由软件从光速延迟范围内的观众那里实时汇编而成，人群呈现出时尚与全息化身混杂交错的怪相。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
An ominous chord is struck, summoning banners of the Sindrian Diktat. A tiny, dancing Dolos Macario, his head over-large, like a child's puppet appears from between them.

Nane provides his voice, squeaking and whining about the 'degenerate spacer, mass-murderer $playerName!' overtop a small feed of the Sindrian Diktat propaganda - sped up, altered to look cheap and tawdry, somehow, its somber outrage undermined with effects trickery.

"Maybe," says Nane reasonably, setting aside the mini-Dolos voice, "there's something more to the story..."
texts.zh:
一段不祥的和弦响起，辛达强权的旗帜随之浮现。一个小小的、跳着舞的 Dolos Macario，脑袋大得不成比例，像个孩童玩偶，从旗帜之间钻了出来。

Nane 替他配音，尖声尖气地抱怨着那个'堕落太空人、杀人魔 $playerName！'，背景是一小段辛达强权的宣传片——被调了速度、改得廉价粗劣，那股庄重义愤不知怎么就败在了特效把戏之下。

"也许，\" Nane 收起小 Dolos 的嗓音，通情达理地说，\"这故事背后还有别的东西..."

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Nane narrates, making you out to be not so much a mass-murderer as a luckless spacer. Well-intentioned on the whole, if a bit naive.

It plays a bit into the unfortunate stereotype of the dazed, undersocialized spacer who is taken advantage of by fast-talking, cosmopolitan dirt-siders.

Your reappearance in the holo breaks your stream of thought away from musing on your self-image.
texts.zh:
Nane 娓娓道来，把你塑造成一个不太像杀人魔、倒更像倒霉太空人的角色。总体上心地不坏，只是有点天真。

这多少迎合了那个不幸的刻板印象：一个懵懂、不善交际的太空人，被油嘴滑舌的都市地面人占了便宜。

你在全息影像里再次露面，打断了你对自我形象的沉思。

options.en: Watch

texts.en:
There you are again, walking across the entry lounge of the Galatia Academy. Cut to outside of Hercules' office. You knock, and are let in. Time compression; a moment later Benoit leaves.

Time returns to its normal flow as a figure, blurred by active camo, appears and suddenly fires through the door. They pause a moment to shift their weapon and toss a grenade through the shredded doorway.

More fighting.

It ends showing you stumbling, dazed, from the ruined office, held up by two emergency response technicians. A victim.
texts.zh:
又是你，正走过 Galatia 学院的门厅。镜头切到 Hercules 办公室门外。你敲门，被让了进去。时间被压缩；片刻之后，Benoit 走了出来。

时间恢复常速，一个被主动伪装模糊着的身影现身，突然朝门内开火。他们停顿片刻，调整武器，往支离破碎的门口扔进一枚手雷。

更多交火。

最后是你在两名应急响应技师的搀扶下，恍惚地从残破的办公室走出来。一个受害者。

texts.en:
There you are again, walking across the entry lounge of the Galatia Academy. Cut to outside of an academician's office. You recognize it - presumably the spot where an attack was carried out on Hercules Cyrino.

You reflect that you still have no idea if he survived or not.

Cut to port logs, a quick cross. your $shipOrFleet the date highlights. Other side: surveillance feed of the office, its door caught receiving fire from a frag burst - frozen in time. Timestamped. Nane appears between them, examining one, then the other.

"How odd," Nane says, with a quizzical look. "I may just be a humble drop-out, but it looks like they don't match?"
texts.zh:
又是你，正走过 Galatia 学院的门厅。镜头切到一位院士的办公室外。你认得这里——想必就是 Hercules Cyrino 遇袭的地点。

你回想起来，自己至今不知道他是否活了下来。

镜头切到港口记录，一个快速的对照。你的 $shipOrFleet，日期被高亮标出。另一侧：办公室的监控画面，房门正被一枚破片弹击中——时间凝固。带时间戳。Nane 出现在两者之间，先看一个，再看另一个。

"真奇怪，\" Nane 面露疑惑，\"我可能只是个不值一提的退学生，可这两边看着对不上啊？"

options.en: Continue
Continue

texts.en:
"-more excitement than I ever had in tertiary education, and believe me, we knew how to party!"

This, to mini-Dolos, who nods and begins to dance.

"But" Nane gives mini-Dolos a little shove, and he falls on his bottom. "It's pretty obvious $playerName was the target of-"

Did Provost Baird cooperate to provide this security feed?

A bribe, or a hack?
texts.zh:
"——比我在大学时代经历过的任何刺激都多，相信我，我们那会儿可会玩了！"

这话是对小 Dolos 说的，他点点头，跳起舞来。

"不过——\" Nane 轻轻推了小 Dolos 一把，他一屁股坐倒在地。\"明摆着，$playerName 才是目标——"

是院长 Baird 配合提供了这段监控画面吗？

是贿赂，还是入侵？

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"-a good time on Qaras," Nane continues, "believe me, you DON'T want to-"

There you are again, a grainy security sensor feed outside the bar. A huge goon puts a gun in your face...

"-can you believe this?"

Laughter. Audience reaction shots. A gesture and some meaningless words referencing some youth trend that hasn't broken out of the Westernesse system quite yet.
texts.zh:
"——在 Qaras 玩得开心，\" Nane 接着说，\"相信我，你绝对不想——"

又是你，酒吧外一段满是噪点的保安传感器画面。一个彪形大汉把枪口顶到你脸上...

"——你敢信吗？"

笑声。观众反应镜头。一个手势，外加几句没什么意义的词，引用了某种还没传出 Westernesse 星系的青年潮流。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Nane shifts to explaining the logs of a private courier operation to an increasingly uncomfortable mini-Dolos, dates and names highlighted. Low-profile shuttles to an obscure asteroid in the Hybrasil system.

Altered medical reports - a series of deaths, covered up over a period of many cycles before you ever found Elysium.

"Oh, that's awkward isn't it?" Nane exchanges looks with mini-Dolos, who shrugs in faux-innocence.
texts.zh:
Nane 转而向越来越坐立不安的小 Dolos 解说一桩私人信使业务的记录，日期与姓名被逐一高亮。低调的穿梭机飞往 Hybrasil 星系一颗偏僻的小行星。

被篡改的医疗报告——一连串死亡，在你发现 Elysium 之前，已经被掩盖了许多个星历年。

"哦，这可有点尴尬，是吧？" Nane 与小 Dolos 交换了个眼神，后者故作无辜地耸了耸肩。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Next is a clip from the other 'cast, the one from the real Macario. The words ORTHRUS MURDER: FATHER MOURNS SON in glowing blood-red.

The words shrink, as if the air was let out of them, and flop onto the ground under Nane's sardonic expression. Mini-Dolos attempts to lift the words back up, behind him the mockery-edit of real Macario's original propaganda holo, but the words prove too floppy and awkward, and finally he throws up his arms and sulks in frustration.
texts.zh:
接下来是另一档节目的片段，真正 Macario 那一档。血红色的发光大字：ORTHRUS 凶案：父亲哀悼儿子。

那些字缩小了，仿佛被抽干了气，软塌塌地掉到地上，Nane 脸上挂着嘲讽。小 Dolos 试图把字重新举起来，身后是真 Macario 原版宣传全息片的戏仿剪辑版，可那些字软得实在别扭，最后他只能扬起双臂，气恼地生闷气。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"If murder was the goal," says Nane, "why did Maeus Moroz get the last shot?"

From a high angle, a grimy feed. There's you and Maeus Moroz, sharing a drink. He looks gruff, but is nodding his head at your words. The bartender sets two small glasses down, and Moroz immediately empties his.
texts.zh:
"如果目标是谋杀，\" Nane 说，\"那最后一枪为什么是 Maeus Moroz 开的？"

高角度拍摄，一段脏兮兮的画面。你和 Maeus Moroz 在共饮。他脸色阴沉，却对你的话点着头。酒保放下两只小杯，Moroz 立刻一饮而尽。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Methinks," Nane's head and voice tilt in a signature mid-sentence re-pitch, "a little spider's web of lies is looking a lit...tle convenient when you consider recent events..."

A tiny Hector and Achilles join the mini-Dolos, though child-sized even to him.

Immediately, they begin to fight, and for a moment it looks like Dolos might play the adult before - being the blackguard he is - tries to smack Achilles. With comic irony, little bully Hector sweeps Achilles' legs, allowing Dolos' hand to connect with Hector instead, and...

Meanwhile, a fat little Horacio Caden appears, completely unaware of the conflict, stumbling with a bottle in hand...
texts.zh:
"依我看，\" Nane 的头与声音在句中标志性地一偏，语调随之一变，\"一张小小的谎言蛛网，放到近来这些事里去看，可就显得有那么...点儿太方便了..."

一个小小的 Hector 和 Achilles 加入进来，站在小 Dolos 旁边，个头却连对他都算孩童尺寸。

他们立刻打作一团，有一瞬间，倒像是 Dolos 要扮演一回大人——可紧接着，他这个恶棍就去扇 Achilles 了。讽刺的是，小恶霸 Hector 一记扫腿把 Achilles 绊倒，让 Dolos 的手正好落在 Hector 身上，于是...

与此同时，一个胖乎乎的小 Horacio Caden 出现，完全没察觉那边的冲突，手里拎着酒瓶摇摇晃晃地走过来...

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Nane's arms lift, sweeping away the whole comic-bizarre scene. The image dims and desaturates.

"I'm just your lovely everyday holo-friend, fellow Syzygens, but even I didn't have to look too close before the official story started unraveling. But first-"

Nane pivots seamlessly into an ad-read for an esoteric insurance scheme. A few spacers close to the bar grow bored and, at their behest, the bartender adjusts the holo stream.
texts.zh:
Nane 抬起双臂，把整幅滑稽荒诞的场景一扫而空。影像转暗，褪去色彩。

"我不过是你们可爱的日常全息朋友，各位 Syzygen 同胞，可就连我也不用凑得太近，官方的说法就开始崩线了。不过首先——"

Nane 无缝转进一段玄乎保险方案的广告口播。吧台边几个太空人听腻了，应他们要求，酒保调了调全息流。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: Whatever that was, it must have been what you paid Faro Inesis to arrange.
texts.zh: 不管那是什么，肯定是你花钱请 Faro Inesis 安排的那一出。

texts.en: Whatever that was, it must have been what you paid Arroyo to arrange.
texts.zh: 不管那是什么，肯定是你花钱请 Arroyo 安排的那一出。

texts.en: Whatever that was, it must have been what Orcus Rao arranged to help with your reputation. You shake your head to think that part of the Hegemony's black-ops budget went to pay for it.
texts.zh: 不管那是什么，肯定都是 Orcus Rao 为帮你挽回名声安排的那一出。想到霸主的黑色行动预算有一部分花在了这上面，你不禁摇头。

texts.en: Whatever that was, it must have been what Finlay Siyavong arranged to help with your reputation. You shake your head to think that part of the Persean League's black-ops budget went to pay for it.
texts.zh: 不管那是什么，肯定都是 Finlay Siyavong 为帮你挽回名声安排的那一出。想到英仙座联盟的黑色行动预算有一部分花在了这上面，你不禁摇头。

texts.en: Whatever that was, it must have been what Fortuna Kato arranged to help with your reputation. You shake your head to think that part of Gens Kato's budget went to pay for it.
texts.zh: 不管那是什么，肯定都是 Fortuna Kato 为帮你挽回名声安排的那一出。想到 Kato 氏族的预算有一部分花在了这上面，你不禁摇头。

texts.en: Whatever that was, it seems to have been designed to undermine Macario's efforts to destroy your reputation by making a farce of him and his narrative of somber outrage.
texts.zh: 不管那是什么，看来目的都是要拆 Macario 的台：他本想毁掉你的名声，如今他自己和他那套沉痛义愤的说辞反倒成了笑柄。

texts.en:
Hopefully it works.

As if in answer, a couple of spacers walking by do a double-take in recognition and... it's not fear, or hatred, but awkward acknowledgement. Their look seems to say 'dirt-siders, right? Mistake to trust them'.

You look back to the bar.
texts.zh:
但愿这有用。

像是回应一般，几个路过的太空人认出你来，愣了一下，回头又看——那神情不是恐惧，也不是憎恨，而是尴尬的会意。他们的眼神仿佛在说：'地面人嘛，对吧？信他们就是个错'。

你转回头看向吧台。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: "I have them," he says.
texts.zh: "护卫我有。"他说。

texts.en:
"There's a spacer bar," he continues. "You'll know of it. And if you don't, you'll be directed to it. We shall settle what is to be done."

He hits the comms shut-off.
texts.zh:
"有一家太空佬酒吧。\"他接着说。\"你会知道是哪家。就算不知道，也会有人给你指路。该办的事，我们到那儿定。"

他按下了通讯切断键。

options.en:
Cut the comm link and shuttle to Yesod Station
#cutCommLink:Cut the comm link
options.zh:
切断通讯，坐穿梭机去 Yesod 空间站
#cutCommLink:切断通讯链接

texts.en: "I have means, captain."
texts.zh: "我有门路，舰长。"

texts.en: His expression is level, and stern.
texts.zh: 他的神色平静而严峻。

texts.en: "I will not hide."
texts.zh: "我不会躲。"

texts.en: His brow raises fractionally, as if to say, you?
texts.zh: 他的眉头抬了抬，仿佛在说：你？

texts.en: "Let them try," he says softly.
texts.zh: "让他们试试。"他轻声说。

texts.en: His brow raises fractionally, as if to say, you?
texts.zh: 他的眉头抬了抬，仿佛在说：你？

texts.en: He does not answer; his expression is stern.
texts.zh: 他没有回答，神色严峻。

texts.en:
"The Hegemony," he says with a scowl. "Don't be naive. I will not hide."

He re-examines you.
texts.zh:
"霸主。\"他皱眉道。\"别天真了。我不会躲。"

他重新把你打量了一遍。

texts.en: His lip twitches once, but he remains collected.
texts.zh: 他的嘴唇抽动了一下，随即又恢复镇定。

texts.en:
He looks over you for a long moment before responding.

"That's what lots of people heard."
texts.zh:
他打量了你许久，才开口。

"很多人听到的就是这个版本。"

options.en: You're saying it didn't happen?
options.zh: 你是说那件事根本没发生？

texts.en:
"Not like that." He pauses for a moment, then says, "What is it you want, spacer."

The latent irritation makes his question into a demand: explain yourself.
texts.zh:
"不是那么回事。\"他顿了顿，才说，\"你想要什么，太空佬。"

那股按着的火气把他的问话压成了一道命令：说清楚你的来意。

texts.en:
He looks over you for a long moment before responding.

"They told everyone it was a bar fight." After another pause, he speaks, "What is it you want, spacer."

The latent irritation makes his question into a demand: explain yourself.
texts.zh:
他打量了你许久，才开口。

"他们对外说那是一场酒吧斗殴。\"又停了一阵，他才开口，\"你想要什么，太空佬。"

那股按着的火气把他的问话压成了一道命令：说清楚你的来意。

texts.en:
"Everyone is someone's pawn, captain," he says. A touch of amusement appears on his lips. "Until they're not."

His eyes drill into you. It's that intense Andrada look, familiar from the propaganda holos. Self-confident to the point of hubris. The eyes that watched as fleets burned in the skies of Askonia.
texts.zh:
"每个人都是某人的棋子，舰长。\"他说，唇边浮起一点玩味。\"直到不再是为止。"

他的目光钉进你眼里。那是 Andrada 家特有的逼人眼神，宣传全息里常见的那种。自信到近乎狂妄。就是这双眼睛，看着舰队在 Askonia 诸世界的天空中烧成火海。

texts.en:
"I am well aware," he says, unflinching.

"And who are you to come here, to Yesod, and tell me this?"
texts.zh:
"我很清楚。"他说，面不改色。

"那你又是谁，跑到 Yesod 来，对我说这些？"

options.en: Did someone already come for you? An assassin?
options.zh: 已经有人来找过你了？刺客？

options.en: That was one assassin. Do you have any idea what you're up against?
options.zh: 那只是一个刺客。你知道自己面对的是什么吗？

options.en: I am $playerName. The question is who you are.
Because you're a clone of Philip Andrada.
options.zh: 因为你是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体。

options.en: I am $playerName. And you know you're a clone of Philip Andrada.
options.zh: 我是 $playerName。而你自己清楚，你是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体。

texts.en:
He tilts his head ever so slightly, gaze locked through the comms.

Making a point of giving you no answer.
texts.zh:
他极轻微地偏了偏头，目光透过通讯链接钉在你身上。

摆明了不打算答你。

texts.en:
His eyes drill into you.

It's that intense Andrada look, familiar from the propaganda holos. Self-confident to the point of hubris. The eyes that watched as fleets burned in the skies of Askonia.

He knows.
texts.zh:
他的目光钉进你眼里。

那是 Andrada 家特有的逼人眼神，宣传全息里常见的那种。自信到近乎狂妄。就是这双眼睛，看着舰队在 Askonia 诸世界的天空中烧成火海。

他知道了。

options.en: Did Fleet Intelligence tell you? Was it Siyavong?
options.zh: 是舰队情报部告诉你的？Siyavong？

options.en: You already know, don't you.

texts.en:
The touch of a self-satisfied smile appears. Achilles nods; a gesture of respect for catching on so quickly.

"I suspected," he says. "So did Fleet Intel, for quite some time. Siyavong confirmed it when he finally contacted me."
texts.zh:
他唇上浮起一丝自得的笑。Achilles 点了点头——那是敬你反应这么快的意思。

"我早怀疑过。\"他说。\"舰队情报部也是，已经很久了。Siyavong 终于联系上我的时候，把这件事确认了下来。"

texts.en:
He barely reacts to your revelation.

Instead, his eyes drill into you. It's that intense Andrada look, familiar from the propaganda holos. Self-confident to the point of hubris. The eyes that watched as fleets burned in the skies of Askonian.
texts.zh:
你揭出的这件事没让他起什么反应。

他只是把目光钉进你眼里。那是 Andrada 家特有的逼人眼神，宣传全息里常见的那种。自信到近乎狂妄。就是这双眼睛，看着舰队在 Askonia 诸世界的天空中烧成火海。

options.en: You already know.

texts.en:
"Help me." His words are deadpan, unbelieving.

"Why would you help me? Who even are you?"
texts.zh:
"帮帮我。"他的语气平板，透着不信。

"你为什么要帮我？你到底是什么人？"

"Nope, don't know him."

texts.en:
$Post $personLastName gives you a look, then glances down at a datapad and taps something.

"It would be inappropriate to discuss internal Fleet affairs. Especially with a commissioned auxiliary of the Hegemony."

$HeOrShe reaches for the comms cut-off.

"Good day, captain."

"谈论舰队内部事务是不合适的。尤其是对一个持有霸主委任状的辅助人员。"

$HeOrShe 伸手去按通讯切断键。

"日安，舰长。"

texts.en:
$Post $personLastName gives you a look, then glances down at a datapad and taps something. Then looks back up at you, wearily.

"I don't make it a habit of discussing internal Fleet affairs, $titlePL. Even with those who bear our commission. I have orders to be highly discrete in matters involving Lieutenant Kalian after the... incident."
texts.zh:
$Post $personLastName 看了你一眼，随后低头看了看数据板，敲了几下，又疲惫地抬眼看向你。

"我不习惯谈论舰队内部事务，$titlePL。哪怕对方持有我们的委任状也一样。在那件... 事之后，凡涉及 Kalian 中尉，我都奉命必须极度谨慎。"

texts.en:
$Post $personLastName gets an annoyed look.

"Yes? A lieutenant you say? I'm an administrator of the civilian polity, captain. Ask someone from Fleet about your lieutenant, like our local station commander."

$HeOrShe sighs.

"Did you have anything relevant to my duties to discuss?"
texts.zh:
$Post $personLastName 露出一脸的不耐烦。

"有事？你说一位中尉？舰长，我是民政管理机构的行政官。你那位中尉的事，去问舰队里的人，比如我们本地的空间站指挥官。"

$HeOrShe 叹了口气。

"你还有什么事，是跟我的职责有关的吗？"

texts.en:
"Kalian, Kalian..." $HeOrShe looks up, rubbing $hisOrHer ear.

After a moment, $hisOrHer eyes light up. "Lieutenant Kalian, of course."

"Recent transfer. Fine young man. Such potential! Couldn't tell you why he got assigned to Yesod, but they don't tell the quartermaster anything, ha-ha."
texts.zh:
"Kalian，Kalian..."$HeOrShe 抬起头，揉着$hisOrHer的耳朵。

过了一会儿，$hisOrHer 的眼睛亮了起来。"Kalian 中尉，当然。"

"最近刚调来的。好小伙子。多有潜质！他为什么被派到 Yesod，我可说不出来——不过他们什么都不会告诉军需官，哈哈。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe thinks for a moment.

"The station commander was not happy. Sent out a memo about military-civil relations. I'm Fleet, captain. Need to keep everyone happy, military and commercial alike."

"If one of mine got in a fight," $heOrShe says, "they'd be cleaning the heads for a month. That's all I'll say about that."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe想了一会儿。

"空间站指挥官很不高兴，发了一份关于军民关系的通告。我是舰队的人，舰长。军方也好，商界也好，两头都得哄好。"

"要是我手下有人打了这么一架，\"$heOrShe说，\"就得刷一个月厕所。这话我就说到这儿。"

texts.en: "That it happened," $heOrShe says. "Kalian and some spacer, I think? The station commander was not happy, sent out a memo about military-civil relations."
texts.zh: "听说确实打了。\"$heOrShe说。\"Kalian 和某个太空佬，好像是？空间站指挥官很不高兴，发了一份关于军民关系的通告。"

texts.en:
"That it happened," $heOrShe says. "Kalian and some spacer, I think? The station commander was not happy, sent out a memo about military-civil relations."

"You sure didn't help, did you," $heOrShe adds. "I'd stay out of the station commander's way if I were you."
texts.zh:
"听说确实打了。\"$heOrShe说。\"Kalian 和某个太空佬，好像是？空间站指挥官很不高兴，发了一份关于军民关系的通告。"

"你肯定没帮上忙，是吧。\"$heOrShe补了一句。\"换作我，就离空间站指挥官远点。"

"Sorry, that's all I've got."

texts.en:
"No. Just that he got in a fight. I suppose it wasn't with you?"

$HeOrShe pauses a moment, looking to see if you'll volunteer anything, then shrugs.

"Anyway, have you got some business to discuss?"
texts.zh:
"没有。只听说他打了一架。我猜不是跟你打？"

$HeOrShe顿了顿，看着你会不会主动说点什么，然后耸了耸肩。

"总之，你有没有什么事要谈？"

$HeOrShe reaches for the comms cut-off.

"Good day, captain."

texts.en:
$HeOrShe looks at you from overtop a datapad.

"Yes, I see now. And you were involved. Threw the first punch, as the surveillance proved. Struck a cadet of the Persean League Navy. Then you were told to leave."

The $post takes a deep breath.

"We're being very lenient with you, captain." $HeOrShe reaches for the comms cut-off.

"Good day and good-bye."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 从数据板上方看着你。

"对，我现在看明白了。而且你也有份。监控记录证实，是你先动的手。你打的是英仙座联盟海军的一名学员。然后你被要求离开。"

$post 深吸了一口气。

"我们对你是非常宽容了，舰长。"$HeOrShe 伸手去按通讯切断键。

"日安，再见。"

$HeOrShe reaches for the comms cut-off.

"Good day, captain."

texts.en:
"You get a feel for it in my position," $heOrShe says, lifting $hisOrHer chin. "Some new officers, they expect you to come to them and beg for a requisition list. As if I need to make more work for myself!"

"Kalian, he showed before his first duty shift. Polite, to-the-point, organized. Practically did my job for me - with a fine salute, on top."

$HeOrShe leans back, smiling, "And he did all of that looking bruised and battered like he'd fell down from orbit! Made an impression, I tell you. And, ha-ha, he must have made an impression on some spacer scu- some, er, unruly individuals at the bar."
texts.zh:
"在我这个位置上，你自然会有感觉，\"$heOrShe 扬起 $hisOrHer 下巴说道，\"有些新来的军官，还指望你上门去求一份申领单。好像我嫌自己活儿不够多似的！"

"Kalian 呢，头一班岗之前就来找我了。有礼貌，说话干脆，办事有条理。简直把我的活儿替我干了——末了还敬了个漂亮的礼。"

$HeOrShe 靠回椅背，笑吟吟的，"而且他做这些的时候，一身青一块紫一块，活像从轨道上摔下来过！跟你说，印象深得很。还有，哈哈，他大概也给酒吧里那几个太空佬渣... 那个，不太守规矩的家伙，留下了点印象。"

texts.en:
"Oh, I don't know," $heOrShe says.

"Like I said, I'm the quartermaster. It's always 'we need this list of materiel and we need it yesterday'. Now if they'd bothered to plan ahead and comms me for a chat to let me know what's been planned, maybe drop off an extra crate of this or that, it'd make everyone's life easier."

$PersonLastName shakes $hisOrHer head.
texts.zh:
"哦，我可说不清，"$heOrShe 说道。

"像我说的，我是军需官。永远是'这份物资清单我们昨天就要'。要是他们肯提前规划，跟我通个话聊聊打算怎么办，也许再顺手多送一箱这个那个过来，大家日子都好过。"

$PersonLastName 摇了摇 $hisOrHer 的头。

texts.en:
"I don't know about that, $playerSirOrMadam." $HeOrShe drums a few fingers on $hisOrHer console with a renewed look of concern for regulations.

"If it's not a request from Fleet, I can't just give out the comms IDs of an officer unless it's been approved."

$HeOrShe shrugs. "Sorry."
texts.zh:
"这个我可不敢说，$playerSirOrMadam。"$HeOrShe 用几根手指在 $hisOrHer 控制台上敲了敲，脸上又浮出那种对规章的顾虑。

"要不是舰队发来的请求，我不能随便把一名军官的通讯识别码交出去，除非已经批了。"

$HeOrShe 耸了耸肩。"抱歉。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe smiles and shakes $hisOrHer head.

"No, I'll not be taking a bribe. Quartermaster's privilege is one thing, but there's some matters you don't stick fingers in if you want to keep all ten or so."

"And Lieutenant Kalian? I want the best for him, I suppose. He was polite. No gens-baby, that one."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 笑了笑，摇了摇 $hisOrHer 的头。

"不行，我不受贿。军需官有军需官的门路，这是一回事；可有些事，想保住十根手指就别往里伸。"

"至于 Kalian 中尉？我倒是希望他好。他懂礼貌。不是那种氏族少爷，那一个不是。"

options.en: I understand. I apologize if I overstepped propriety.
options.zh: 我明白。若是我失了分寸，还望见谅。

options.en: I do too. I'm looking for him because his life may be in danger.
options.zh: 我也希望他好。我找他，是因为他可能有性命之忧。

texts.en: "I've already forgotten," $heOrShe says with a wink.
texts.zh: "我已经忘了，"$heOrShe 眨了眨眼说道。

texts.en:
Now $heOrShe looks concerned.

"Don't know what that might be about, captain, and I don't want to know. Sounds like it's above my pay grade. I think you should talk to the station commander."
texts.zh:
$heOrShe 此刻露出了关切的神色。

"不知道那会是什么事，舰长，我也不想知道。听起来不是我这点薪水该操心的。我看你该去找空间站指挥官谈谈。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe looks down, pokes at an interface, and frowns.

"So you are."

More tapping at the interface. The frown deepens.

"Looks like his comms ID really has been classified by FleetInt. So no luck, captain. Maybe Kalian got into a fight with the wrong spacer, eh?"

"I'm sorry, but I'm not going to step on FleetInt's toes for you, $playerSirOrMadam. Best of luck finding Lieutenant Kalian."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 低下头，戳了戳界面，皱起眉。

"所以确实是。"

又在界面上敲了几下。眉头皱得更紧。

"看来他的通讯识别码真被舰队情报部列为机密了。那就没办法了，舰长。也许 Kalian 是跟不该惹的太空佬打了一架，嗯？"

"抱歉，我可不会为了你去踩舰队情报部的脚，$playerSirOrMadam。祝你顺利找到 Kalian 中尉。"

texts.en: "M'pleasure," $personLastName says and gives a casual salute before signing off the link.
texts.zh: "好说，"$personLastName 说着，随意敬了个礼，随后切断了通讯链路。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe pauses for a moment, then speaks.

"That's the story, yes. But it wasn't a bar fight - it was a targeted attack. An assassination attempt."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 顿了顿，才开口。

"对外是这么说，没错。可那不是酒吧斗殴——那是针对性的袭击。一次暗杀企图。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe pauses for a moment, then speaks.

"Cover story was he got in a bar fight. But it wasn't - it was a targeted attack. An assassination attempt."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 顿了顿，才开口。

"对外说他在酒吧打了架。其实不是——那是针对性的袭击。一次暗杀企图。"

texts.en: "Strange, though. Wasn't Pathers that did it, or ANTIs or anything like that. And why a lieutenant? Kalian was impressive in the academy, but he's nobody. No history, no gens."
texts.zh: "可这事透着古怪。动手的不是左径分子，也不是 ANTI 或者那一类人。而且为什么是一名中尉？Kalian 在军官学院里很出色，可他没什么分量。没有履历，没有家世。"

options.en: Huh. Weird. I'd like to speak with him - do you have his comms ID?
options.zh: 嗯。怪事。我想跟他谈谈——你有他的通讯识别码吗？

options.en: It's probably because he's a clone of Philip Andrada
options.zh: 大概因为他是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体

texts.en:
$HeOrShe sighs.

"Sorry, $playerLastName. Direct orders."

"We should wrap. Weird business going around, like some Fleet Intelligence op. I don't like it, but no one asked me or told me anything."

"That'll be you too, if you know what's good for you. Give me a stand-up fight, stick to your guns - those you can count on."

$HeOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat and reaches for the comms cut-off. "Good day, then."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 叹了口气。

"抱歉，$playerLastName。这是直接命令。"

"我们就到这儿吧。最近在办些古怪的事，像是舰队情报部的行动。我不喜欢，可没人问过我，也没人告诉我什么。"

"你要是识相，也会落得同样的处境。给我一场堂堂正正的仗，守住你的炮位——那些才靠得住。"

$HeOrShe 清了清 $hisOrHer 嗓子，伸手去按通讯切断键。"那么，日安。"

texts.en:
$Post $PersonLastName stares at you for a long, long moment. Processing.

"$TitlePL," $heOrShe says finally. "Your comms signal must have had a glitch, it seems like your last statement got garbled."

"I believe we must now conclude our discussion. I have... a meeting. To attend."

$HeOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat and reaches for the comms cut-off.

"Good day, then."
texts.zh:
$Post $PersonLastName 久久地盯着你。像是在消化什么。

"$TitlePL，\"$heOrShe 终于开口，\"你的通讯信号恐怕出了故障——你最后那句话似乎串了音。"

"我想我们的谈话该到此为止了。我还有个... 会要赴。"

$HeOrShe 清了清 $hisOrHer 嗓子，伸手去按通讯切断键。

"那么，日安。"

texts.en:
"Captain $PlayerLastName."

$personName's voice is as calm as quiet death.

"I hope we are not here to repeat any provocative fabrications."
texts.zh:
"$PlayerLastName 舰长。"

$personName 的声音平静得像无声的死。

"希望我们不是来重复那些挑衅性的捏造的。"

options.en: I'm looking for a young man called Perseus Saturnian.
options.zh: 我在找一个叫 Perseus Saturnian 的年轻人。

texts.en:
"Of course," he says blandly.

"We have many guests here, and the directors of Mbaye-Gogol consider their privacy a core principle of the Cryosanctum. It is perhaps our utmost principle; a pillar of the corporation. We have a reputation spanning... generations."

Blanc's face is barely animate. When his lips move, it is as if a corpse has been compelled to twitch by embedded electrodes.

"So I am sure you understand why I cannot confirm or deny the presence of any individual."
texts.zh:
"当然，"他语气平淡地说。

"我们这里有许多客人，而 Mbaye-Gogol 的董事们把他们的隐私视为冷冻圣所的核心原则。这或许是我们最高的原则，是公司的支柱。我们的声誉已经延续了... 好几代人。"

Blanc 的脸上几乎没有活气。他的嘴唇动起来时，就像一具尸体被埋入的电极逼着抽动。

"所以我相信你能理解，为什么我既不能确认、也不能否认任何人的存在。"

options.en: I'm looking for Perseus Andrada, heir to the Supreme Executor.
options.zh: 我在找 Perseus Andrada，最高元首的继承人。

options.en: I have questions about an operation performed here by a Doctor Cydonia.
options.zh: 关于一位 Cydonia 医生在这里做的一台手术，我有几个问题。

texts.en:
"It would be inappropriate to speculate on the alleged activities of hypothetical guests or employees, whether on-contract or... permanent staff."

Blanc speaks soothingly, like quiet death.

"Please accept my apologies, captain."
texts.zh:
"对假设中的客人或雇员的所谓活动加以揣测，是不合适的——无论他们是合同人员，还是... 长期员工。"

Blanc 的语气安抚人心，像安静的死亡。

"请接受我的歉意，舰长。"

texts.en:
"It is as I explained," Blanc says, his voice suffocatingly soothing.

"It would be inappropriate to discuss the hypothetical activities of guests or employees, whether permanent staff or... contracted."

His attempt at a sad, apologetic smile mostly fails.
texts.zh:
"正如我解释过的，"Blanc 说，声音安抚得令人窒息。

"讨论客人或雇员——无论长期员工还是... 合同人员——的假设性活动，是不合适的。"

他试图挤出一个悲伤而歉意的微笑，基本失败了。

options.en: I'm forced to be direct. Perseus Andrada died here. Because of Doctor Cydonia.
options.zh: 我只能直说。Perseus Andrada 死在这里。因为 Cydonia 医生。

texts.en:
"It is a provocative scenario you propose," he says, blinking slowly. "We do our utmost to avoid any such excitement."

"Now," he looks aside, "I'm afraid I have a most pressing engagement which cannot be delayed. Until another time, captain?"
texts.zh:
"你提出的情形很有挑衅性，"他说，缓缓眨着眼，"我们竭尽全力避免任何这类刺激。"

"那么，\"他看向一旁，\"恐怕我有个极其紧迫的约见，不能耽搁。改日再谈，舰长？"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
He doesn't wait for your response before tapping a comms block and cut-off command.

Perhaps he'll speak with you again in a day or so, after he's cooled off.
texts.zh:
他还没等你回应，就按下通讯阻断与切断指令。

也许过一两天他会再找你谈。等他冷静下来。

options.en: Cut the comm link

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

options.en: I had an interesting conversation with your quartermaster.
options.zh: 我跟你的军需官有过一次很有意思的谈话。

texts.en: "Oh?" He barely raises an eyebrow.
texts.zh: "哦？"他连眉毛都几乎没动一下。

options.en: I've confirmed that Doctor Cydonia attempted an operation on Perseus Saturnian.
options.zh: 我已确认，Cydonia 博士曾试图对 Perseus Saturnian 施行手术。

texts.en: He blinks, once.
texts.zh: 他眨了一下眼。

options.en: And it failed. Perseus was sent to 'bioprocessing'. His parts were sold off.
options.zh: 而且失败了。Perseus 被送去'生物处理'。他的器官被拆开卖掉了。

texts.en: Blanc sighs a long, drawn out sigh.
texts.zh: Blanc 长长地叹了一口气，拖得很慢。

texts.en: Blanc sighs a long, drawn out sigh. Centers himself, his face settling into a shape of deep disapproval, and draws a breath-
texts.zh: Blanc 长长地叹了一口气。他定了定神，脸上凝成一幅深切不以为然的神情，然后吸了一口气——

texts.zh: Blanc 长长地叹了一口气。他定了定神，脸上凝成一幅深切不以为然的神情，然后吸了一口气——

options.en: I've also had an interesting conversation with your portmaster...
options.zh: 我还跟你的港务长有过一次很有意思的谈话...

options.en: I've also had an interesting conversation with your quartermaster...
options.zh: 我还跟你的军需官有过一次很有意思的谈话...

texts.en:
"Enough!"

It's not quite a shout, but Blanc's anger has almost drawn color to his cheeks. Almost.

You've crossed a threshold.

"I see, captain, that your persistence is not easily diverted. So let us 'clear the air', as they say, and lay rest to your alleged concerns."

There is threat in his voice; cool, slow, and patient.
texts.zh:
"够了！"

这还算不上喊叫，但 Blanc 的怒气几乎让血色涌上了脸颊。几乎。

你已经越过了一道界线。

"我看出来了，舰长，你的执着不容易被引开。那我们就照他们的说法'把话说开'，也好让你那些所谓的疑虑有个了结。"

他的声音里带着威胁：冷静、缓慢，而且很有耐心。

options.en: I'd like nothing more.

texts.en:
Blanc holds his gaze on you, then exhales; an uncomfortable whistling sound.

"The involvement of 'Doctor' Wyatt Cydonia was a stipulation on behalf of... a particular client. They insisted that he perform the procedure. And tripled the usual fee. I must admit that accepting these terms was a rare lapse in judgement within Mbaye-Gogol."

He looks off and away. "More than credits, there were... political considerations."
texts.zh:
Blanc 的目光在你身上停了一会儿，然后呼出一口气，发出一种令人不适的哨音。

"'博士' Wyatt Cydonia 的参与，是应... 某位客户的要求。他们坚持要由他来做这台手术。而且付了三倍的常规费用。我得承认，接受这些条件，是 Mbaye-Gogol 内部一次罕见的判断失误。"

他把目光移开，望向别处。"比起星币，还有... 政治上的考量。"

options.en: So the 'accident' was due to Cydonia alone, not Mbaye-Gogol policy?
options.zh: 那么这起'事故'只该归咎于 Cydonia，而不是 Mbaye-Gogol 的方针？

texts.en:
"Precisely," he says. "I am relieved by your understanding of the situation."

"Our only error was allowing him to operate in our facilities, using our equipment and support team. ...The subject-pair was not viable, the procedure was doomed from the outset."

"Cydonia." He speaks as if the name pains him, contorting his ghoulish visage.
texts.zh:
"正是如此，\"他说，\"你能这样理解局势，我很欣慰。"

"我们唯一的错误，是允许他在我们的设施里、用我们的设备和保障团队施行手术。...这一对受术体本身就不具备可行性，手术从一开始就注定失败。"

"Cydonia。"他说出这个名字时像在忍痛，那张食尸鬼般的脸扭曲起来。

options.en: Let him speak

texts.en:
"Cydonia promised the impossible." His eyes flit, scanning a tally of damages in what must pass for a rage. "No one can bring back the dead!"

"The transfer subject, effectively brain-dead... the chance of success was nil, however viable the target clone. Now this error, his egregious misrepresentation, reflects poorly upon the Cryosanctum. I hear he's fled to that barbarous hive of pirates called 'Kanta's Den'."

He shakes his head, stiffly.
texts.zh:
"Cydonia 承诺了不可能的事。"他的眼睛飞快地扫动，像是在清点一份损失清单，那大概就是他所能表现出的愤怒。"没人能让死者复生！"

"移植受体实际上已经脑死亡... 无论目标克隆体多么可行，成功的几率都是零。如今这个错误、他这番恶劣的虚假陈述，让冷冻圣所颜面尽失。我听说他已经逃到那个叫'Kanta's Den'的野蛮海盗窝里去了。"

他僵硬地摇了摇头。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"His touch is a stain on our reputation," he says. "I fear it may take generations to erase. You... you must tell me how you found- tell me who is spreading this malicious rumor."

His eyes pin you, suddenly sharp.
texts.zh:
"他经手的东西，是我们声誉上的一块污渍，\"他说，\"我怕要几代人的时间才能擦掉。你... 你必须告诉我是怎么查到的——告诉我是谁在散布这种恶意的谣言。"

他的目光忽然变得锐利，把你钉在原地。

options.en: I must keep my sources confidential. You of all people understand discretion.
options.zh: 我必须为我的消息来源保密。别人不说，你最该懂什么叫谨慎。

options.en: Dolos Macario. His operation had sloppy infosec.
options.zh: Dolos Macario。他的行动在信息安全上太马虎了。

options.en: So. Cydonia failed to upload the brain-dead Philip Andrada into his own clone?
options.zh: 那么，Cydonia 是没能把脑死亡的 Philip Andrada 上传进他自己的克隆体？

options.zh: Dolos Macario。他的所作所为，背弃了最高元首 Philip Andrada 那超凡的愿景。

options.en: So. Cydonia failed to upload the brain-dead Supreme Executor into a clone?
options.zh: 那么，Cydonia 是没能把脑死亡的最高元首上传进克隆体？

texts.en:
"I understand perfectly," he says, with a clear undertone suggesting he does not, and that he's very annoyed at someone.

Possibly you, among others.
texts.zh:
"我完全明白，"他说，话里清楚地透着另一层意思：他并不明白，而且正对某个人极为恼火。

而在这些人当中，说不定就有你。

texts.en:
"Macario." His look is distant. Light-years distant.

"I understand." His eyes return to you, some patient grievance kindling a distant glow.
texts.zh:
"Macario。"他的目光变得遥远。远以光年计。

"我明白了。"他的目光回到你身上，某种积压已久的怨怼在其中点起一点幽微的光。

texts.en:
Blanc's eyes focus on you. An understanding.

"No," he lies dutifully.

"That unfortunate tale is a grotesque imagination. As executive representative of the Mbaye-Gogol corporation, I reiterate that client corpus integrity is among our core values. And we take matters of defamation deadly seriously."

"I expect that with your not insubtantial assets exposed to legal action you will avoid repeating... damaging speculation."

His face twitches itself into an automatic customer-facing approximation of a smile.
texts.zh:
Blanc 的目光聚在你身上。是一种了然。

"不。"他尽职尽责地撒了这个谎。

"那个不幸的故事纯属荒诞的想象。作为 Mbaye-Gogol 公司的执行代表，我再重申一次：客户遗体的完整性是我们的核心价值观之一。而我们对诽谤之事是极其严肃的。"

"考虑到你名下不容小觑的资产有可能面临法律诉讼，我期望你能避免再重复... 那些有害的揣测。"

他的脸抽搐了一下，自动摆出一副面向客户用的、近似微笑的表情。

options.en: I think we understand one another.
options.zh: 我想我们彼此都明白了。

options.en: Thanks, I got what I needed.
options.zh: 多谢，我要的已经拿到了。

options.en: Maybe an 'investment' into securing your reputation is in order...
options.zh: 也许该为保住你的声誉'投资'一笔了...

texts.en: Blanc says nothing as he hits the comms cut-off.
texts.zh: Blanc 一言不发，按下了通讯切断。

texts.en: You have independent verification of the fate of Perseus, for what it's worth, and a few gruesome details besides. Everyone involved in Mbaye-Gogol seems to blame Doctor Cydonia for what went wrong.
texts.zh: 不管怎么说，你手里有了关于 Perseus 下场的独立核实，还顺带得到几个令人作呕的细节。Mbaye-Gogol 里凡是沾边的人，似乎都把出错的责任归到 Cydonia 医生头上。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: Cydonia may provide additional information when confronted with these accusations - if you decide to pursue the matter further.
texts.zh: 若你决定继续追下去，拿这些指控去当面质问 Cydonia，他或许还会多吐些东西出来。

texts.en:
What you've gleaned of Cydonia's self-image suggests that he might take offense when confronted with these accusations - he is proud, after all.

Maybe that's what it'll take to make him talk.
texts.zh:
从你对 Cydonia 自我认知的了解看，被当面这样指控，他大概会被激怒——毕竟他是个骄傲的人。

也许只有这样，才能让他开口。

options.en: Perhaps you should pay Cydonia a visit
You've got your answer - dead is dead
options.zh: 答案你已经有了——死了就是死了

texts.en:
Perhaps you should.

Kanta's Den, in the Magec system.

It's not truly over until you have his story, however distorted.
texts.zh:
也许确实该去。

Kanta's Den，在 Magec 星系。

除非你亲耳听到他的说法——无论那说法被扭曲成什么样——这件事都不算真正了结。

texts.en:
You've discovered the fate of each of the seven sons of Philip Andrada.

Scattered to the small worlds of the Persean Sector, some died by the hand of assassins, others never truly lived.

But enough survived. The blood of Andrada lives on.
texts.zh:
你已经查清了 Philip Andrada 七个儿子各自的结局。

他们被散落到英仙座星域的小世界，有的死于刺客之手，有的从未真正活过。

但活下来的已经够多。Andrada 的血脉仍在延续。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
You've discovered the seven Andradas and found Macario's contingency plan for control of the Sindrian Diktat in the form of Hector Andrada. It is clear, too, that he does not fully control the situation and perhaps never did. He would have never allowed Achilles to live.

History waits in fine balance as each presumptive heir builds strength.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly.

Openly - and soon.
texts.zh:
你查清了七位 Andrada 其人，也发现了 Macario 为掌控辛达强权所备的后手——Hector Andrada。同样清楚的是，他并未完全握得住局面，或许从来就没握住过。否则他绝不会让 Achilles 活着。

历史悬在一线之间，每位自认的继承者都在积蓄力量。

只消一点火星，冲突就会明面烧起来。

明面开战——而且很快。

Openly - and soon.

而只消一点火星，冲突就会明面烧起来。

明面开战——而且很快。

texts.en:
Whatever the schemes of the Andrada's divided old guard, two of Philip's sons have moved into the foremost positions to succeed as Supreme Executor of their clone-father's empire: Hector and Achilles. Two of seven.

History waits in fine balance as each builds strength, as each prepares to gamble everything.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly. And soon. They will be vulnerable. They will see rivals only in one another.

That will be the time to strike.
texts.zh:
无论 Andrada 家那些各怀心思的旧部在打什么算盘，Philip 的两个儿子已经站到了最前头，只等接掌他们克隆父亲帝国的最高元首之位：Hector 与 Achilles。七人中的二人。

历史悬在一线之间，两人各自积蓄力量，各自准备押上全部。

只消一点火星，冲突就会明面爆发。而且很快。届时他们都最是脆弱。他们眼中只会有彼此这一个对手。

那就是动手的时候。

texts.en:
Whatever the schemes of the Andrada's divided old guard, two of Philip's heirs have moved into the foremost positions to succeed as Supreme Executor of their clone-father's empire: Hector and Achilles. Two of seven. One made weak by Macario's corrupting influence, the other made weak by the League's.

History waits in fine balance as each builds strength and prepares to gamble everything.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly. And soon. They will be vulnerable. They will see rivals only in one another.

That will be the time to strike.

那就是动手的时候。

texts.en:
Whatever the schemes of the Andrada's divided old guard, two of Philip's heirs - his true blood - have moved into the foremost positions to succeed as Supreme Executor of their father's empire: Hector and Achilles. Two viable heirs of the original seven. But are they made weak by corrupting influence - one by Macario's scheming, the other by the League's? Can Andrada's blood, can his transcendent philosophy, overcome such setback?

History waits in fine balance as each builds strength and prepares to gamble everything.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly. And soon. They will be vulnerable. They will see rivals only in one another.

One thing is clear: you must choose.
texts.zh:
无论 Andrada 家那些各怀心思的旧部在打什么算盘，Philip 的两位继承人——他真正的血脉——已经站到了最前头，只等接掌他们父亲帝国的最高元首之位：Hector 与 Achilles。最初七人中仅存的两个可继之人。可他们是否已被腐蚀性的影响弄弱了——一个毁于 Macario 的算计，另一个毁于联盟的？Andrada 的血脉，他那套超凡的哲学，能跨过这样的挫折吗？

历史悬在一线之间，两人各自积蓄力量，各自准备押上全部。

只消一点火星，冲突就会明面爆发。而且很快。届时他们都最是脆弱。他们眼中只会有彼此这一个对手。

有一件事很清楚：你必须选边。

texts.en: Blanc says nothing as he hits the comms cut-off. The looks he gives you says quite enough.
texts.zh: Blanc 一言不发，按下了通讯切断。他看你的那一眼，已经把话说尽了。

texts.en:
"The transcendent... what?" Blanc blinks, then re-focuses.

"Dolos Macario," he says firmly, after a moment. His look is distant. Light-years distant.

"I understand." His eyes return to you, some patient grievance kindling a distant glow.
texts.zh:
"超凡的... 什么？"Blanc 眨了眨眼，重新定下神来。

"Dolos Macario。"片刻之后，他肯定地说。他的目光变得遥远。远以光年计。

"我明白了。"他的目光回到你身上，某种积压已久的怨怼在其中点起一点幽微的光。

texts.en:
"What a grotesque imagination you have," he says blandly.

"As executive representative of the Mbaye-Gogol corporation, I cannot comment on our relationship with a particular client, real or hypothetical. However," his voice grows deeper. "We hold client corpus integrity among our core values. Mbaye-Gogol takes defamation very, very seriously due to the sacred relationship we hold with all of our clients."
texts.zh:
"你的想象力真是荒诞得可以，"他语气平淡地说。

"作为 Mbaye-Gogol 公司的执行代表，我无法就我们与某位客户之间的关系置评，无论这位客户是真实存在还是假设的。不过，\"他的声音沉了下去，\"客户遗体的完整性是我们的核心价值观之一。Mbaye-Gogol 与我们所有客户之间维系着神圣的关系，因此我们对诽谤一事极其、极其严肃。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"I expect that with your not insubstantial assets exposed to legal action, you will avoid repeating this... speculation."

His face twitches itself into an automatic customer-facing approximation of a smile.

"That will be all for today, I think, Captain $PlayerName," he says, then cuts the link with a block-and-terminate command.
texts.zh:
"考虑到你名下相当可观的资产有可能面临法律诉讼，我期望你能避免再重复这种... 揣测。"

他的脸抽搐了一下，自动摆出一副面向客户用的、近似微笑的表情。

"今天就到这里吧，$PlayerName 舰长。"他说完，用一条阻断并终止的指令切断了链接。

texts.en:
You watch the ghostly afterimagine of Gallu Blanc fade into blackness.

If the man has nerves, you may have just struck one. He's scared, but not scared enough to crack.

Perhaps he'll speak with you again in a day or so. After he's cooled off.
texts.zh:
你看着 Gallu Blanc 那幽灵般的余像沉入黑暗。

这人要是有痛处，你刚才大概正好戳在上面。他确实怕了，但还没怕到垮掉。

也许过一两天他会再找你谈。等他冷静下来。

options.en: I had an interesting conversation with your portmaster.
options.zh: 我跟你的港务长有过一次很有意思的谈话。

texts.en: "Our portmaster upholds Mbaye-Gogol safety standards to my satisfaction," he says with forced nonchalance. "I have no need to be involved in such matters."
texts.zh: "我们的港务长执行 Mbaye-Gogol 安全标准，我很满意，\"他强作淡然地说，\"这种事不必我插手。"

options.en: It was confirmed that Doctor Cydonia worked as a contractor for Mbaye-Gogol.
options.zh: 已确认 Cydonia 博士曾以承包人身份为 Mbaye-Gogol 工作。

texts.en:
"Oh?" His voice is calm.

"We employ many contractors, captain, and their work is - as you surely know - a private matter between Mbaye-Gogol and our guests."
texts.zh:
"哦？"他的声音很平静。

"我们雇了很多承包人，舰长。而你当然清楚，他们的工作属于 Mbaye-Gogol 与客人之间的私事。"

options.en: It corroborates a disturbing report in my possession concerning Perseus Saturnian.
options.zh: 这印证了我手上一份关于 Perseus Saturnian 的报告——内容令人不安。

options.en: I'm trying to find out what happened to a man named Perseus Saturnian.
options.zh: 我在查一个叫 Perseus Saturnian 的人出了什么事。

texts.en:
"Haven't heard the name, captain. And I wouldn't know what you mean by 'happened'."

The $post shrugs. "I handle port operations, and I run a tight operation. Safety first."

"You'll want to talk to Mister Blanc if you have business with the Cryosanctum, but I'll tell you now that Mbaye-Gogol company policy is very strict about client privacy."
texts.zh:
"没听过这名字，舰长。我也不懂你说的'出了什么事'是什么意思。"

这位 $post 耸了耸肩。"我管港口运营，我这摊子管得很紧。安全第一。"

"你要是跟冷冻圣所有生意，该去找 Blanc 先生谈。不过我现在就可以告诉你，Mbaye-Gogol 的公司政策对客户隐私管得极严。"

texts.en:
"I think you've asked quite enough about things outside the scope of matters strictly related to my concern, which is with port operations." $HeOrShe crosses $hisOrHer arms.

"Is that all, then?"
texts.zh:
"我认为，关于我职责范围之外的事，你问得已经够多了。我管的只是港口运营。"$HeOrShe把$hisOrHer双臂抱在胸前。

"那就这些？"

options.en: Do you happen to know of a Doctor Cydonia? He performed... work here.
options.zh: 你碰巧知道一位 Cydonia 博士吗？他在这里... 做过些事。

texts.en:
A look of disgust flashes on the $post's face before $heOrShe can hide it.

"No... I don't know anyone by that name. $PlayerSirOrMadam."
texts.zh:
$post的脸上掠过一丝厌恶，$heOrShe还没来得及掩藏。

"不... 我不认识叫这名字的人。$PlayerSirOrMadam。"

options.en: By the face you just made, I'd say you've met him.
options.zh: 就凭你刚才那副表情，我敢说你见过他。

options.en: I don't either. I just heard... a rumor. (lie)
options.zh: 我也不知道。我只是听说... 有个传闻。 (撒谎)

options.en: I have a report placing him on Nomios on... $sd7s_cydoniaDate2.
options.zh: 我有一份报告，把他定位在 Nomios，时间是... $sd7s_cydoniaDate2。

options.en: Of course not. Sorry to have bothered you.
options.zh: 当然不认识。抱歉打扰了。

options.en: You appear to have a strong negative reaction to the name 'Cydonia'.
options.zh: 你对'Cydonia'这个名字似乎有很强的负面反应。

options.en: I don't either. I just heard... a rumor. (lie)

options.en: Of course not. Sorry to have bothered you.
options.zh: 当然不认识。抱歉打扰了。

texts.en:
"No, I-" $HeOrShe pauses, then glares at you.

"Spacer rumors. Not sure they're about the same, uh, person you're asking about. I don't hold with rumors, you see."
texts.zh:
"不，我——"$HeOrShe顿了一下，然后瞪着你。

"太空佬的闲话。我不确定那说的是不是，呃，你说的同一个人。你也知道，我不信传闻。"

options.en: I heard he performs operations of some kind. Heard of that?
options.zh: 我听说他做某种手术。你听说过吗？

texts.en:
The $post looks a bit pale.

"Haven't heard about that. Wouldn't be interested, anyway."
texts.zh:
$post的脸色有些发白。

"没听说过。反正我也不会感兴趣。"

options.en: So why do you think he was on Nomios on $sd7s_cydoniaDate2?
options.zh: 那你为什么觉得他会在 $sd7s_cydoniaDate2 出现在 Nomios？

texts.en:
$HisOrHer eyes flash with alarm for just a moment.

"Look," $heOrShe says, taking a deep breath.

"I don't know who you are or who you're working for, but Cydonia's contract was terminated. He was only ever that: a contractor. Hired at the insistence of some big client. He did bad work and no one liked him. Not my business. End of story."
texts.zh:
$HisOrHer的眼中闪过一丝惊慌，只一瞬间。

"听着，"$heOrShe深吸一口气，说道。

"我不知道你是谁，也不知道你在替谁干活，但 Cydonia 的合同已经被终止了。他从头到尾就只是个承包人。某个大客户坚持要雇他。他活儿干得烂，没人喜欢他。这不关我的事。就这样。"

options.en: What was he hired to do to Perseus Saturnian?
options.zh: 他被雇来对 Perseus Saturnian 做什么？

texts.en:
"I don't know who that is or what Cydonia did. I oversee port operations, not Sanctuary client procedures."

The $post mouths a curse.

"You can't tell anyone I said anything. And I didn't. It's all rumors and hearsay. I don't have access to Cryosanctum records. No one can prove anything."
texts.zh:
"我不知道那是谁，也不知道 Cydonia 干了什么。我管的是港口运营，不是圣所的客户流程。"

这位 $post 无声地骂了一句。

"你不能告诉任何人我说过话。而且我什么都没说。全是传言和道听途说。我接触不到冷冻圣所的记录。谁也证明不了什么。"

options.en: Someone can... but you'll be fine. Thanks for the help.
options.zh: 总有人能证明... 不过你会没事的。多谢帮忙。

options.en: So I shouldn't tell Gallu Blanc how you feel about Cydonia?
options.zh: 那我是不是不该告诉 Gallu Blanc 你对 Cydonia 是什么看法？

options.en: We'll see. Thanks for the help.

texts.en: "Captain. I've told you... too much. Isn't that what you wanted?"
texts.zh: "舰长。我跟你说的... 太多了。这不正是你想要的吗？"

options.en: Just checking. Thanks for the help.
options.zh: 只是确认一下。多谢帮忙。

options.en: 10,000 credits.

texts.en: The $post transfers the credits then mumbles something darkly as $heOrShe hits the comms shut-off.
texts.zh: 这位 $post 转完账，低声咕哝了句什么，随后 $heOrShe 切断了通讯。

texts.en: "Good," $heOrShe says with relief, then corrects $hisOrHer tone toward neutrality. "That's good. I mean, not... there are all sorts out there. All sorts, aren't there."
texts.zh: "好，\"$heOrShe松了口气，随后把$hisOrHer的语气调回不冷不热。\"那就好。我是说，不是... 外面什么样的人都有。什么样的人都有，对吧。"

"Got a way with words, you do. Let's call us a sight better than a clean slate."

texts.en:
"What 'happened', huh. Let me guess, friend went missing? And respecting client's privacy is a core pillar of Mbaye-Gogol."

$HeOrShe crosses $hisOrHer arms.

"Yeah, we get that from time to time. Not my department."
texts.zh:
"'出了什么事'，是吧。让我猜猜，朋友失踪了？而尊重客户隐私是 Mbaye-Gogol 的核心支柱之一。"

$HeOrShe交叉起$hisOrHer的手臂。

"是啊，这种事隔三差五就来一桩。不归我管。"

$HeOrShe looks passably apologetic.

texts.en:
"Funny you should ask. Me, I've had the time to cook up some philosophy on the question. Not a lot of excitement on Nomios you know, ha-ha."

$HeOrShe coughs, then puts on a serious look.

"There's dignity and all that which Mister Blanc likes to talk about. But it's more about the living what got left behind, isn't it? Otherwise there'd be none to care about those that's dead. So putting it like that, you've got to weigh whose needs are served and," $heOrShe winks, "What's it's worth."

$HeOrShe咳了一声，然后摆出一副严肃的表情。

"Blanc 先生爱挂在嘴边的那些尊严之类的说法，当然是有的。可说到底，这更多是活着的人、被留下来的人的事，不是吗？不然就没有人会在乎死人了。这么说吧，你得掂量掂量满足的是谁的需要，还有，\"$heOrShe眨眨眼，\"这值多少钱。"
