"I see you're in the biz. Didn't figure you were at first look. Welly well, good to know I don't have to play pretend with you."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe露出刮目相看的神色。

"看来你是同行。第一眼还真没看出来。很好很好，知道在你这儿不用装样子，我就放心了。"

options.en: He performed an operation here. The subject died.
options.zh: 他在这里做过一台手术。受术者死了。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe snorts, not quite a laugh.

"Yeah, that's Cydonia. What's amazing is he's ever had a patient who lived."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe嗤了一声，算不上笑。

"是啊，这就是 Cydonia。稀奇的是他居然有过活下来的病人。"

texts.en: A pause. "Sorry if it was a friend of yours, ya'know. That died."
texts.zh: 一阵沉默。"要是那是你的朋友，那就抱歉了，你懂的。死了的那位。"

texts.en:
A pause.

"Sorry if it was a friend of yours, ya'know. That died."
texts.zh:
一阵沉默。

"要是那是你的朋友，那就抱歉了，你懂的。死了的那位。"

texts.en:
A pause.

"Good thing the one he got his hands on wasn't your friend. Wouldn't wish a taste of Cydonia on, well... not a lot of people."
texts.zh:
一阵沉默。

"幸好他下手的那位不是你朋友。Cydonia 的手段，我可不希望谁摊上，呃... 说实话，没几个人该遭这个。"

texts.en: A pause. "You know someone he worked on? Hope they weren't your friend."
texts.zh: 一阵沉默。"你认识他动过刀的人？但愿那不是你朋友。"

options.en: He wasn't. But I need to know what Cydonia was trying to do.
options.zh: 他不是。但我需要知道 Cydonia 到底想干什么。

options.en: A very close friend. I am on a quest for vengeance, you see. (lie)
options.zh: 一位非常亲密的朋友。你看，我是在复仇。 (说谎)

options.en: He was a clone of Philip Andrada. Perhaps meant to be his heir.
options.zh: 他是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体。也许本来是要做他的继承人。

options.en: I need to find out what Cydonia was trying to do.
options.zh: 我需要查清 Cydonia 到底想干什么。

options.en: He was a clone of Philip Andrada. Perhaps meant to be his heir.
options.zh: 他是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体。也许本来是要做他的继承人。

texts.en:
"Well, I'd figure he was doing extraction. You know, choice meat." $HeOrShe makes a cutting motion.

$PersonLastName eyes your reaction. "You don't think that was it?"
texts.zh:
"这个嘛，我猜他是在做摘取。你知道的，精选的好肉。"$HeOrShe做了个切割的动作。

$PersonLastName盯着你的反应。"你觉得不是这样？"

options.en: No. I think this was must have been something... special.
options.zh: 不。我想那一定是件... 特别的事。

options.en: No. He was a clone of Philip Andrada. Perhaps meant to be his heir.
options.zh: 不。他是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体。也许本来是要做他的继承人。

texts.en:
"Ugh. The man, if you can call him that... he's got a strange reputation. Breaks all manner of laws."

$HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head grimly.

"And before you make some smart comment, there's laws made by the taxman and the customs officer, and then there's Laws. Of life and... and maybe the sorts of things the Luddies go on about, but not exactly. Taboo, like. Laws that are wrong to break. That's the kind of laws Cydonia doesn't even think about when he starts cutting."
texts.zh:
"唉。那个人，如果还能管他叫人的话... 名声很邪。什么法都敢破。"

$HeOrShe沉重地摇了摇$hisOrHer的头。

"你那句俏皮话先咽回去：有税务官和海关官立的法，然后还有【法】。生命的法... 也许还有卢德信徒们唠叨的那类东西，但又不完全是。像是禁忌。那种破了就是错的法。Cydonia 一旦动刀，连想都不会想到这种法。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"If you're looking to find Cydonia and do some justice, that's a high call. You know he's with the Warlord Kanta, in her court? Hard to say exactly what he is to her, but he's hers. 'Kanta's Protection', they call it."

"And you don't take one from under Kanta's protection easy. Not if you don't want your meats finding a new home on three different Core Worlds and a bit for the fringe as well, if you follow."
texts.zh:
"你要是想找到 Cydonia 讨个公道，那可是个很高的目标。你知道他跟着军阀 Kanta，在她的宫廷里？很难说他对她到底算什么，但他是她的人。他们管这叫'Kanta 的庇护'。"

"而想从 Kanta 的庇护底下带走一个人，可不容易。除非你乐意让自己身上的肉在三个不同的核心世界上各找一处新家，边缘星区还能再分上一点——你明白我的意思。"

texts.en: "You know how it is, though. Cydonia is Kanta's. And taking from Kanta won't go easy. And if. If you got away with it, you'll not want your meats finding a new home on three different of the Core Worlds, if you follow."
texts.zh: "不过你知道这世道是怎么回事。Cydonia 是 Kanta 的人。从 Kanta 手里拿东西，可不会轻松。而且要是... 要是你真能得手，你也不会希望自己身上的肉在三个不同的核心世界各找一处新家吧——你明白我的意思。"

options.en: You're saying Doctor Cydonia is with Kanta. Kanta's Den, Magec system.
options.zh: 你是说 Cydonia 医生跟着 Kanta。Kanta's Den，Magec 星系。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"I am. And best of luck to you."

A look of concern flashes on $hisOrHer face, and $heOrShe quickly adds, "Which is to say I'm not advocating the particulars of vengeance or what-have-you against anyone with Kanta's protection. It's more a general statement of good will toward your wellbeing, physical and emotional."

This seems to satisfy the $post's dock-lawyer's instinct.

"Now, is there any other business I can help you with?"
texts.zh:
"我是。也祝你好运。"

$hisOrHer脸上掠过一丝担忧，$heOrShe连忙补充道："也就是说，我并不是在鼓动对任何受 Kanta 庇护的人采取什么复仇之类的具体行动。这更像是一句泛泛的祝愿，祝你的身心都安康。"

这话似乎让这位 $post 骨子里的码头律师本能得到了满足。

"那么，还有别的什么事需要我效劳吗？"

texts.en:
"Best of luck, is all I can say." $HeOrShe looks concerned for a moment.

"Which is to say, I'm not advocating the particulars of vengeance against anyone with Kanta's protection. It's more a general statement toward your well-being."

This statement seems to satisfy the $post's lawyerly instinct.

"Now, is there any other business I can help you with?"
texts.zh:
"我只能说，祝你好运。"$HeOrShe一时间面露忧色。

"也就是说，我并不是在鼓动对任何受 Kanta 庇护的人采取具体的复仇行动。这更像是一句泛泛的祝愿，为你的安康着想。"

这番话似乎让这位 $post 的律师本能得到了满足。

"那么，还有别的什么事需要我效劳吗？"

texts.en:
Taken aback, $heOrShe is at a loss for words for a moment.

Then, finally, "You've got a straight face, huh. I'll not be calling you a liar, but a big story... it needs a thorough telling."

$HeOrShe squints. "And if what you're telling is truth, then maybe the rads are too high for my ambitions. So," $heOrShe holds up a hand. "Kindly tell no more."
texts.zh:
$heOrShe一时语塞，有些措手不及。

随后，对方终于开口："你这张脸倒是稳得住。我不会说你在撒谎，可这么大的故事... 得讲得详详细细才行。"

$HeOrShe眯起眼睛。"要是你说的都是真的，那这地方的辐射对我的野心来说怕是太高了点。所以，"$heOrShe举起一只手，"请别再往下说了。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Now. When Cydonia was on Nomios, I did not make his acquaintance. All I know is he's not welcome back, and all I do is make sure the meat stays fresh. Not my concern where it comes from, or how."

"Don't much matter now though, because Doctor Cydonia is Kanta's being now. Under her protection. So any who's got blood with him's got to make a deal with Kanta. That's the beginning and end of it."
texts.zh:
"话说回来。Cydonia 在 Nomios 那会儿，我没跟他打过交道。我只知道别再让他回来，而我只管让肉保持新鲜。肉从哪儿来、怎么来的，不关我的事。"

"不过现在也无关紧要了，因为 Cydonia 博士如今是 Kanta 的人，受她庇护。所以跟他有血债的人，都得先跟 Kanta 谈成条件。事情从头到尾就这一条。"

texts.en:
"When Cydonia was on Nomios I did not have the pleasure of his acquaintance. All I do is make sure the meat stays fresh. Not my concern where it comes from, or how."

"You know as well as I that he isn't here now, he's Kanta's now. Under her protection. So if you've got blood with him, you'll need to make a deal with her. That's the beginning the end of it."
texts.zh:
"Cydonia 在 Nomios 的时候，我没那个荣幸结识他。我只管让肉保持新鲜。肉从哪儿来、怎么来的，不关我的事。"

"你我都清楚，他现在不在这儿了，他是 Kanta 的人了，受她庇护。所以你要是跟他有血债，就得去跟她谈条件。从头到尾就这么回事。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe nods.

"I respect that. Can't let them live that's done you and yours so wrong."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe点点头。

"我敬重你这份心。害了你和你的人的家伙，不能让他活着。"

texts.en: "Well, I know if Cydonia was involved, it was an ugly job. I'm amazed he's ever had a patient who lived."
texts.zh: "这个嘛，我只知道只要 Cydonia 掺和进来，活儿就干得难看。他居然有过活下来的病人，这我倒挺吃惊。"

texts.en:
"I don't think I will," $heOrShe snaps.

"You think you're some kind of MuniSec coming in here like you make anyone answer whatever you've got bubblin' in your head? This is Mbaye-Gogol's world, my friend, and they've got the big guns to prove it."

"Now, if you've proper business, then we can have a conversation. If not, then burn yourself bright right away from here, copy?"
texts.zh:
"我不打算回答，"$heOrShe厉声说道。

"你以为自己是市政安保的人？闯进来就一副能让谁都回答你脑子里冒泡那些问题的架势？这是 Mbaye-Gogol 的地盘，朋友，人家有大炮撑腰，这就是明证。"

"现在，你要是有正经生意，咱们可以聊聊。要是没有，那就烧亮自己的尾焰，赶紧从这儿滚蛋，听明白了吗？"

options.en: I apologize for my directness. It's a... sensitive matter.
options.zh: 我为我的直率道歉。这事... 有点敏感。

options.en: I'll think about it. (back)

texts.en:
After a short wait, the comms-link is approved. An image shudders into being.

Doctor Cydonia looks at you, running his tongue over his lips. He wipes his hands with a cloth, which he tucks somewhere off the comms visual.

"What? Is this about my specimens?" His voice is almost a hiss. "I told you... you people never to speak to me directly."
texts.zh:
等了没多久，通讯链路获得批准，一帧影像抖动着成形。

Cydonia 博士看着你，舌头舔过嘴唇。他用一块布擦了擦手，然后把布塞进通讯画面之外的某处。

"什么事？是我的标本的事吗？\"他的声音近乎嘶嘶作响。\"我跟你们说过... 你们这些人，永远别直接找我说话。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en: "Well?" His face droops into a frown. "You're interrupting an important... experiment."
texts.zh: "说吧？\"他的脸垮下来，皱起眉头。\"你打断了我的一个重要的... 实验。"

texts.en:
"Wait- that cranial anatomy... yes, I remember you."

There's a bit of spittle hanging off the side of his mouth. You can't stop watching it.
texts.zh:
"等等——那个颅骨结构... 对，我认得你。"

他嘴角挂着一小点唾沫。你的目光没法从那里挪开。

texts.en:
"You killed my Loke, my beautiful clone; my first viable creation," he whines.

"Why did you take it from me, the first that lived? Why, why." His eyes are large, and wet.

Are those tears?
texts.zh:
"你杀了我的 Loke，我美丽的克隆体，我第一个成活的造物，"他哀声道。

"你为什么要把它从我身边夺走，那是第一个活下来的？为什么，为什么。"他的眼睛很大，湿漉漉的。

那是眼泪吗？

texts.en:
"You threw my Loke out an airlock! My beautiful creation, the first..." He pauses, then speaks. "The first that lived."

"It was so scared after. I had to d- to sedate it. My poor flower." His eyes are large, and wet. "It could have died," he says, holding back tears.
texts.zh:
"你把我的 Loke 扔出了气闸！我美丽的造物，第一个...\"他顿了顿，才接着说，\"第一个活下来的。"

"那之后它怕成那样。我只好给——给它打了镇静剂。我可怜的花儿。"他的眼睛很大，湿漉漉的。"它本来会死的，"他说着，忍住了眼泪。

texts.en:
"You're that upstart mercenary captain," his lip curls with disgust.

"I don't like what you bring out in Jorien. You make her difficult. She's in careful balance, very careful."
texts.zh:
"你就是那个暴发户雇佣兵舰长，"他厌恶地撇起嘴角。

"我不喜欢你勾出来的 Jorien 那一面。你让她变得难缠。她处在一个精心的平衡里，非常精心。"

options.en: It was my life or... his. Kanta activated her minefield.
options.zh: 不是我的命，就是... 他的。Kanta 启动了雷场。

options.en: That Loke-thing was an abomination.
options.zh: 那个 Loke 玩意儿，根本就不该存在。

options.en: I'm sorry about Loke. He was innocent.
options.zh: Loke 的事，我很抱歉。他是无辜的。

options.en: I'm sorry about Loke. (lie)
options.zh: Loke 的事，我很抱歉。 (说谎)

options.en: It was my life or... his. Kanta activated her minefield.
options.zh: 不是我的命，就是... 他的。Kanta 启动了雷场。

options.en: The Loke-thing is an abomination.
options.zh: 那个 Loke 玩意儿，根本就不该存在。

options.en: I'm sorry about Loke. He was innocent.
options.zh: Loke 的事，我很抱歉。他是无辜的。

options.en: I'm sorry about Loke. (lie)
options.zh: Loke 的事，我很抱歉。 (说谎)

options.en: Let's agree to disagree. I'm here to ask you about something else...
options.zh: 那咱们就各执一词吧。我来是想问你另一件事...

options.en: Kanta? Balanced? She's an insane murderous cyborg!
options.zh: Kanta？平衡？她是个杀人不眨眼的疯子赛博格！

options.en: Er... yes. Exquisite work. Masterful, even. (lie)
options.zh: 呃... 是的。精妙的作品。甚至可说是大师手笔。 (说谎)

options.en: Yes. Exquisite work. Masterful, even.
options.zh: 是的。精妙的作品。甚至可说是大师手笔。

texts.en:
He glares at you, eyes red. Lip trembling.

"Philistine, luddite, heretic. You hate genius," he's looking at you, very closely. "It's your jealousy- I see it in your brow. You can't help yourself, your urges compel you to destroy beauty."
texts.zh:
他瞪着你，眼睛发红，嘴唇发抖。

"庸人、卢德分子、异端。你恨天才，\"他凑得很近地看着你。\"是你的嫉妒——我在你的眉宇间看出来了。你控制不住自己，你的冲动逼着你去毁掉美。"

options.en: I'm not here about any of that. I'm here about Perseus Saturnian.
options.zh: 我不是为这些来的。我是为 Perseus Saturnian 来的。

options.en: Sure thing, doc. But I'm here about your failure called 'Perseus Saturnian'.
options.zh: 当然，博士。可我来是为那个叫'Perseus Saturnian'的失败品。

texts.en: Cydonia makes a strange expression, then turns away to cough wetly before looking back at you.
texts.zh: Cydonia 露出一个古怪的表情，转过头去湿漉漉地咳了几声，才又看向你。

texts.en: "I- I wouldn't know anything about that... captain, is it?"
texts.zh: "我——我对那事一无所知... 舰长，是吧？"

texts.en: "I- I wouldn't know anything about that, captain."
texts.zh: "我——我对那事一无所知，舰长。"

texts.en: His wan smile reveals very small, evenly-spaced teeth. Possibly meant to be disarming, it yields a distinct lack of warmth.
texts.zh: 他勉强扯出的笑露出细小而排列整齐的牙齿。这本该是让人卸下防备的笑，却只透出一股明显的冷意。

options.en: Dispense with the denial, 'doctor'. I have Macario's files on Perseus.
options.zh: 别装了，'博士'。我手上有 Macario 关于 Perseus 的档案。

options.en: I know what Macario knows, doctor. I'm trying to help you.
options.zh: Macario 知道什么，我就知道什么，博士。我是在帮你。

texts.en:
Mercifully, the smile disappears.

"Lies," he hisses. "Manufactured by small men who covet my genius."
texts.zh:
谢天谢地，那笑容消失了。

"谎话，\"他嘶声道。\"是那些觊觎我才华的小人造出来的。"

texts.en:
He waves you away. "I must return to my, my work..."

The comms cut, leaving you with a blank link.

Perhaps you need something more to get Cydonia's attention.
texts.zh:
他挥手把你赶开。"我得回去做我的、我的工作了..."

通讯切断，只留下一条空白的链路。

也许你得拿出点更实在的东西，才能让 Cydonia 正眼看你。

texts.en:
"I must return to my, my work..."

He waves you away, then reaches for the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
"我得回去做我的、我的工作了..."

他挥手把你赶开，然后伸手去够通讯开关。

options.en: Cut the comm link
I learned about Perseus Saturnian on Nomios. They all said it was your fault.
options.zh: 我是在 Nomios 听说 Perseus Saturnian 的事的。他们都说那是你的错。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en:
"My fault? MY fault?" His voice rises.

"What I did would have been the preface to a miraculous breakthrough! Which they ALL conspired to sabotage, the small-minded fools. Whoever sent you - was it Gallu Blanc and that conclave of half-frozen brains at the Cryosanctum? Perhaps Macario and Caden, the self-satisfied fool and his fat puppet?"

Cydonia almost throbs, his hands clenched tightly.

"They cannot... be- conceive of the golden age my great work will bring."
texts.zh:
"我的错？【我】的错？"他的声音拔高了。

"我所做的事，本该是一场奇迹般突破的序章！可他们【全都】合谋破坏它——那群心胸狭隘的蠢货。派你来的到底是谁？是 Gallu Blanc，和冷冻圣所里那帮泡在罐里的脑子？也许是 Macario 和 Caden，那个自鸣得意的蠢货和他那个肥胖的傀儡？"

Cydonia 浑身震动，双手死死握紧。

"他们根本... 想——想象不出我的伟业将带来怎样的黄金时代。"

texts.en: "You try my patience," he says with a sigh. "It is futile indulgence to gift wisdom to a beast like you."
texts.zh: "你在消磨我的耐心，\"他叹了口气，\"把智慧赐给像你这样的畜生，是徒劳的纵容。"

texts.en: "You try my patience," he says with a sigh. "It is futile indulgence to gift wisdom to a beast like you."
texts.zh: "你在消磨我的耐心，\"他叹了口气，\"把智慧赐给像你这样的畜生，是徒劳的纵容。"

options.en: If your... great work is eternal life, why are you hiding here with Kanta?
options.zh: 如果你的... 伟业就是永生，那你为什么躲在 Kanta 这里？

options.en: Gallu Blanc said you tried to transfer the consciousness of Philip Andrada into Perseus.
options.zh: Gallu Blanc 说，你曾试图把 Philip Andrada 的意识转移进 Perseus。

options.en: I heard Mbaye-Gogol blames you for... the incident. They set you up?
options.zh: 我听说 Mbaye-Gogol 把... 那次事故的责任推到你头上。是他们设的局？

options.en: What was your goal with Perseus? Some form of immortality?
options.zh: 你对 Perseus 打的什么算盘？某种形式的永生？

options.en: Why would Macario want to sabotage your work?
options.zh: Macario 为什么要破坏你的工作？

options.en: You're insane. You know that, right?
Yours is truly a great work. Can I help in any way?
options.zh: 你做的确实是一项伟业。我能帮上什么忙吗？

texts.en:
"I don't owe you an explanation, worm," he says with a sneer. "But I'm cursed with a... generosity... a need to seed wisdom even upon barren ground."

He waves weakly, dismissing his own quibbling.

"Kanta," he almost whispers, "Is a glorious mind. She possesses a, a, a foreshadowing of the clarity of the new race - the Human Eternal. She is the spark that shall portend the flame, the fire; no, the nova!"

Cydonia nearly screeches this last word.
texts.zh:
"我没必要向你解释，虫子，\"他冷笑着说，\"可我偏偏被一种... 慷慨... 缠上了，非要把智慧的种子撒在贫瘠的土地上。"

他虚弱地摆了摆手，把自己那点计较挥散掉。

"Kanta，\"他几乎是耳语，\"她有一颗光辉的心智。她身上有、有、有着新种族——永生之人——那份澄明的先声。她是那点火星，预示着火苗、烈火；不，是那颗轰然爆开的恒星！"

最后那个词，Cydonia 几乎是尖啸出来的。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: It takes him a moment to recover, head hanging, breathing.
texts.zh: 他低着头喘气，过了一会儿才缓过来。

texts.en:
Cydonia almost throbs, his hands clenched tightly.

"I gave so much, so much to Blanc and the half-frozen brains who give him his orders. Never should have trusted them - between those stifling 'procedures', endless 'checklists', and that farce of an 'ethics board'," his voice is a mocking whine.

"He ensured my failure! They saw what I was about to achieve - a breakthrough which would make their primitive icebox, their precious cryosanctum, obsolete. They never had the clarity of vision to reproduce my, my methods."

He takes a moment, wheezing, to catch his breath.
texts.zh:
Cydonia 浑身震动，双手死死握紧。

"我付出了那么多，那么多——给了 Blanc，和那些对他发号施令的半冻僵脑子。我当初就不该信他们——那些令人窒息的'程序'、没完没了的'清单'，还有那个闹剧似的'伦理委员会'，"他的声音是嘲弄的尖鸣。

"是他确保了我的失败！他们看见了我即将达成的东西——一项足以让他们那台原始的冰柜、他们宝贝的冷冻圣所变得一钱不值的突破。他们从来没有那份眼力，去复现我的、我的方法。"

他喘着粗气，停了一会儿才缓过来。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
His voice creaks out, more quietly than before.

"The transfer of consciousness to a cloned body... it would be akin to immortality, would it not? Though I knew it wouldn't work on Nomios. With Perseus."

"That doesn't mean the experiment was a waste," he says, defensive. "I played along. It was a ruse, in part. Ha! There was... data to collect. Elements of the procedure to refine. All part of the great work. Much delayed, yes, but it proceeds..."

His hands wander around his console until one finds a datapad, which he strokes softly.
texts.zh:
他的声音从嗓子里挤出来，比先前轻了些。

"把意识转移进克隆的身体... 那几乎等同于永生，不是吗？虽然我早知道在 Nomios 成不了。用在 Perseus 身上成不了。"

"但这不代表那次实验是白费，\"他辩解道，\"我配合了他们。一部分是假意周旋。哈！总有... 数据要收集。程序里有些环节要改良。全都是伟业的一部分。是拖后了很多，没错，但它在推进..."

他的手在控制台上摸索，直到摸到一块数据板，便轻轻抚了起来。

texts.en:
Cydonia almost throbs, his hands clenched tightly.

"I gave so much. To Mbaye-Gogol, to that cabal of half-frozen brains that gives Gallu Blanc his orders. The cryosanctum. Pah! With their stifling 'procedures' and endless 'checklists' and that farce of an 'ethics board'," his voice is a mocking whine.

"They ensured my failure. Their aim from the start was to ruin my reputation amongst the so-called 'official' cybernetics research community. They saw what I was about to achieve - and they wanted to destroy it. They never had the clarity of vision to reproduce my methods."

He takes a moment, wheezing, to catch his breath.
texts.zh:
Cydonia 浑身震动，双手死死握紧。

"我付出了那么多。给了 Mbaye-Gogol，给了那个对 Gallu Blanc 发号施令的半冻僵脑子的小集团。冷冻圣所。呸！他们那套令人窒息的'程序'、没完没了的'清单'，还有那个闹剧似的'伦理委员会'，"他的声音是嘲弄的尖鸣。

"他们确保了我的失败。他们从一开始就想毁掉我在所谓'正统'神经机械学研究界的名声。他们看见了我即将达成的东西——就想把它毁掉。他们从来没有那份眼力，去复现我的方法。"

他喘着粗气，停了一会儿才缓过来。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Macario," Cydonia's eyes narrow. "Paranoid, back-stabbing Sindrians... blaming, scheming, accusing. Delay after delay!"

"He's a small mind. Clever, in a way, but small. Philip Andrada was always the greater man; he had a vision, a vision to transform mankind! I can't speak for his methods, but it was a vision nonetheless. Macario hated that. He hated it because he couldn't understand, you see? His mind could not perceive the essence of divinity which is just... within reach."

Cydonia's hand raises, not quite reaching. He doesn't seem conscious of its movement.
texts.zh:
"Macario，\"Cydonia 眯起眼睛，\"多疑、背后捅刀的辛达人... 推责、算计、指控。一次次的拖延！"

"他器量狭小。某种意义上的聪明，但终究狭小。Philip Andrada 才是更伟大的人；他有远见，那是一种改造人类的远见！他的手段我不做评判，但那毕竟是远见。Macario 恨的就是这一点。他恨它，因为他理解不了，你明白吗？他的心智看不见那份神性的本质——而它就在... 触手可及之处。"

Cydonia 抬起手，却没有真正伸出去。他似乎没意识到自己在动。

options.en: Watch what his hand does

texts.en:
"Macario can only imagine terrorizing his tiny fiefdom, his squalid little star system. That's why he poisoned the Perseus operation."

His hand seems to mimic manipulating a small object. A motion like pinching, and a twist.

Cydonia looks away with a contemplative sneer.

"...Philip, too, I expect," he mutters.
texts.zh:
"Macario 只想象得出怎么恐吓他那块小小的封地、他那个肮脏的小星系。所以他才会毒害 Perseus 的行动。"

他的手像是在摆弄一件小东西。一个捏住、再一拧的动作。

Cydonia 把目光移开，脸上挂着沉思般的冷笑。

"...我猜，Philip 也一样，"他喃喃道。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
His watery eyes snap back to you.

"You see... no, of course you don't. You're a gun-holder, a planet-razer. Another tedious gangster. I'm surrounded by your breed."

He examines you, intrusive somehow despite the comms.

"I can tell from your cranial aspect. You're a clever beast, much akin to Macario. I see it, now. Maybe not even that. Perhaps you're Caden? A chained hound."
texts.zh:
他那双水汪汪的眼睛猛地转回你身上。

"你明白... 不，你当然不明白。你不过是个拿枪的、烧星球的。又一个乏味的匪徒。我身边全是你这类货色。"

他打量着你，隔着通讯，那目光却莫名地有种侵门踏户的意味。

"从你的颅骨轮廓就看得出来。你是头聪明的畜生，跟 Macario 很像。我现在看出来了。也许还没那么聪明。说不定你是 Caden？一条拴着链子的猎犬。"

texts.en:
He cackles wetly, shooting spittle, doing nothing to repudiate your statement.

"Yesss, my genius is as madness to a lesser being. Witnessing your pathetic intellect attempt to understand is amusing... but. But not for so long." His face droops.

"It is lonely to possess a mind at this lofty apex... "
texts.zh:
他湿漉漉地怪笑起来，唾沫四溅，丝毫没有反驳你的话。

"对——了，对低等存在来说，我的天才就形同疯癫。看着你那点可怜的心智试图理解，倒是有趣... 不过。不过也持续不了多久了。"他的脸垮了下来。

"拥有一颗处在如此高处的心智... 是孤独的..."

texts.en: "You?" He snorts. "I think not."
texts.zh: "你？\"他哼了一声，\"我看不必。"

texts.en: "I tire of this," he says, looking away.
texts.zh: "我厌倦了，"他说着，把目光移开。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
He wipes his hands with the cloth he tucked away at the beginning of your conversation. Attention drifting.

"I must return to my... experiment."
texts.zh:
他取出你们谈话开始时收起来的那块布，擦了擦手。注意力正在飘远。

"我得回到我的... 实验上去了。"

texts.en: The comms snap off quite abruptly.
texts.zh: 通讯啪地一声断了，十分突兀。

options.en: Cut the comms

texts.en: You got Cydonia's side of the story. He is not, perhaps, entirely trustworthy. But his self-serving grievances may contain a shadow of truth.
texts.zh: 你听到了 Cydonia 那一面的说法。他这个人也许并不完全可信。但他那些自私的怨言里，或许藏着一丝真相的影子。

texts.en:
Mercifully, the smile disappears.

"Help me," he hisses. "Why would I need help from vermin?"
texts.zh:
谢天谢地，那笑容消失了。

"帮我？\"他嘶声道。\"我凭什么需要虫豸来帮？"

texts.en: "You lie."
texts.zh: "你撒谎。"

texts.en: "You lie."
texts.zh: "你撒谎。"

texts.en: Cydonia frowns, and makes a distracted muttering sound. Perhaps something about 'specimens'.
texts.zh: Cydonia 皱起眉，心不在焉地嘟囔了一声。也许是在说'标本'。

texts.en:
"Insane?" Cydonia perks up, combative. "Hardly, hardly at all."

"What you cannot admit is that she is more sane than you - or even I. Her mind has had centuries to develop a, a transcendent wisdom. Beyond good and evil... I tend her, like a garden of such complexity you cannot begin to comprehend. Such beautiful fruit it will bear..."
texts.zh:
"疯子？\"Cydonia 精神一振，摆出应战的架势。\"算不上，远远算不上。"

"你不肯承认的是，她比你更清醒——甚至比我更清醒。她的心智有了几百年时间去发育出一套、一套超凡的智慧。超越善恶... 我照料她，就像照料一座复杂到你根本无从理解的花园。它结出的果实会多么美丽..."

options.en: But it didn't work out so well with Perseus, did it.
options.zh: 可换成 Perseus，就没那么顺利了，对吧。

texts.en:
"Is it not?" Cydonia perks up, attentive to praise.

"Her body is one thing; meat and mechanics. The concerns of a dilletante," he makes a dismissive wave.

"It is her mind that fascinates me most... it is more sophisticated than you can imagine. Beyond good and evil. With centuries to develop, and the correct... supplements... I tend her like a garden of such complexity you cannot begin to comprehend. Such beautiful fruit is growing..."
texts.zh:
"不是吗？"Cydonia 精神一振，对赞誉格外上心。

"她的身体是一回事；血肉与机械。那是半吊子才操心的事，"他不屑地摆了摆手。

"最让我着迷的是她的心智... 它比你所能想象的更为精妙。超越善恶。有几百年时间去发育，再加上正确的... 补剂... 我照料她，就像照料一座复杂到你根本无从理解的花园。多么美丽的果实正在长成..."

options.en: But why didn't it work on Perseus Saturnian?
options.zh: 可为什么在 Perseus Saturnian 身上就不管用？

texts.en:
After a short wait, the comms-link is approved. An image shudders into being.

Doctor Cydonia barely looks up. He's rummaging around in some tray, his hands are spattered with... something. It's hard to tell in the cold cast of light.

"Are you that delivery, my specimens? How many times have I t-told you to go directly to the portboss!"
texts.zh:
等了没多久，通讯链路获得批准，一帧影像抖动着成形。

Cydonia 博士几乎没抬头。他正在一个托盘里翻找，手上溅着... 什么东西。在那冷调的光线下很难看清。

"你就是那个送货的？我的标本呢？我跟你们说过多少遍了，直接去找港务长！"

"Bloody stars, why? You're... you're not making a 'delivery' are ya?"

$HeOrShe 看了你一眼，那眼神至少有几分错愕，或许还有几分不加掩饰的厌恶。

"群星在上，为什么？你... 你不是来'送货'的吧？"

texts.en: $HeOrShe sounds like $heOrShe is on the edge of cutting the comms on you. You're unlikely to get much more from $himOrHer.

options.en: No, I want to find out what he did at the Cryosanctum on Nomios.
options.zh: 不是。我想弄清楚他在 Nomios 的冷冻圣所里做了什么。

options.en: 'Meat trade', huh. I heard he was doing more sophisticated work.
options.zh: '卖肉'，是吗。我听说他做的是更精细的活儿。

options.en: Do I look like a servitor? I've my own business which is none of yours.
options.zh: 我看起来像个仆役吗？我有我自己的事，跟你无关。

options.en: Maybe I'll just deliver 1000 credits to your accounts... (bribe)

options.zh: 送货。对。给医生的。活体样本。非常... 娇贵。 (说谎)

options.en: Actually, never mind. (back)

texts.en:
The pirate look is no less confounded.

"Meat trade, s'what he did isn't it? Chopping them frosty corpsies up for bits? Common knowledge, I'd think."
texts.zh:
那海盗脸上的困惑一点没减。

"'卖肉'，他干的不就是这个吗？把那些冻得硬邦邦的尸首剁成块？我还以为这是人人都知道的。"

texts.en:
$PersonName looks aside, a queasy look crossing their face.

"Whatever that is, I've ain't got nothing to do with it, truth, and it's none of my business besides."
OR
"What, augments and suchlike?" $heOrShe says.

"Cydonia does them, I suppose. Nowabouts he oils the queen's clanky parts, rigs wires and neurointerfacing or whatnot, I hear."

"不管那是什么，都跟我没关系，说真的，好吧，反正不归我操心。"

"Cydonia 大概就干这个。眼下他给女王那些叮当响的部件上油，接线、搞神经接口什么的，我听说。"

耸了耸肩。不关$hisOrHer的事。

texts.en:
"Oh, well good on you $playerSirOrMadam! I'm honored to be spoke down at by your fanciness."

$HeOrShe spits, though the effect is somewhat diminished by the spittle landing on $hisOrHer own console.

"I'll not be be wasting your time no more, by yer leave."
texts.zh:
"哦，那可真了不起啊，$playerSirOrMadam！能被您这样的大人物居高临下地说上两句，我真是荣幸。"

$HeOrShe 吐了口唾沫，不过那点气势打了折扣——唾沫落在了$hisOrHer自己的控制台上。

"那我就不再耽误您的时间了，告退。"

texts.zh:
"随你便，" $heOrShe说道。
OR
$HeOrShe双手合十，点了点头。

texts.en:
"Okay." $heOrShe says, giving you a skeptical look. "Perhaps there's a more profitable discussion we could have."
OR
$HeOrShe frowns. "My time isn't cheap, you know."
OR
"I should be charging by the minute," he says to himself.
OR
"Sure," he says, with a skeptical look. "What's your next pitch?"
OR
He simply sighs.
texts.zh:
"好吧。\" $heOrShe说着，怀疑地看了你一眼，\"也许我们能聊点更有赚头的事。"
OR
$HeOrShe几乎要皱起眉头。"我的时间可不便宜，你知道的。"
OR
"真该按分钟跟你收费，" 他自言自语地嘟囔了一句。
OR
"行吧，\" 他狐疑地看了你一眼，\"你下一套说辞又是什么？"
OR
他只是叹了口气。

texts.en:
The comms resolve, showing the face of Maeus Moroz. He doesn't look happy.

"What do you want?"
texts.zh:
通讯接通，显出 Maeus Moroz 的脸。他看上去不太高兴。

"你想要什么？"

texts.en:
The image flickers and holds.

"After each sleep, I tell myself 'you live to see Dolos Macario dead'."

He does not look well. Too little sleep, too much drink.

"Vengeance sustains a man. But no more," he mutters.
texts.zh:
影像闪了闪，稳住了。

"每次睡醒，我都对自己说：'你活着，是为了亲眼看见 Dolos Macario 死'。"

他气色很糟。睡得少，喝得多。

"复仇撑着一个男人活下去。可也撑不了多久了，"他喃喃道。

texts.en:
The image flickers and holds.

"After each sleep, I tell myself 'you live to see Dolos Macario dead'. Vengeance sustains a man. But no more," he mutters.

He does not look well. Too little sleep, too much drink. His eyes manage to find yours through the comms.

"What do you want?"
texts.zh:
影像闪了闪，稳住了。

"每次睡醒，我都对自己说：'你活着，是为了亲眼看见 Dolos Macario 死'。复仇撑着一个男人活下去。可也撑不了多久了，"他喃喃道。

他气色很糟。睡得少，喝得多。他的目光穿过通讯，勉强找到你的眼睛。

"你想要什么？"

options.en: I'm looking for Pericles Moroz.
I'm looking for Pericles Aventine.
I'm looking for Pericles Andrada.

texts.en:
He stares at you for a long moment. His eyes have seen death, and many times over. You can tell.

"Why? Why do you want my son? Speak!"

For a man with the composure of a warrior, he seems unduly upset by your question.
texts.zh:
他盯着你看了很久。那双眼睛见过死亡，而且不止一次。你看得出来。

"为什么？你找我儿子做什么？说！"

对一个有战士般沉稳的人来说，这一退让太多了，多得不寻常。

options.en: I need to warn him. Someone is killing those... like him.
options.zh: 我得警告他。有人在杀那些... 像他一样的人。

options.en: He's a clone of Philip Andrada.
options.zh: 他是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体。

options.en: I have a business opportunity. Mercenary work. (lie)
options.zh: 我有个做买卖的机会。雇佣兵的活儿。 (说谎)

options.en: You seem... did something happen?
options.zh: 你看起来... 出什么事了？

texts.en:
Maeus simply looks at you for a long time. He seems less angry now than simply old. And sad.

"And these killings. How do you know of this." His voice is suddenly calm. "How is that, I must ask, unless you are one of them? Them that did it. A turncoat, a traitor, another spy playing a spy-game?"

"Answer me captain, and well."
texts.zh:
Maeus 只是久久地看着你。他现在看上去不那么愤怒了，只是老。还有悲伤。

"还有这些凶杀。你是怎么知道的。\"他的声音骤然平静下来。\"这我就得问了：除非你就是他们中的一个？就是干下这些事的那伙人？一个倒戈的、一个叛徒，又一个玩着间谍把戏的间谍？"

"回答我，舰长，好好回答。"

options.en: I can't tell you that. You'll have to trust me.
options.zh: 这个我不能告诉你。你得信我。

options.en: I found intel intended for Dolos Macario.
options.zh: 我找到了一份情报，本来是送给 Dolos Macario 的。

texts.en:
"Trust you." He spits the words. "Over the body of my son, my only son, dead in the street!"

"You know." His voice becomes deadly calm.

"Where he came from, before he was my son. How is that, I must ask, unless you are one of them? Them that did it. Answer me captain, and well."
texts.zh:
"信你。\"他把这两个字吐出来。\"拿我儿子的尸首起誓——我唯一的儿子，死在街上！"

"你知道。"他的声音变得死一般平静。

"他是从哪里来的，在他成为我儿子之前。这我就得问了：除非你就是他们中的一个？就是干下这些事的人。回答我，舰长，好好回答。"

texts.en:
"Trust you." He spits the words. "Over the body of my son, my only son, dead in the street!"

"You know." His voice becomes deadly calm.

"Where he came from, before he was my son. How is that, I must ask, unless you are one of them? Maybe you are working for Dolos. Answer me captain, and well."
texts.zh:
"信你。\"他把这两个字吐出来。\"拿我儿子的尸首起誓——我唯一的儿子，死在街上！"

"你知道。"他的声音变得死一般平静。

"他是从哪里来的，在他成为我儿子之前。这我就得问了：除非你就是他们中的一个？也许你在替 Dolos 做事。回答我，舰长，好好回答。"

options.en: I found intel. It was meant for Dolos Macario...
options.zh: 我找到了一份情报。本来是送给 Dolos Macario 的...

options.en: I'm not one of 'them'. Trust me.
options.zh: 我不是'他们'中的一个。信我。

options.en: I'm working for Dolos Macario. (lie)
options.zh: 我在替 Dolos Macario 做事。 (说谎)

options.en: I'm working for Siyavong, a Persean League intelligence officer. (lie)
options.zh: 我在替 Siyavong 做事，他是英仙座联盟的情报官。 (说谎)

options.en: I'm working for Siyavong, a League intelligence officer. Kind of.
options.zh: 我在替 Siyavong 做事，他是联盟的情报官。算是吧。

texts.en:
He stares at you for a long moment. His eyes have seen death, and many times over. You can tell.

It takes him several deep breaths to speak.

"You lie," he says, finally. "I will meet you, in space. One of us must die."
texts.zh:
他久久地盯着你。那双眼睛见过死亡，而且不止一次——你看得出来。

他连吸了好几口大气，才终于开口。

"你撒谎，\"他终于说道，\"我在太空里等你。我们两个，必须死一个。"

texts.en:
He stares at you for a long moment. His eyes have seen death, and many times over. You can tell.

Maeus takes a deep breath.
texts.zh:
他久久地盯着你。那双眼睛见过死亡，而且不止一次——你看得出来。

Maeus 深吸了一口气。

options.en:
Let me buy you a drink. You could use it.
#sd7sMaeus_barWasLooking:"I was looking for him, it's true. I found out who he is."
options.zh:
让我请你喝一杯。你现在正需要。
#sd7sMaeus_barWasLooking:"我确实在找他。我查清了他的身份。"

texts.en:
After a moment he grunts an affirmation.

* * *
texts.zh:
片刻之后，他闷声应了一声，算是同意。

* * *

options.en: Take a shuttle down to Orthrus and meet Maeus Moroz
options.zh: 乘穿梭机降落 Orthrus，与 Maeus Moroz 会面

texts.en: You take a shuttle down to the main concourse and quickly find a likely-looking establishment.
texts.zh: 你搭乘穿梭机来到主港区内，很快就找到了一家看起来还不错的店。

texts.en: As you enter the bar you are buffeted by the human white-noise of conversation and revelry. Ad-holos buzz softly from ceiling-mounted units, shining garish highlights through glasses and bottles as spacer crews mingle with merchants and locals trading drinks for rumor, jobs, and opportunities.
texts.zh: 刚踏入酒吧，人群的嘈杂与喧嚣立即扑面而来。天花板上的全息广告装置发出柔和的嗡嗡声，将艳俗的广告铺撒在杯盏交错之间。宇宙民们混杂在生意人和本地人当中，用酒水换取流言、工作和机遇。

texts.en:
As you enter the bar you are buffeted by the white-noise of conversation. A spacer at a cheap table looks at you and shock crosses their face. They nudge the merchant on the seat beside, and point. A hush falls over the bar. The ad-holos buzz softly, shining garish highlights through glasses.

Several groups rise and leave, glaring acidly; one spacer spits at your feet, muttering curses. Your guards' hands find their weapons, but nothing more is necessary. You enter the bar, quieter than you found it; most drinkers do their best to pretend they didn't see you.
texts.zh:
刚踏入酒吧，谈话的喧嚣立即扑面而来。一个坐在廉价吧台后的宇宙民看到了你，脸上不由自主地掠过一丝震惊。他和同伴推了推坐在一旁的商人，还指了指你。一片寂静开始在酒吧里蔓延开来，只有全息广告装置依旧轻声作响，在杯盏之间投射着艳俗的广告。

有几群人起身离开了，临走前不忘酸溜溜地瞪了你一眼。一个宇宙民向你的脚下吐了口唾沫，低声咒骂了一句什么。你的卫兵把手放到了武器上，但暂时没有拔出来的必要。你找到了明显比之前安静了许多的吧台，在你走向那边时，大部分的酒客都尽力假装没看到你。

texts.en:
As you enter the bar you are buffeted by the white-noise of conversation. A spacer at a cheap table looks at you with a double-take of recognition. They elbow their drinking companions, stand, and aggressively - unsteadily - approach you. At three meters they halt as they just now spot your guards, who have made themselves less inconspicuous.

"You! You can't go doing what you're doing," the spacer finds words are preferable now to a physical altercation. "Throwing i-pulses at the hyperspace beasties and the ghosties. It's bad luck. Bad, bad luck going shoutin' at things yer not meant to!" They've begun shouting at you, which you feel violates the generalized principle. "-'ll be the death of us all!"

The spacer's comrades, eyeing you, pull their loud companion back toward a quiet corner. A few onlookers make corrupted motions of Luddic blessing; spacer signs against ill-omen.
texts.zh:
刚踏入酒吧，谈话的喧嚣扑面而来。一个坐在廉价吧台后的宇宙民看到了你，脸上不由自主地掠过一丝震惊。他们用手肘顶了顶喝得醉醺醺的同伴，站起身，不怀好意地靠过来。注意到你身边乔装打扮过的警卫后，他们在三米开外的地方停了下来。

"你！你做那些事情是会遭报应的！" 那个宇宙民没法动手，就转而寻找些适合当下的言语开骂了过来，"朝那些超空间野兽和幽灵丢阻断脉冲是会倒大霉的。晦气！太晦气了！干这一行的都知道不该朝这些东西大吼的！" 对方的言辞逐渐激烈，让你觉得自己好比犯下了基本原则方面的大错一样。"这会害我们所有人送命的！"

这个宇宙民的同伴一边盯着你，一边把他们的大嗓门同伴拉回安静的角落。一些围观的人做着各种有些走样的卢德教派祈福动作，这是宇宙民驱邪的动作。

texts.en: The lounge is adorned on all surfaces in richly gilt geometrics; black marble columns underlit by cool light-tubes seem to hang effortlessly in the air. Corporate climbers, either slick Tri-Tachyon careerists or wannabes in crisp suits, negotiate deals while buying one another increasingly unlikely cocktails. A few spacers engage in subdued drinking in the low seats, glancing uneasily at what is either abstract art or some kind of holo-projection rig looming from the ceiling.
texts.zh: 酒座里的各个墙面都装饰着富丽堂皇的镀金几何图形。黑色大理石柱沐浴在冷光管的柔光之下，雍容华贵地悬在空中。在速子科技名利场里打拼的家伙们全都西装革履，在谈生意的同时不断买来价格越来越离谱的鸡尾酒请客。一些宇宙民则在矮靠背椅上低调地喝着酒，有些局促地瞥着那些若隐若现地从天花板上投影下来的不知是抽象艺术还是全息投影的东西。

texts.en: The space is dark and filled with shouts, sweat, and pulsing music. Every wall and surface is pitted and stained by rough spacers banging their mugs and laughing as a couple of pirate crews posture for a fight. You can only assume that one of the heavily augmented bouncers will spoil the fun before weapons are drawn. Gangers and pirate captains watch the scene smugly from smoke-filled booths at the back.
texts.zh: 昏暗的空间里塞满了呐喊、汗臭和律动着的音乐。正好有两拨海盗船员摆出了要干上一架的样子，惹得酒吧里这群粗野的太空佬们大笑起哄，抄起他们手中的杯子给所有的墙和桌面又敲上了一层坑洼和污渍。看来你只能指望在有人拔枪干起来之前，那群全身堆满生化改造的看场保安里会出来个人扫一扫大家的兴头。在后面烟雾缭绕的隔间里，帮派分子和海盗舰长们看着这场面有些满意地笑了起来。

texts.en: You enter the crowded, well-lit space and take in the rows of taps adorning the wall under bottles from every one of the Core Worlds - and a few from elsewhere. Merchant-captains mingle with off-duty officers at the bar, served efficiently by the uniformed staff. In one corner, a pack of navy cadets shout and sing, desperately enjoying their last work-shift of freedom.
texts.zh: 刚踏入这明亮而拥挤的地方，你的目光就被缀满墙上的一排排酒水龙头吸引过去。龙头上的瓶装酒产地遍布核心世界的每个星球，甚至还有几种出自边缘地带的酒水。商船舰长和休班军官在酒吧里打成一片，穿着制服的工作人员麻利地穿梭其间。在一个角落里，一群海军学员正高唱呐喊，拼命地享受着他们最后一班的自由。

texts.en: You enter the bar, leaving the noisome propaganda broadcasts of the throughway behind. Off-duty laborers drink away their ration credits dutifully at benches set beneath Diktat insignia. In one corner a cadre of finely dressed officer-bureaucrats calls for another round. Even here, a larger-than-life holo of the Lion of Sindria looks down on you as you decide what to do.
texts.zh: 你进入酒吧，把宣传政治大方向的嘈杂广播抛在了身后。下班的劳动者们聚在 辛达强权 标志下方的长凳上，尽职尽责地喝掉他们的粮票。角落里，一群衣着光鲜的军官和文职人员叫嚣着要再来一轮。就算在这种地方，也有个比真人更伟岸的辛达瑞亚之狮全息投影俯视着你，等着你做出下一步的决定。

texts.en: You enter the bar, leaving the noisome propaganda broadcasts of the throughway behind. Off-duty laborers drink away their ration credits dutifully at benches set beneath the new Diktat insignia. In one corner a cadre of finely dressed officer-bureaucrats calls for another round.
texts.zh: 你走进酒吧，把通道里那吵人的宣传广播关在了身后。歇了工的劳工坐在新换的强权徽记下的长凳上，本分地把配给信用点喝个精光。角落里，一伙衣冠考究的军官官僚又招呼着再来一轮。

texts.en: As you enter the bar, you sense a lively tension between the crews from across the League worlds. Dour Kazeronians in fine uniforms drink spirits while proud but poor Mayasurans down pints of rice-beer. A crew of Tylians trade rounds and boasts with a couple Zaganian bridge officers who are making a poor example of Luddic temperance. Glowing displays show media feeds from all the worlds of the League, and their speakers contribute to a dull roar of human white noise.
texts.zh: 从进入酒吧的那一刻起，你就感受到了来自联盟世界各地的船员之间求同存异的氛围。不苟言笑的 Kazeron 人身着光鲜的制服喝着烈酒，旁边高傲但落魄的 Mayasura 人则一扎又一扎地灌着稻啤酒。一群 Tyle 船员与几名 Zagan 舰桥军官边吹牛边拼酒，为卢德教规提倡的节制立了个坏榜样。众多显示屏五光十色地展示着来自联盟各个行星的媒体资讯，而它们的扬声器也为这众人的喧哗平添了一分吵闹。

texts.en: You duck past notices encouraging temperance and restraint as you enter the bar. Someone is playing a stringed instrument in an alcove. A row of handworked samovars suggests that tea is served as often as the weak grain-brew favored by the crew of rough-looking laborers at the bar. Many of the patrons at tables or booths seem to be off-worlders or local unbelievers huddling in the closest analog to a den of sin that can be found.
texts.zh: 你低头避开了鼓励节欲与克制的告示牌，走入酒吧。角落的凹室里有人在演奏着某种弦乐器。吧台旁边一排手工制作的茶炊，提醒你这里经常供应茶水，销量可能和吧台上那些劳工大老粗们爱喝的淡啤酒差不多。不少看起来像是外星访客的人和不信教的当地人聚集几张桌台附近，交流买卖着情报，构成了这里最像罪恶巢穴的地方。

texts.en: A weathered brute from the local vice squad stares rudely as you pass, but does not stop you as you enter the door. They want you to know that they could shut the place down at any time - but an illicit teahouse-bar is a useful conduit with the commerce required to carry out holy war. Inside it is dim, the ceiling low, and the crowd packed. The stench of drug fumes and cheap liquor competes with bodies that disdain modern enzyme soaps.
texts.zh: 在你经过时，当地惩戒团的一头饱经沧桑的彪形大汉狠狠地瞪了你一眼，但并没有阻止你进门。他们只是想让你知道，要不是能为开展圣战提供有利的交易渠道，这样一个违禁的茶楼酒肆他们随时都可以取缔掉。在这昏暗压抑且拥挤不堪的地方里，因不屑使用现代酶制香皂而产生的独特体臭四处弥漫，与毒品烟雾和廉价烈酒的恶臭争奇斗艳。

texts.en: As you enter the bar you are struck by the lack of conversation and revelry. Ad-holos promoting Mbaye-Gogol cryosanctum packages buzz softly from ceiling-mounted units, shining cool highlights through glasses and bottles as subdued spacer crews mingle. A few merchant-captains hold a low conversation while ignoring the few local employees who seem mostly content to drink alone.
texts.zh: 你一进门便觉出这里既无谈笑，也无喧闹。天花板上装的装置低低嗡鸣，播着 Mbaye-Gogol 低温圣所套餐的广告全息影像，冷光透过杯盏瓶罐洒下，几群神色收敛的太空人船员在其中走动。几位商船船长压低了嗓子交谈，对那几个本地雇员不理不睬，而他们倒也多半乐得独饮。

texts.en:
You arrive first, but Moroz is not late. As he sits, he gives the bartender a look and a nod.

The buzz of general conversation from the other patrons starts to rise, tentatively. You don't have to guess what they're talking about.
texts.zh:
你先到了，但 Moroz 也不算迟到。落座时，他朝酒保递了个眼色，点了点头。

其他客人闲聊的嗡嗡声试探着响了起来。他们谈的是什么，你不用猜也知道。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Moroz looks over you as what appears to be his usual drink appears.

"You know. About Pericles. How?"

Without looking at it, he lifts his drink, pauses, then downs perhaps half the volume.
texts.zh:
Moroz 打量着你，这时他惯常喝的那种酒端了上来。

"你知道了。Pericles 的事。怎么知道的？"

他看也不看那杯酒，端起来，顿了顿，然后一口灌下大约半杯。

options.en: It's a long story.

texts.en:
Moroz finishes the drink. Then takes a deep breath, gestures to the bartender, and returns his attention to you.

"I have time."
texts.zh:
Moroz 把酒喝完。然后深吸一口气，朝酒保招了招手，又把注意力转回你身上。

"我有的是时间。"

options.en: Tell him the broad strokes. You must maintain some OPSEC
options.zh: 只讲个大概。总得留些 OPSEC

options.en: Tell him everything. His son is dead, he deserves to know
options.zh: 全都告诉他。他儿子死了，他有权知道

options.en: Tell him little. Control the narrative to your advantage
options.zh: 少说些。把话头引向对你有利的方向

options.en: Tell him the broad strokes. You must maintain some OPSEC
options.zh: 只讲个大概。总得留些 OPSEC

options.en: Tell him everything. A part of Philip Andrada died under his care.
options.zh: 全都告诉他。Philip Andrada 的一部分，是在他的照看下死去的。

options.en: Tell him little. Control the narrative to your advantage
options.zh: 少说些。把话头引向对你有利的方向

texts.en:
You tell Maeus the broad strokes of what you've found, starting with the facts of the matter: Dolos Macario pulled you into a scheme, and you acquired some of his files. You had those files decrypted and discovered the cloning project.

Maeus is no trained intellectual, but his mind is sharp - and suspicious. It's what he's had to be to get this far in his trade.
texts.zh:
你把查到的东西拣大略告诉了 Maeus，从事情本身的实情讲起：Dolos Macario 把你拖进了一桩阴谋，你弄到了他的一些文件。你找人解密了这些文件，发现了那个克隆计划。

Maeus 没受过什么学院训练，可他的头脑锐利——而且多疑。干他这一行能走到今天，他就得是这样。

texts.en:
"I thank you captain," he says, setting another glass among the crowd of empties.

"I know who must die." He takes a deep breath, looking up and away.

"Dolos Macario."

He stands. Impressively steady for how much he's had.
texts.zh:
"谢谢你，舰长，"他说着，把又一只杯子搁进那一堆空杯之间。

"我知道谁必须死。"他深吸一口气，抬眼望向别处。

"Dolos Macario。"

他站起身。喝了这么多还能站得这么稳，令人佩服。

texts.en:
You've discovered the fate of each of the seven sons of Philip Andrada.

Scattered to the small worlds of the Persean Sector, some died by the hand of assassins, others never truly lived.

But enough survived. The blood of Andrada lives on.
texts.zh:
你已经查清了 Philip Andrada 七个儿子各自的结局。

他们被散落到英仙座星域的小世界，有的死于刺客之手，有的从未真正活过。

但活下来的已经够多。Andrada 的血脉仍在延续。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
You've discovered the seven Andradas and found Macario's contingency plan for control of the Sindrian Diktat in the form of Hector Andrada. It is clear, too, that he does not fully control the situation and perhaps never did. He would have never allowed Achilles to live.

History waits in fine balance as each presumptive heir builds strength.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly.

Openly - and soon.
texts.zh:
你查清了七位 Andrada 其人，也发现了 Macario 为掌控辛达强权所备的后手——Hector Andrada。同样清楚的是，他并未完全握得住局面，或许从来就没握住过。否则他绝不会让 Achilles 活着。

历史悬在一线之间，每位自认的继承者都在积蓄力量。

只消一点火星，冲突就会明面烧起来。

明面开战——而且很快。

texts.en:
Whatever the schemes of the Andrada's divided old guard, two of Philip's sons have moved into the foremost positions to succeed as Supreme Executor of their clone-father's empire: Hector and Achilles. Two of seven.

History waits in fine balance as each builds strength, as each prepares to gamble everything.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly. And soon. They will be vulnerable. They will see rivals only in one another.

That will be the time to strike.
texts.zh:
无论 Andrada 家那些各怀心思的旧部在打什么算盘，Philip 的两个儿子已经站到了最前头，只等接掌他们克隆父亲帝国的最高元首之位：Hector 与 Achilles。七人中的二人。

历史悬在一线之间，两人各自积蓄力量，各自准备押上全部。

只消一点火星，冲突就会明面爆发。而且很快。届时他们都最是脆弱。他们眼中只会有彼此这一个对手。

那就是动手的时候。

History waits in fine balance as each builds strength and prepares to gamble everything.

texts.en:
Whatever the schemes of the Andrada's divided old guard, two of Philip's heirs - his true blood - have moved into the foremost positions to succeed as Supreme Executor of their father's empire: Hector and Achilles. Two viable heirs of the original seven. But are they made weak by corrupting influence - one by Macario's scheming, the other by the League's? Can Andrada's blood, can his transcendent philosophy, overcome such setback?

History waits in fine balance as each builds strength and prepares to gamble everything.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly. And soon. They will be vulnerable. They will see rivals only in one another.

One thing is clear: you must choose.
texts.zh:
无论 Andrada 家那些各怀心思的旧部在打什么算盘，Philip 的两位继承人——他真正的血脉——已经站到了最前头，只等接掌他们父亲帝国的最高元首之位：Hector 与 Achilles。最初七人中仅存的两个可继之人。可他们是否已被腐蚀性的影响弄弱了——一个毁于 Macario 的算计，另一个毁于联盟的？Andrada 的血脉，他那套超凡的哲学，能跨过这样的挫折吗？

历史悬在一线之间，两人各自积蓄力量，各自准备押上全部。

只消一点火星，冲突就会明面爆发。而且很快。届时他们都最是脆弱。他们眼中只会有彼此这一个对手。

有一件事很清楚：你必须选边。

* * *

texts.en:
"No," he says. "There is not trust here." He shows this, moving his hand between you and him.

"It is how it is. I will kill Dolos Macario in my way, and you will do what you do." Maeus shrugs.

"Burn bright."

He leaves.
texts.zh:
"不，"他说。"这里没有信任。"他用手在你和他之间比了比，表示的就是这个意思。

"事情就是这样。我会用我的方式杀了 Dolos Macario，你干你该干的事。"Maeus 耸了耸肩。

"烧得亮些。"

他走了。

texts.en:
Before he leaves, he calls you 'comrade' and shares talk of strategies of assassination and covert ops, raiding and piracy, and lopsided fleet actions.

It is no small task, taking down Macario, and no truly hard plans can be made this night. But you have gained an ally who seeks blood vengeance and will give his life for that cause.

At the time and place of need, Maeus will fight Macario. This he swears.
texts.zh:
临走之前，他称你一声"同志"，与你聊起暗杀与秘密行动的战术、劫掠与海盗行径，以及以多打少的舰队交锋。

扳倒 Macario 绝非易事，今晚也做不出什么真正周密的计划。但你得到了一个盟友：他要的是血债血偿，并愿为此付出性命。

到该动手的时候、该动手的地方，Maeus 会与 Macario 一战。这是他立下的誓。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Maeus gives you a long look.

"I think you are not stupid, captain. But you can be stupid." He jabs a finger at you. "You know who Dolos Macario is? You heard stories, about what he's done? I think you have. There are too many, told by too many, to be lies made to make a man look bad."

"Besides," his expression closes, darkly. "I do know what kind of man Dolos Macario is."

He stands up, pushes his (latest) empty glass back.
texts.zh:
Maeus 久久地看了你一眼。

"我看你不蠢，舰长。可你也会犯蠢。\"他伸手指着你。\"你知道 Dolos Macario 是什么人？你听过关于他的那些故事？我看你听过。传的人太多，故事也太多，不像是编出来抹黑一个人的谎话。"

"再说，\"他的神情收拢，沉了下去。\"我确实知道 Dolos Macario 是怎样一个人。"

他站起身，把 (最新的一只) 空杯推回去。

"Yes," he says. "I will kill Dolos Macario in my way, and you will do what you do."

Maeus stands, shoving his (latest) glass back to join the others.

"Burn bright."

He leaves.

"好，\"他说。\"我会用我的方式杀了 Dolos Macario，你干你该干的事。"

Maeus 站起身，把 (最新的一只) 杯子推回去，和其余的空杯作伴。

"烧得亮些。"

他走了。

texts.en:
You tell him everything you know, and how - starting at the ugly encounter in a Sindrian bar with an intelligence officer who was shot by the Spider of Sindria himself not long after.

You even show him the files on your TriPad. Each clone of Andrada, each put into a different place and raised - in some form - in a different way.

You get the feeling, behind his gruff manner, that he acknowledges and values the trust you've given him. Maeus does not ask for a copy of the files, though from his questions you get the impression that he'd guessed at the edges of the truth already. All seven of them.

Maeus is no trained intellectual, but his mind is sharp and suspicious. It's what he's had to be to get this far in his trade.
texts.zh:
你把你所知的一切都告诉了他，连同来龙去脉——从辛达强权治下一间酒吧里那场难看的相遇讲起，讲那位情报官，讲他没多久就被辛达瑞亚的蜘蛛本人开枪打死。

你甚至把 TriPad 上的文件给他看。Andrada 的每一个克隆体，各自被安置在不同的地方，以不同的方式——多少算是——被养大。

你能感觉到，在他那粗鲁的外表之下，他认可并看重你给予的信任。Maeus 没有要一份文件副本，可从他的问话里你看得出，他早已猜到了真相的边角。七个，全都在内。

Maeus 没受过什么学院训练，可他的头脑锐利，而且多疑。干他这一行能走到今天，他就得是这样的人。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
You tell him little but for the key facts of the matter - that you acquired files intended for Macario and decrypted them without his knowledge, you investigated where they led and found a project to produce clones of Philip Andrada. You don't specify how many, or how exact your intel is.

His eyes are suspicious. Maeus has a sharp mind, even if he's no academician.
texts.zh:
你只拣关键的事实说了些——你弄到了一些本该送到 Macario 手里的文件，在他不知情的情况下解密了它们；你顺着线索查下去，发现了一个制造 Philip Andrada 克隆体的计划。你没有说明一共有几个，也没说你的情报究竟有多确切。

他的目光满是疑虑。Maeus 头脑锐利，哪怕称不上一位院士。

options.zh: 你就不想听听我的解释？

options.en: You're making a mistake, Maeus.
I had nothing to do with it! I swear this by the stars and life they give.
options.zh: 这事跟我毫无关系！我以群星起誓，以群星赐予的生命起誓。

I serve the Sindrian Diktat! To spill the blood of Andrada is treason!
options.zh: 我效忠辛达强权！杀害 Andrada 家的人，就是叛国！

texts.en: The comms snap off.
texts.zh: 通讯骤然切断。

texts.en:
You've discovered that Pericles Aventine - or 'Moroz', or 'Andrada' - is dead. Someone got to him first and got away without giving Maeus a chance for revenge.

He's grasping for someone to blame. And he's found you.
texts.zh:
你查明 Pericles Aventine——或者说'Moroz'，或者说'Andrada'——已经死了。有人抢先一步杀了他，又全身而退，没给 Maeus 留下半点复仇的机会。

他正四处抓一个人来担这份罪责。而现在，他抓住了你。

texts.en:
He narrows his eyes, his gaze boring through your armor. It is relentless, unforgiving. But you hold.

Maeus takes a deep breath and closes his eyes.

He looks sad, now, and old.
texts.zh:
他眯起眼睛，目光仿佛要穿透你的装甲。那目光毫不放松，也不留半分情面。可你撑住了。

Maeus 深吸一口气，闭上了眼睛。

此刻他看上去既悲伤，又苍老。

options.en:
Let me buy you a drink. You could use it.
#sd7sMaeus_commsWasLooking:"I was looking for him, it's true. I found out who he is."
options.zh:
让我请你喝一杯。你现在正需要。
#sd7sMaeus_commsWasLooking:"我确实在找他。我查清了他的身份。"

texts.en: "An intelligence officer," he repeats. "-Kind of?" The look he's giving you does not bode well.
texts.zh: "情报官，"他重复道，"——'算是吧'？"他看你的眼神可不是好兆头。

texts.en:
"Dolos the Spider."

Maeus looks away, as if deep in memory. His eyes snap back toward you.

"You said 'those like him'. What is it you mean by that?"
texts.zh:
"蜘蛛 Dolos。"

Maeus 移开目光，像是陷入了久远的记忆。随即他的眼睛又猛地转回你身上。

"你说'像他一样的人'。这话是什么意思？"

options.en: I shouldn't tell you more. You'll have to trust me.
options.zh: 我不该再多说了。你得信我。

options.en: Pericles is a clone of Philip Andrada.
options.zh: Pericles 是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体。

texts.en:
"No. He was my son!" His voice cracks. "No matter what some test says, he was that."

His use of the past tense is telling. And, appallingly, Maeus seems to be holding back tears.
texts.zh:
"不。他是我的儿子！\"他的声音裂了。\"不管哪份检测报告怎么说，他就是我的儿子。"

他用的是过去时，这就说明了一切。而令人心惊的是，Maeus 似乎正在忍住眼泪。

options.en: Did something happen to Pericles?

texts.en:
He narrows his eyes, as if calculating. His jaw clenches and unclenches. There's an unsecured hatch atop a growing rage.

"You knew." His voice is suddenly calm.

"Where he came from, before he was my son. How is that, I must ask, unless you are one of them? Them that did it. Answer me captain, and well."
texts.zh:
他眯起眼睛，像是在盘算。牙关一紧一松。一腔渐涨的怒火之上，还压着一道没闩牢的舱门。

"你早就知道。"他的声音骤然平静下来。

"他是从哪里来的，在他成为我儿子之前。这我就得问了：除非你就是他们中的一个？就是干下这些事的人。回答我，舰长，好好回答。"

texts.en:
"You lie."

The cold professionalism drains from Moroz's face, replaced by a slowly growing rage.

"Who sent you? Tell me! Did you help them?"

He stands, shouting.

"Did you kill my son?!"
texts.zh:
"你在撒谎。"

那股冷峻的职业气度从 Moroz 脸上一层层褪去，取而代之的是一腔缓缓涨起的怒火。

"谁派你来的？说！你有没有帮他们？"

他站起来，吼着。

"是不是你杀了我儿子？！"

options.en: What? No. He's dead?
No, but I wish I did. He was the spawn of Philip Andrada.
options.zh: 不是我。但我倒希望是我干的。他是 Philip Andrada 的种。

options.en: Yes. His true name was Pericles Andrada so he had to die. (lie)
options.zh: 是我。他真名是 Pericles Andrada，所以他必须死。 (说谎)

texts.en:
He stares at you for a long moment. His eyes have seen death, and many times over. You can tell.

Apparently this one, the Pericles who was - as you've just learned - murdered, affected him like no other.

It takes him several deep breaths to speak.

"I will meet you, in space. One of us must die."

The comms snap off.
texts.zh:
他久久地盯着你。那双眼睛见过死亡，而且不止一次——你看得出来。

而眼前这个 Pericles——你刚刚得知，他已遭人谋杀——看来对他的触动，远非旁人可比。

他连吸了好几口大气，才终于开口。

"我在太空里等你。我们两个，必须死一个。"

It breaks, like a wave, and Maeus deflates. A sad, old man.

"They killed him. Now you come, with his name in your mouth. What am I to make of that?"

options.en: What happened? Who is 'they'?
I'm sorry. But I think I know why someone came for him.
options.zh: 很抱歉。但我想我知道，为什么会有人冲他而来。

options.en: That's good. He was the spawn of Philip Andrada.
options.zh: 那很好。他是 Philip Andrada 的野种。

texts.en:
The cold professionalism drains from Moroz's face. He is white with shock, and increasingly, you find, rage.

"How do you know to ask that? Who sent you? Tell me! Did you help them?"

He stands, shouting.

"Did you kill my son?!"
texts.zh:
Moroz 脸上那层冷峻的职业做派一瞬间褪尽。他震惊得脸色发白，而你看得出，那苍白正一点点化作怒火。

"你怎么会问到这个？谁派你来的？说！你是不是帮了他们？"

他霍然起身，吼了起来。

"是你杀了我儿子？！"

options.en: What? No. He's dead?
No, but I wish I did. He was the spawn of Philip Andrada.
options.zh: 不是我。但我倒希望是我干的。他是 Philip Andrada 的种。

options.en: Yes. His true name was Pericles Andrada so he had to die. (lie)
options.zh: 是我。他真名是 Pericles Andrada，所以他必须死。 (说谎)

options.en: I'm looking for Pericles Aventine. He's a mercenary active in this volume.
options.zh: 我在找 Pericles Aventine。他是个在这一带活动的雇佣兵。

texts.en:
"Pericles... Aventine?" $HeOrShe rubs $hisOrHer chin. "Haven't heard that name, no. Not a common name, Pericles..."

"Do you mean Pericles Moroz, the son of Maeus Moroz? Maeus runs the Samarra Wolves, a merc company based here on Orthrus. They regularly take on security contracts both from the polity and private jobs. Often enough for the Hegemony, too, if you'll believe it."
texts.zh:
"Pericles... Aventine？\"$HeOrShe 搓了搓$hisOrHer下巴。\"没听过这名字，没有。Pericles 可不是个常见的名字..."

"你是指 Maeus Moroz 的儿子 Pericles Moroz？Maeus 经营着 Samarra Wolves，一家以 Orthrus 为基地的雇佣兵公司。他们经常接下政体的安保合同，也接私活。信不信由你，还常常替霸主干活。"

texts.en:
"Pericles... Aventine?" $HeOrShe rubs $hisOrHer chin. "Haven't heard of them, no. Pericles though... not a common name."

"Do you mean Pericles Moroz, son of Maeus Moroz? Maeus runs the Samarra Wolves, a merc company based here on Orthrus. They regularly take on security contracts both from the polity and private jobs. Often enough for the Hegemony, too, if you'll believe- er." $HeOrShe coughs.

"What I mean, $titleHeg, is Maeus doesn't have a commission like you do, but he does work closely with the Hegemony.
texts.zh:
"Pericles... Aventine？\"$HeOrShe 搓了搓$hisOrHer下巴。\"没听过这号人，没有。不过 Pericles... 这名字可不常见。"

"你是指 Pericles Moroz，Maeus Moroz 的儿子？Maeus 经营着 Samarra Wolves，一家以 Orthrus 为基地的雇佣兵公司。他们经常接下政体的安保合同，也接私活。信不信由你，还常常替霸主干活——呃。"$HeOrShe 咳了一声。

"我的意思是，$titleHeg，Maeus 不像你，没有正式的委任，但他确实跟霸主走得很近。"

options.en: They work for the Hegemony?
Moroz, of course. Do you have his comms ID?
options.zh: 当然是 Moroz。你有他的通讯 ID 吗？

options.en: They work for the Hegemony?
Moroz, of course. Do you have his comms ID?
options.zh: 当然是 Moroz。你有他的通讯 ID 吗？

texts.en:
"Sometimes. Considering how they bend the law from time to time, it's... well." $HeOrShe just shrugs. "But Maeus gets the job done. Pericles too, although..."

$HeOrShe frowns and shakes $hisOrHer head.
texts.zh:
"有时候吧。考虑到他们隔三差五就绕着法律走，这事... 嗯。\"$HeOrShe 只是耸了耸肩。\"不过 Maeus 能把活干成。Pericles 也是，只是..."

$HeOrShe 皱起眉头，摇了摇$hisOrHer的头。

options.en: Although what?

texts.en:
The $post examines you for a moment.

"Between you and me, captain, he's... overenthusiastic. I wouldn't use the word 'bloodthirsty', that's not quite it, but..."
texts.zh:
$post 打量了你片刻。

"私下跟你说，舰长，他... 太热心了。我不会用'嗜血'这个词，那不算贴切，不过..."

options.en: And the Hegemony allows it?
What does Maeus think? Isn't he in charge?
options.zh: Maeus 怎么看？他不是管事的吗？

texts.en:
$PersonLastName smiles uncertainly.

"You're not new to this, captain. Orthrus is not Hegemony space, not yet anyway. So let me put it to you straight."

"When the Hegemony can't get the results it wants within their system of rules and regulations, they'll still get the results they want. You understand?"
texts.zh:
$PersonLastName 露出一个不确定的微笑。

"舰长，你可不是新手。Orthrus 不是霸主的领空，至少现在还不是。所以我就跟你直说了吧。"

"当霸主在它那套规章制度之内得不到想要的结果时，它照样会得到想要的结果。你明白吗？"

options.en: If Pericles is a problem, why doesn't Maeus rein him in?
options.zh: 如果 Pericles 是个麻烦，Maeus 为什么不约束他？

texts.en:
"I think he does."

$HeOrShe gives you a long look.

"I need not remind you that I consider this conversation to be in strict confidence."

$HeOrShe looks away, tapping at an interface.

"Lots of work to do. Burn bright?"
texts.zh:
"我想他明白。"

$HeOrShe 长久地看了你一眼。

"不必我提醒你，我认为这次谈话绝对保密。"

$HeOrShe 移开目光，点着某个界面。

"活儿多着呢。火光长明？"

texts.en:
"He is," $heOrShe says. "For now. What scares me is what Pericles would be like if he wasn't."

$HeOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat and glances away.

"I need not remind you that I consider this conversation to be in strict confidence."
texts.zh:
"他是在管，\"$heOrShe 说。\"至少眼下如此。我害怕的是，万一没人管，Pericles 会变成什么样。"

$HeOrShe 清了清$hisOrHer嗓子，把目光移开。

"不必我提醒你，我认为这次谈话绝对保密。"

texts.en:
"He is," $heOrShe says. "For now. What scares me is what Pericles would be like if he wasn't."

$HeOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat and glances away.

"I need not remind you that I consider this conversation to be in strict confidence."

"他是在管，\"$heOrShe 说。\"至少眼下如此。我害怕的是，万一没人管，Pericles 会变成什么样。"

"不必我提醒你，我认为这次谈话绝对保密。"

options.en: Of course. And the Hegemony - they allow this?
options.zh: 当然。那霸主呢——他们允许这种事？

options.en: Of course. And the Hegemony - we, they allow this?
options.zh: 当然。那霸主呢——我们、他们，就允许这种事？

texts.en:
"Maeus Moroz is who you'll want to talk to. He's the owner-operator of the Samarra Wolves Private Security Corporation."

$HeOrShe picks up a datapad and taps at it for a moment.
texts.zh:
"你该找的是 Maeus Moroz。他是 Samarra Wolves 私营安保公司的老板兼经营者。"

$HeOrShe 拿起一块数据板，点了一会儿。

texts.en: $HeOrShe picks up a datapad and taps at it for a moment. Then gives you a skeptical look.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe 拿起一块数据板，点了一会儿，然后投来怀疑的目光。

texts.en:
"Does regular work for the Orthrus Polity with my stamp of approval, so I've got his comms right here."

$HeOrShe gives you a warning look.

"Watch out for his kid though.That one won't meet a good end, mark my words."
texts.zh:
"他常替 Orthrus 政体做事，有我的批准盖章，所以他的通讯号我这儿就有。"

$HeOrShe 递给你一个警告的眼神。

"不过得当心他那个孩子。那小子不会有好下场，记住我的话。"

texts.en:
"We sometimes allocate his firm fuel and supplies in support of officially sanctioned ops. Mostly anti-pirate patrols for the small players the Hegemony isn't bothered to track down."

"Never had any problems with Maeus. His son... well. Anyway, here's the comms. Good luck!"
texts.zh:
"我们有时会调拨燃料和补给给他的公司，支持一些官方批准的行动。多半是替那些霸主懒得去追的小角色做反海盗巡逻。"

"跟 Maeus 打交道从没出过问题。他儿子嘛... 算了。总之，这是通讯号。祝你好运！"

texts.en:
"We've always got the Wolves coming and going from the spaceport. This is their base of operations, you know? May be a bunch of cold-blooded killers, but they're OUR cold-blooded killers. Even with those hulls with Hegemony marks Maeus took in after one of those Heggie jobs."

$HeOrShe gives a cynical grin. "I sleep better knowing we're their home base. Anyway, here's his comms ID."
texts.zh:
"Wolves 的人总是从太空港进进出出。这儿是他们的行动基地，你知道吧？也许他们是一群冷血杀手，可他们是我们的冷血杀手。就连那些带着霸主标记的船体，也是 Maeus 替霸主干完一票活儿之后收进来的。"

$HeOrShe 露出一个讥讽的笑。"知道我们是他们的老家，我睡得还安稳些。总之，这是他的通讯 ID。"

texts.en:
"Pericles Moroz? You must mean Maeus; he's the owner-operator of the Samarra Wolves Private Security Corporation."

$HeOrShe picks up a datapad and taps at it.
texts.zh:
"Pericles Moroz？你说的一定是 Maeus；他是 Samarra Wolves 私营安保公司的老板兼经营者。"

$HeOrShe 拿起一块数据板，点了几下。

texts.en:
"Sorry, captain." $PersonName puts on an officious facade. "My position requires that I maintain a professional distance from such matters."

$HeOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat.

"Do you have any official business to discuss?"
texts.zh:
"抱歉，舰长。\"$PersonName 摆出一副公事公办的架势。\"我的职位要求我与这类事务保持职业距离。"

$HeOrShe 清了清$hisOrHer嗓子。

"你还有什么公务要谈吗？"

options.en: I'm trying to contact Pericles Moroz. I hear his company occasionally works for the polity...
options.zh: 我想联系 Pericles Moroz。听说他的公司偶尔替政体做事...

options.en: I'm looking to hire a merc, someone local... to, uh, support the economy of Orthrus. (lie)
options.zh: 我想雇个雇佣兵，本地人... 呃，好支持支持 Orthrus 的经济。 (说谎)

texts.en:
$PersonName looks moderately surprised, but not displeased.

"I applaud your dedication to supporting Orthrus. We've got a few private military contractors here. Hmm. Persean Kinetic Solutions is more about long-haul convoys, TopMag-Unifleet specializes in zero-g and ground ops, and... I know. You'll want to contact Maeus Moroz's outfit. They're the Samarra Wolves. Pirate-smashers you can count on."

$HeOrShe picks up a datapad and taps at it for a moment.
texts.zh:
$PersonName 显得有些意外，但并无不悦。

"我很赞赏你支持 Orthrus 的热心。我们这儿有几家私营军事承包商。嗯。Persean Kinetic Solutions 更擅长长途护航，TopMag-Unifleet 专精零重力与地面作战，还有... 我知道了。你该去联系 Maeus Moroz 的队伍。他们叫 Samarra Wolves，是收拾海盗的可靠好手。"

$HeOrShe 拿起一块数据板，点了几下。

options.en: Continue
I'd like to contact Pericles Moroz. Do you have his comms ID?
options.zh: 我想联系 Pericles Moroz。你有他的通讯 ID 吗？

texts.en:
$PersonName puts on an officious facade. "My position requires that I maintain a certain distance from... such matters."

$HeOrShe feels $heOrShe has already said too much, in other words. Perhaps another local official can help.

$HeOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat. "Perhaps there is something else I can help you with?"
texts.zh:
$PersonName 摆出一副公事公办的架势。"我的职位要求我与... 这类事务保持一定距离。"

换句话说，$HeOrShe 觉得自己已经说得太多了；$heOrShe 心里想必也清楚。也许换一位本地官员能帮上忙。

$HeOrShe 清了清$hisOrHer嗓子。"也许还有别的事我能帮上忙？"

options.en: I wish to discuss the ANDRADA files.
options.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 档案。

texts.en:
"Dolos Macario's secret files, yes."

He smiles broadly, teeth flashing perfectly.

"You can only imagine my surprise when they turned out to be of substance. Quite the conspiracy you've revealed. Or is it Macario I should thank?"

He raises his eyebrows. "You may yet be doing him service."
texts.zh:
"Dolos Macario 的秘密档案，对。"

他咧嘴一笑，牙齿白得发亮。

"你可以想象我有多意外——那些东西居然真有分量。你揭出来的阴谋可不小。或者，我该谢的是 Macario？"

他挑起眉毛。"说不定你这是在帮他。"

texts.en:
"The files you brought to me, yes."

He smiles broadly, teeth flashing perfectly.

"You can only imagine my surprise when they turned out to be of substance. Quite the conspiracy you've revealed. Or is it Dolos Macario I should thank?"

He raises his eyebrows. "You may yet be doing him service."
texts.zh:
"你带给我的那些档案，对。"

他咧嘴一笑，牙齿白得发亮。

"你可以想象我有多意外——那些东西居然真有分量。你揭出来的阴谋可不小。或者，我该谢的是 Dolos Macario？"

他挑起眉毛。"说不定你这是在帮他。"

texts.en:
"The files you brought to me, yes."

He smiles broadly, leaning back.

"Well?"
texts.zh:
"你带给我的那些档案，对。"

他咧嘴一笑，向后靠去。

"然后呢？"

texts.en:
"Macario's secret files, yes."

He smiles broadly, leaning back.

"Well?"
texts.zh:
"Macario 的秘密档案，对。"

他咧嘴一笑，向后靠去。

"然后呢？"

texts.en: "No. The topic has been discussed to my satisfaction," he says authoritatively. "Don't mention it again."
texts.zh: "不必了。这个话题已经谈得让我满意了，\"他以不容置疑的口吻说，\"别再提了。"

texts.en:
"The files you brought to Horus Yaribay before me, yes."

He leans back, smiling broadly without making any effort to look like he means it.

"Well?"
texts.zh:
"那些你先交给了 Horus Yaribay、才轮到我看到的档案，对。"

他向后一靠，咧嘴笑着，却半点没打算装出真诚。

"然后呢？"

options.en: Horus is too weak to respond. It's clear why you are Prime Demarchon.
options.zh: Horus 太软弱，根本无力回应。你为什么会是大统领，一目了然。

options.en: Uh, never mind.

texts.en:
"You're telling me things that I know, $titlePL," he says impatiently - but is his interest piqued?

"Speak plainly. Why are you here?"
texts.zh:
"你在跟我说我早就知道的事，$titlePL，"他不耐烦地说——可他的兴趣是不是被勾起来了？

"直说吧。你来做什么？"

options.en: I want to take down Macario. You're strong enough to do it.
options.zh: 我要扳倒 Macario。你有这个实力。

options.en: I seek power. If I work for you, I may achieve it.
options.zh: 我求的是权力。若为你效力，我或许能得到它。

options.en: I want to back the winning side. It's safer - and profitable.
options.zh: 我想站在赢的那一边。更安全，也有利可图。

options.en: Uh, never mind.

texts.en: "Hmm. We will speak of your... troubles," he says.
texts.zh: "嗯。你的...麻烦，我们以后再谈，"他说。

texts.en:
"But first, I ask a question of you, $titlePL," he says regally.

"It is the question of whether you are with me, with Gens Hannan, or if you are not. I would see that you given great rewards, power, and access as a client of my patronage."

"It is a choice," he says softly. "I want you to confirm it to me."

"Now."
texts.zh:
"但首先，我要问你一个问题，$titlePL，"他说，气度俨然。

"问题就是：你到底站在我这边、站在 Hannan 氏族这边，还是不。若你站过来，我会让你作为我的门客，得到丰厚的赏赐、权力与门路。"

"这是个选择，\"他轻声说，\"我要你亲口向我确认。"

"就现在。"

options.en: I am with you.
I cannot submit myself to you and your Gens.
options.zh: 我不能向你和你的氏族屈膝。

texts.en: "Good," he whispers.
texts.zh: "很好，"他低声道。

texts.en: The comms cut quite abruptly.
texts.zh: 通讯骤然中断。

texts.en: Reynard's meaning is as clear as your answer to his arrogant demand. If you want help, you'll have to go elsewhere.
texts.zh: 你对他那傲慢要求的回答，已经让 Reynard 的意思再明白不过。想要帮忙，你得另寻他人。

texts.en:
"Now - we were speaking of the ANDRADA files."

Reynard sits up, attentive. Expectant.
texts.zh:
"好了——刚才我们说到 ANDRADA 档案。"

Reynard 坐直身子，专注，带着期待。

texts.en:
He drops whatever expression he was performing for you and turns away.

The link cuts to black.
texts.zh:
他收起了那副专门演给你看的神情，转过身去。

通讯切断，屏幕一片漆黑。

texts.en: "I'll see to Dolos," he says. "But first is a matter more important to me: Fortuna Kato."
texts.zh: "Dolos 的事我会处置，\"他说，\"但眼下有件对我更重要的事：Fortuna Kato。"

options.en: Continue
Cut the comm link
Continue

texts.en:
"Fortuna Kato's puppet, Achilles, will soon launch his claim as Philip Andrada's heir."

He looks off-link as he speaks, at some view not shared with you. It's probably grand.

"She seeks to undermine the cohesion of the Persean League and primacy of Gens Hannan. A foolish plan, and doomed, but it nonetheless requires my personal response."

He smiles to himself, a feral gleam in his eyes. "She'll see that I am not lax in my attentions. And you can help me with a part of it."
texts.zh:
"Fortuna Kato 的傀儡，Achilles，很快就要公开宣称自己是 Philip Andrada 的继承人。"

他说话时目光飘向链路之外，看着一处不与你共享的景象。那景象想必很气派。

"她想瓦解英仙座联盟的团结，动摇 Hannan 氏族的首要地位。这计划很蠢，也注定失败，可终究需要我亲自应对。"

他自顾自地笑了笑，眼里闪着野性的光。"她会看到，我盯事情从不松懈。而其中一部分，你可以帮我。"

options.en: What are you proposing?

texts.en:
"A quiet and civilized war, as is proper. I have had a quantity of materiel assembled. It shall be transferred to your name before the end of our conversation."

"I want you to take this materiel to Umbra and give Imoinu Kato everything she possibly wants for her little play-revolution."

He seems very, very pleased with himself.

"Do this, and you will be rewarded."
texts.zh:
"一场安静而文明的战争，这才合规矩。我已经备好了一批军需物资，等我们谈完，就会转到你名下。"

"我要你把这批物资送到 Umbra，交给 Imoinu Kato；她那个过家家似的革命要什么，就给她什么。"

他看上去对自己满意极了。

"办成这件事，你会得到赏赐。"
effects: #AddTextSmall "You have been given fuel and supplies in a storage bay on $entity.name" highlight

texts.en:
"I was going to ask you to take weapons and supplies to Umbra to fuel one Imoinu Kato's little revolution - imagine my surprise at the report that you had already done so!"

He examines you with an oddly penetrating gaze far from his usual show of nonchalance.

"If I was a more suspicious man, I might have concerns that you shared the anarchic delusions of Antis like the Gens Kato child. But I know you better than that, $titlePL. You appreciate what power provides."

"Keep up the good work. I want the Gens Kato child to have everything she wants."
texts.zh:
"我本打算让你带武器和补给去 Umbra，给 Imoinu Kato 那场小革命添把火——结果报告说，你已经这么干过了！你可以想见我有多意外。"

他打量着你，目光锐利得有些反常，全无平日那副漫不经心。

"我要是疑心再重些，或许会担心你跟 Kato 氏族那小丫头一样，抱着 Antis 那套无政府的妄想。可我了解你，$titlePL，不至于此。你懂得权力能给你什么。"

"继续这么干。Kato 氏族那小丫头要什么，我就要她得到什么。"

texts.en:
"I was going to ask you to take weapons and supplies to Umbra to fuel one Imoinu Kato's little revolution - imagine my surprise at the report that you had already done so."

He examines you with an oddly penetrating gaze far from his usual show of nonchalance.

"If I was a more suspicious man, I might have concerns that you shared the anarchic delusions of Antis like the Gens Kato child. But I know you better than that, $titlePL. You appreciate what power provides."

He snaps his fingers at someone off-link.
texts.zh:
"我本打算让你带武器和补给去 Umbra，给 Imoinu Kato 那场小革命添把火——结果报告说，你已经这么干过了。你可以想见我有多意外。"

他打量着你，目光锐利得有些反常，全无平日那副漫不经心。

"我要是疑心再重些，或许会担心你跟 Kato 氏族那小丫头一样，抱着 Antis 那套无政府的妄想。可我了解你，$titlePL，不至于此。你懂得权力能给你什么。"

他朝链路外的某个人打了个响指。

options.en: You want me to... help Imoinu and the ARC?
options.zh: 你要我...去帮 Imoinu 和 ARC？

texts.en:
"Yes!"

He laughs.

"Nothing will vex Fortuna more. I want to see the flames from Kazeron!"

He closes his eyes to take in a slow, pleased breath.

"If there's anything left over, keep it. Use it or sell it, I don't care."
texts.zh:
"对！"

他大笑起来。

"没什么比这更让 Fortuna 恼火了。我要从 Kazeron 都能看见那火光！"

他闭上眼，缓缓吸了一口气，满心惬意。

"要是有剩下的，就留着。自己用还是卖掉，我不管。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"As for Macario's propaganda... yes, in fact, I have just the thing. Speak to Finlay Siyavong; he's an agent with Fleet Intelligence. A bit unimaginative," Reynard flashes a look of minor embarassment on Siyavong's behalf, "but competent nonetheless."

"He has much potential if he can get over... well, you'll see. My secretary will arrange his comms-id for you, I'm sure."

Reynard looks away, something off-link catching his eye.
texts.zh:
"至于 Macario 的那套宣传...没错，我这儿正好有个办法。去找 Finlay Siyavong，他是舰队情报部的特工。人有点缺乏想象力，\"Reynard 脸上掠过一丝替 Siyavong 感到的尴尬，\"但办事还是靠得住的。"

"只要他能克服...算了，你见了就知道。他很有潜力。我的秘书会把他的通讯编号给你，我想没问题。"

Reynard 移开目光，链路外有什么东西吸引了他。

options.en: I've spoken with Agent Siyavong before.
options.zh: 我之前和 Siyavong 特工谈过。

texts.en:
"Wonderful," he says in a way that ensures you are not mistaken about the fact that he does not care.

"Fleet Intelligence will probably ask you to pledge yourself to support Achilles Andrada," he waves a hand, growing bored.

"Do it, or don't, I care not."
texts.zh:
"太好了，"他说道，那语气确保你不会误会——他其实一点也不在乎。

"舰队情报部大概会让你表态支持 Achilles Andrada，"他摆了摆手，已经开始觉得无聊。

"做不做，随你，我不在乎。"

options.en: Don't you want to undermine Achilles, and therefore Kato?
options.zh: 你不想搞垮 Achilles，从而搞垮 Kato 吗？

texts.en:
"Ultimately." He looks over his desk at you. "But I find it amusing to allow Fortuna to believe the millions of credits she's committed to this scheme, and continues to commit, will pay off."

He barks a laugh to himself.

"Let us speak of it again after the war is announced. Now I have much to do. Probably. Good day then, $titlePL."

The comms cut seemingly of their own accord, to a holding pattern, the crest of Gens Hannan.
texts.zh:
"终究会。\"他隔着桌子看向你。\"不过我倒觉得有趣：让 Fortuna 相信她投进这个计划的几百万星币——还有她继续投的那些——终会有回报。"

他自顾自地短笑了一声。

"等战争宣布之后，我们再谈这件事。眼下我有很多事要办。大概吧。那就这样，$titlePL，日安。"

通讯仿佛自己断了，转入了等待画面：Hannan 氏族的纹章。

texts.en:
"Ultimately." He looks over his desk at you. "But I find it amusing to allow Fortuna to believe the millions of credits she's committed to this scheme, and continues to commit, will pay off."

He barks a laugh to himself, then pauses.

"Although... yes, I think I would have you speak to Horus Yaribay."
texts.zh:
"终究会。\"他隔着桌子看向你。\"不过我倒觉得有趣：让 Fortuna 相信她投进这个计划的几百万星币——还有她继续投的那些——终会有回报。"

他自顾自地短笑了一声，随即顿住。

"不过...对，我想让你去和 Horus Yaribay 谈谈。"

texts.en:
Reynard's secretary appears, for only a moment. "Hold please, I shall forward the link per the Prime Demarchon's request," they say, before disappearing.

The crest of Gens Hannan appears again for a moment. An upthrust, open hand. Golden rays.

You're pondering Reynard's petty revenge against Fortuna via her granddaughter Imoinu when your quartermaster pings you about an inquiry from a warehouse manager on $entity.name.

Before you can respond, the comms flash an incoming link.
texts.zh:
Reynard 的秘书只露了一瞬。"请稍候，我这就按大统领的吩咐把链路转过去，"说完便消失了。

Hannan 氏族的纹章又出现了一瞬：一只向上张开的手，金色的光芒。

你正琢磨着 Reynard 如何借 Fortuna 的孙女 Imoinu 来实施他那点小报复，军需官忽然发来提示：$entity.name 上有一位仓库管理员提出查询。

你还没来得及回应，通讯界面上闪起一条接入请求。

options.en: Accept the link

texts.en:
"Advise him, as a contact, as a friend, to work against Fortuna Kato," he says, a slow smile growing at the thought.

"He is soft and will respond to sentiment. Then let us speak of all of this again, once the war is announced, as soon it must be. I have much to do now, probably."

"Good day, $titlePL."

The comms cut seemingly of their own accord.
texts.zh:
"以联系人的身份、以朋友的身份劝他，去跟 Fortuna Kato 作对，"他说，想到这儿，笑容缓缓绽开。

"他心软，吃感情这一套。等战争宣布之后——那不会太久了——我们再把这一切谈一遍。眼下我有很多事要办，大概吧。"

"日安，$titlePL。"

通讯仿佛自己断了。

texts.en:
"It is presumptive to question me, $titlePL." He narrows his eyes. "But I am in a forgiving mood."

He flicks with his hand, discarding his own indignation.

"Of course I knew of Kalian. He's the product of a minor and long-standing arrangement with our 'friends' from Askonia. A little insurance for Philip, a little hostage for us."
texts.zh:
"质疑我，是越界，$titlePL。\"他眯起眼睛。\"不过我眼下心情宽厚。"

他随手一挥，连自己的不悦也一并挥开了。

"Kalian 的事我当然知道。那是我们与 Askonia 那些'朋友'之间一项不起眼却由来已久的安排。对 Philip 是一份小小的保险，对我们则是一个小小的人质。"

options.en: Wait, you're working with Macario?
options.zh: 等等，你在和 Macario 合作？

texts.en:
"Mind your tone, $titlePL," Reynard says, though casually.

"Our Diktat representative has not been entirely forthright about Macario's personal attention to the matter, nor about the scope of Philip's... ambitions. Your files," he extends a charitable hand. "Prove their misdirection."

"Not that I blame them, of course. I wouldn't trust me either."

"I suppose I have you to thank." Reynard almost rolls his eyes. "A rare concession, do enjoy it."
texts.zh:
"注意你的口气，$titlePL，"Reynard 说，语气倒还随意。

"我们那位辛达强权代表，并没有完全坦白 Macario 对这件事的亲自关注，也没有说清 Philip 那些...野心的范围。而你的档案，\"他伸出手，姿态宽宏，\"证明了他们的误导。"

"当然，我不怪他们。换了我，我也不会信我自己。"

"看来我该谢你。\"Reynard 几乎翻了个白眼。\"难得的让步，好好享用吧。"

texts.en:
"Mm. Clearly."

Reynard doesn't seem terribly concerned.
texts.zh:
"唔。看来确实如此。"

Reynard 看上去并不怎么在意。

options.en: You don't seem terribly concerned.
You have a plan, don't you.
I wish to offer my assistance with your... response.
options.zh: 我想为你的...回应出一份力。

texts.en: "Consider it thus: Fortuna Kato is investing tremendous resources into a risky gambit with an unreliable partner." He grins toothily. "It is not every cycle that your closest competition conspires to provide such an opening."
texts.zh: "不妨这样看：Fortuna Kato 正把大量资源押在一场豪赌上，而她的伙伴并不可靠。\"他咧嘴一笑，露出牙齿。\"你最亲近的竞争对手主动送来这样一个机会，可不是每个星历年都有的事。"

texts.en:
He puts his hands behind his head, leaning back, quite comfortable.

"I shall perhaps make use of you in this regard as the situation... ripens."
texts.zh:
他双手枕在脑后，向后一靠，一副怡然自得的样子。

"等局势...成熟些，我也许会在这件事上用得上你。"

texts.en:
He produces a concessionary smile, as if from an approving teacher to a clever student.

"Consider it thus: Fortuna Kato is investing tremendous resources into a risky gambit with an unreliable partner." His grin becomes toothier. "It is not every cycle that your closest competition conspires to provide such an opening."
texts.zh:
他挤出一个带点让步意味的笑，像是老师在夸奖一个机灵的学生。

"不妨这样看：Fortuna Kato 正把大量资源押在一场豪赌上，而她的伙伴并不可靠。\"他的笑容咧得更开，牙齿都露了出来。\"你最亲近的竞争对手主动送来这样一个机会，可不是每个星历年都有的事。"

texts.en:
"It pleases me to hear you say this. I shall perhaps make use of you in this regard as the situation... ripens."

He puts his hands behind his head, leaning back, quite comfortable.

"It is not every cycle that your closest competition conspires to provide such an opening. Fortuna Kato is investing tremendous resources into a risky gambit with an unreliable partner."

He produces a toothy grin.
texts.zh:
"听你这么说，我很高兴。等局势...成熟些，我也许会在这件事上用得上你。"

他双手枕在脑后，向后一靠，一副怡然自得的样子。

"你最亲近的竞争对手主动送来这样一个机会，可不是每个星历年都有的事。Fortuna Kato 正把大量资源押在一场豪赌上，而她的伙伴并不可靠。"

他咧嘴一笑，露出牙齿。

texts.en:
"Good," he says.

"And before you succumb to the impulse by making a gauche inquiry, this has not been done at my order. Why dirty my own hands with such frivolity when there are so many others who are more than willing?"

He leans back comfortably, quite content with the situation.
texts.zh:
"很好，"他说。

"还有——趁你还没忍不住提出那种失礼的问题：这事不是我下令做的。既然有那么多人心甘情愿代劳，我何必用自己的手去沾这种无聊的事？"

他舒坦地向后一靠，对这局面相当满意。

texts.en:
Reynard looks at you for a moment, a gleam in his eye. His smirk is not entirely unfriendly.

"Your offer is appreciated, but no. It amuses me to watch the drama unfold," he says, looking off-link somewhere. Perhaps at a gorgeous landscape.

"I've a notion that this may be worked to my advantage," he lifts a finger at you, looking smug. "But it shan't do to tell too early. Watch closely. You may learn something, $titlePL."
texts.zh:
Reynard 看了你片刻，眼里有光。他的笑不算全然不友善。

"你的提议我很领情，但不必。看着这出戏演下去，我挺开心，"他说，目光飘向通讯之外某处。也许是某片华美的风景。

"我有个想法，这件事或许能为我所用，\"他朝你竖起一根手指，一脸得色，\"不过说太早可不行。看仔细了。你或许能学到点什么，$titlePL。"

texts.en:
As you begin to explain Reynard waves an interruption.

"Yes, yes, I've read the report - and between the lines. Macario usurped one or more elements of the clone program in order to secure a means to advance his personal agenda. An obvious play."

He drums his fingers on his luxurious desk.

"This 'Hector' will announce that Supreme Executor Philip Andrada has, sadly and finally, died of 'natural causes' and he's been forced, tearfully, to take his father's throne while Dolos smirks on the parade stand behind him."

"We'll deal with it in due time."
texts.zh:
你刚开口解释，Reynard 便挥手打断。

"知道，知道，报告我读过——连字缝里的也读了。Macario 篡夺了克隆计划的一环或几环，为的是弄到一个能推进他私心的手段。招数太明显了。"

他用手指在奢华的书桌上敲了敲。

"这个'Hector'会宣布：最高元首 Philip Andrada 不幸终于'自然死亡'，而他含泪被迫继承父亲的宝座，Dolos 就在他身后的检阅台上冷笑。"

"到时候再收拾。"

texts.en:
As you begin to explain Reynard waves an interruption.

"Yes, yes, I've read the report - and between the lines. Macario usurped one or more elements of the clone program in order to secure a means to advance his personal agenda. An obvious play."

He taps manicured fingers on his luxurious desk. They stop. His eyes turns to you.

"And how sure are you that he was in that asteroid when you blew it up?" He doesn't wait for an answer. "Not sure enough, I think."

"你炸掉那颗小行星的时候，有多确定他就在里面？\"他不等你回答。\"我看，还不够确定。"

texts.en:
He snaps his fingers, interrupting your explanation.

"The intention is that we are surprised when this 'Hector' announces that Supreme Executor Philip Andrada has, sadly and finally, died of 'natural causes' and he has been forced, tearfully, to take his father's throne while Dolos smirks on the parade stand behind him."

Pausing to giving you a patient look, he says, "I do not plan to be surprised. We'll deal with it in due time."

他打了个响指，打断你的解释。

"他们的用意，就是让我们在这个'Hector'宣布时措手不及：最高元首 Philip Andrada 不幸终于'自然死亡'，而他含泪被迫继承父亲的宝座，Dolos 就在他身后的检阅台上冷笑。"

他顿了顿，用一种近乎耐心的目光看着你，说："我没打算措手不及。到时候再收拾。"

texts.en:
"Mm," he says. "Yes, I'm familiar with the situation. Philip Andrada transformed into a weak-necked academician. It's the punchline of a sophomoric joke."

Reynard doesn't manage a smile, but he sits up, and anger enters his voice.

"The real scandal is the lapse in Academy security, perhaps due to the Hegemony brute Baird's put in charge. Probably reporting everything back to Daud, if he can remember any three words long enough to make it to a comm-link."
texts.zh:
"嗯，\"他说，\"是，这局面我清楚。Philip Andrada 变成了一个缩着脖子的院士。这像个幼稚笑话的包袱。"

Reynard 没能挤出笑容，但他坐直了，声音里多了怒气。

"真正的丑闻是学院安保的疏漏——多半是因为霸主派来管事的那个莽夫 Baird。他大概把一切都回报给 Daud 了，只要他能记住哪怕三个词、还能撑到通讯接通。"

texts.en:
"Mm," he says. "And he was killed, I know. Boo-hoo."

Reynard sits up, anger entering his voice.

"The real scandal is the lapse in Academy security, perhaps due to the Hegemony brute Baird's put in charge. Probably reporting everything back to Daud, if he can remember any three words long enough to make it to a comm-link."
texts.zh:
"嗯，\"他说，\"而且他死了，我知道。真惨。"

Reynard 坐直身子，声音里透出怒气。

"真正的丑闻是学院安保的疏漏——多半是因为霸主派来管事的那个莽夫 Baird。他大概把一切都回报给 Daud 了，只要他能记住哪怕三个词、还能撑到通讯接通。"

texts.en:
"I've sent a representative to express my displeasure; many of my Gens' offspring, and of my clients besides, attend the Galatia Academy and I won't hold with assassination."

He scoffs, annoyed, then brushes the issue away. His anger, at least, is directed elsewhere.

"We'll speak no more of it."
texts.zh:
"我已派了一名代表去表达不满；我氏族里许多子弟，还有不少附庸的子弟，都在 Galatia 学院就读。我容不下暗杀这种事。"

他恼火地哼了一声，随即把这事拂开。至少，他的怒气是冲着别处去的。

"此事不必再提。"

texts.en:
"This is about those files, isn't it."

He gives you an accusing look.

"You decrypted them. And now... what?"
texts.zh:
"这是为了那些文件，是吧。"

他用责备的目光看着你。

"你把它们解开了。然后呢...你想怎么样？"

texts.en:
He looks suspicious.

"Production problems in the fuel industry, disruption of the supply chain? Hmm," he taps at a TriPad. "I've got capital to work with on the fuel angle..."

Arroyo looks up from reviewing his charts and portfolios. "Or is this more. It is, isn't it."
texts.zh:
他面露怀疑。

"燃料产业的生产出了问题，供应链断了？嗯，\"他敲了敲 TriPad，\"燃料这块我手上有资金可以动..."

Arroyo 从他那堆图表和投资组合上抬起头。"还是说，这事比那更大。是的，更大，对吧。"

You begin to explain about the files, about what appear to be seven clone-sons of Andrada in seven star systems. You've confirmed a few, and each seems to have been raised in unique circumstances...

Arroyo is leaning on one hand, the fingers digging deep into his temple.

Arroyo 一手支着头，手指深深掐进太阳穴。

texts.en:
You begin to explain about the files, about what appear to be seven clone-sons of Andrada in seven star systems. You've confirmed most of the files' content, finding clones of Andrada raised in various unique circumstances... and there may be a conspiracy targeting them.

Arroyo is leaning on one hand, the fingers digging deep into his temple.
texts.zh:
你开始讲那些文件，讲那似乎是七个散布在七个星系里的 Andrada 克隆儿子。文件的内容你已核实了大半：这些 Andrada 的克隆体成长于各不相同、各自独特的环境...而且，似乎有一场阴谋正冲着他们而去。

Arroyo 一手支着头，手指深深掐进太阳穴。

He takes a deep breath, then slowly lets it out.

"I see," he says finally. "So what?"
texts.zh:
他深吸一口气，再缓缓吐出来。

"我明白了，\"他终于开口，\"所以呢？"

texts.en: "I think we're done with that." He picks up a TriPad. "Anything else?"
texts.zh: "我看这事就到此为止吧。\"他拿起 TriPad，\"还有别的事？"
