texts.en:
"Never said it wasn't," he says. "If you detect a certain exasperation in my manner credit it to your recklessness."

He takes a steady, calming breath.

"And I can't say I'm the least bit surprised Andrada had this scheme cooking for... since the beginning of his hostile takeover, from the sounds of it. Makes sense given his fundamentals."
texts.zh:
"我可没说过它不重要，\"他说，\"你要是在我身上瞧出一股不耐烦，那得记在你自己的鲁莽账上。"

他稳稳吸了一口气，把心气压下去。

"而且我一点也不意外 Andrada 早就炖着这么一锅计划...听上去，从他开始那场敌意收购的时候就在炖了。以他的基本面，这很说得通。"

texts.en: "Sure," he says. "And I'm not surprised Andrada had something like this cooking... from the beginning of his hostile takeover, from the sounds of it. It makes sense given his fundamentals."
texts.zh: "当然，\"他说，\"我也不意外 Andrada 早就炖着这么一锅东西...听上去，从他开始那场敌意收购的时候起就在炖了。以他的基本面来看，这很合理。"

texts.en:
"Imagine you're an egotistical maniac," he gives you a look. "Not merely egotistical a normal, justified amount, like me. Imagine a real loose fitting."

"If you really needed a backup, you could create children. Clones are a step better, though. More control. A more perfect vessel because you can count on them looking like you, more or less. Appeals to the ego, right?"

"Setting that aside, your first option would be life-extension, of course. But what if you're a paranoid dictator under tech restrictions and constant threat of hostile covert ops? Hard to find life-extension care you can trust."
texts.zh:
"想象你是个自大狂，\"他瞥了你一眼，\"不是像我这样，只自大到正常、合理的分量。想象一个彻底脱了缰的。"

"如果你真需要一个备份，你可以生孩子。克隆体要更进一步：更好控制。也更像一件完美的容器——你差不多能指望他们长得像你。这对自大狂很有吸引力，对吧？"

"撇开这个不谈，你的首选当然是延寿手段。可要是你是个偏执的独裁者，受着技术管制，还时刻面临敌对秘密行动的威胁呢？你很难找到信得过的延寿医疗。"

options.en: Why?

texts.en:
He rubs his fingers through his beard, thoughtful.

"They're delicate operations, potentially long recovery time. Need to stay awake to make sure no one gets any ideas. So do it quick and sophisticated. Domain-era tech like that has a limited pool of practitioners, and they're closely watched."

"Imagine if even one technician was compromised. Could do it subtle, switch a few codes in a custom protein-nanite top-up... built-in delay, make whatever went wrong look natural. Or like the fault of someone else."

Arroyo puts his hands behind his head, and leans back in his luxurious chair.

"Glad I'm not him."
texts.zh:
他手指捋过胡须，若有所思。

"那些手术都很精细，恢复期可能很长。你得保持清醒，好确保没人动歪心思。所以要做得又快又精。那种人之领时代的技术，能上手的人本来就没几个，而且都被盯得很紧。"

"想想看，只要有一个技师被人拿住了。动手可以很隐蔽：在定制的蛋白纳米补剂里换掉几个编码...设好延迟，让出问题的地方看起来是自然发生，或者像是别人的过失。"

Arroyo 双手枕到脑后，往他那张奢华的椅子里一靠。

"幸好我不是他。"

options.en: Are you saying Philip Andrada was murdered by a life extension treatment?
options.zh: 你是说 Philip Andrada 是被人用延寿治疗害死的？

texts.en:
"Does it matter what got him?"

He manages the suggestion of a shrug; not easy in his pose.

"I'm saying it could be done. And if I wanted to live a long, happy life - and I do - then I wouldn't go around making major powers of the Persean Sector my enemy."
texts.zh:
"他是怎么倒下的，有区别吗？"

他勉强做出一个耸肩的样子——以他这个姿势，可不容易。

"我是说，这种事办得到。而我要想长命百岁、过得舒坦——我确实想——那我就不会到处把英仙座星域的大势力都树成敌人。"

texts.en:
"Oh yes," he says confidently.

"And I'll consider my advice to you in this conversation to be sufficient payment for the tip-off. So don't try angling for a cut. You've got to do the work yourself."

He smirks.
texts.zh:
"哦，那当然，"他答得很笃定。

"至于这次谈话里给你的这些建议，我就当作够付你那份情报的钱了。所以别想着再从我这儿分一杯。活儿得你自己去干。"

他嘴角一撇，笑了。

texts.en:
"If I were you," he says, "I'd forget about all of it, sell my fleet, and invest in something stable so I could live a long, comfortable life."

He glares at you pre-emptively. "And if you don't like that advice, you shouldn't have asked in the first place."
texts.zh:
"要是我是你，\"他说，\"我就把这一切都忘掉，把舰队卖掉，投点稳当的产业，好让自己长长久久、安安稳稳地过完这辈子。"

他抢先瞪了你一眼。"你要是不爱听这建议，当初就不该来问。"

texts.en:
"Good. Me too." He picks up a TriPad.

"Anything else going on? Maybe something nice? Something that won't get poison slipped in my dinner or get me arrested by a covert-ops snatch-squad?"
texts.zh:
"很好。我也一样。"他拿起 TriPad。

"还有别的事吗？来点好消息？那种不会有人往我晚饭里下毒、也不会害我被秘密行动组的抓人小队逮走的事？"

texts.en:
"No. I'm already stressed out because you brought this up, whatever 'this' is."

He leans back. "Besides, I have good chems for this sort of thing."

"Now, explain."
texts.zh:
"不。你一提这事我就已经有压力了，管它'这事'是什么。"

他往后一靠。"再说，这种事我有上好的药剂。"

"现在，说吧。"

"Now, explain."

texts.en:
The comms link holds for a moment on the understated crest of Persean League Fleet Intelligence before connecting.

"Greetings, $TitlePL $playerLastName," Siyavong says.
texts.zh:
通讯链路在英仙座联盟舰队情报部那枚低调的徽记上停留了片刻，随后接通。

"你好，$TitlePL $playerLastName，"Siyavong 说。

texts.en:
He proceeds immediately into a rant.

"It was a fool who provided a planet-killer to the Sindrian Diktat," Siyavong says forcefully. "Not a monster, I think. Merely a credits-hungry fool. Or worse, a believer."

He looks away. There is more anger in his voice than you've ever heard before - something well beyond the uptight annoyance you might expect, what with his educated Kazeronian accent.

"I would hate to think it was a believer."

An awkward silence extends.
texts.zh:
他立刻发作起来。

"把行星杀手交给辛达强权的，是个蠢货，\"Siyavong 语气强硬地说。\"我想不是恶棍。只是个见钱眼开的蠢货。或者更糟——一个信徒。"

他移开视线。他声音里的怒气，比你以往听过的都要重——远不止他那口受过良好教育的 Kazeron 腔调本该带来的那种拘谨的烦躁。

"我真不愿去想那是个信徒。"

尴尬的沉默漫延开来。

texts.en:
"Achilles Andrada reigns as Demarchon of the Sindrian Diktat."

Siyavong taps his desk. And you see his half-smile appear.

"Victories which are too great can turn into dangerous things, you know. Sometimes it is best if success is... moderate."
texts.zh:
"Achilles Andrada 以辛达强权统领的身份掌权。"

Siyavong 敲了敲书桌。你看到他那抹半笑浮了上来。

"你要知道，太大的胜利是会变成危险东西的。有时候，成功...适度一些反而最好。"

texts.en:
"Achilles Andrada reigns as Supreme Executor."

"And he's slipped from... Gens influence, shall we say. But at least it was not, as many are also now saying, a 'great' victory."

Siyavong taps his desk.

"Great victories can be a dangerous thing, you know. Sometimes it is best for most of us to avoid too many of them. Accounting for context, of course."
texts.zh:
"Achilles Andrada 以最高元首的身份掌权。"

"而且他已经摆脱了...氏族的操控，姑且这么说吧。但至少，那并不是如今许多人也在说的那种'伟大'胜利。"

Siyavong 敲了敲书桌。

"你要知道，伟大的胜利可能是危险的东西。有时候，对我们大多数人来说，这类胜利少一些反而最好。当然，这要视情况而定。"

texts.en:
"Achilles Andrada reigns as Supreme Executor after a great victory."

Siyavong taps his desk. A nervous tic?

"Great victories can be dangerous. Sometimes it is best for... for the rest of us if there are not too many of them."

His half-smile does not re-appear.
texts.zh:
"Achilles Andrada 在一场伟大胜利之后以最高元首的身份掌权。"

Siyavong 敲了敲书桌。是紧张的怪癖吗？

"伟大的胜利可能很危险。有时候，对...对我们其余人来说，这类胜利不要太多才好。"

他那抹半笑没有再出现。

texts.en:
"Hector Andrada," he says, and looks at you as if that's statement enough. He's tapping his desk. A nervous tic?

"Great victories can be dangerous. Sometimes it is best for... for most of us if there are not too many of them. The results, you see; well..."

His half-smile does not re-appear.
texts.zh:
"Hector Andrada，"他说，看着你，仿佛这名字就已经说明了一切。他敲着书桌。是紧张的怪癖吗？

"伟大的胜利可能很危险。有时候，对...对我们大多数人来说，这类胜利不要太多才好。你看那些后果；唉..."

他那抹半笑没有再出现。

texts.en:
"Hector Andrada," he says, and looks at you as if that's statement enough.

"But it was not, as many are now saying, a great victory." He emphasizes that word, 'great'. Siyavong taps his desk. A nervous tic?

"Great victories can be dangerous. Sometimes it is best for most of us if there are not too many of them," a flicker of smile regrows, "with context accounted for, of course."
texts.zh:
"Hector Andrada，"他说，看着你，仿佛这名字就已经说明了一切。

"但那并不是——如今许多人正这么说——一场伟大的胜利。"他把'伟大'这个词咬得很重。Siyavong 敲了敲书桌。是紧张的怪癖吗？

"伟大的胜利可能很危险。有时候，对我们大多数人来说，这类胜利不要太多才好，\"一丝笑意重新泛起，\"当然，这要把具体情况算进去。"

texts.en:
"The end of the Sindrian Diktat," he says, and looks at you as if that's statement enough. "It was no great victory for anyone. Though perhaps the Hegemony is pleased to make example of 'their' mutiny?"

Siyavong taps his desk. A nervous tic?

"Great victories can be dangerous. Sometimes it is best for most of us if there are not too many of them," a flicker of a smile regrows, "with context accounted for, of course."
texts.zh:
"辛达强权的终结，\"他说，看着你，仿佛这名字就已经说明了一切。\"那对谁都不是什么伟大的胜利。不过也许霸主倒乐意拿'他们的'那场叛乱来做个榜样？"

Siyavong 敲了敲书桌。是紧张的怪癖吗？

"伟大的胜利可能很危险。有时候，对我们大多数人来说，这类胜利不要太多才好，\"一丝笑意重新泛起，\"当然，这要把具体情况算进去。"

texts.en:
He frowns. Not a subject he wished to revisit, apparently.

"He cannot become anything more than he was." Siyavong raises a finger at you. "I suggest that you not read too much into this absence of information. You recall his condition - which is almost certainly irreversible barring the provision of a miracle which, as a humble servant of the Fleet Intelligence Service, is not amongst the privileges I may draw upon to perform my duties."

"The matter is effectively closed."

He is still frowning.
texts.zh:
他皱起眉头。看来这不是他想再谈的话题。

"他不可能比从前更有起色。\"Siyavong 朝你竖起一根手指。\"我建议你别从这份信息缺失里读出太多东西。你记得他的状况——那几乎肯定是不可逆的，除非出现奇迹；而作为舰队情报部一名卑微的雇员，动用奇迹并不在我履行职责所能享有的特权之列。"

"这件事实际上已经了结了。"

他仍然皱着眉。

texts.en:
"Yes, well." A grimace. "Not quite like this."

He pauses. Watching you.

"What I want is what is best for the safety and security of the Persean League, $titlePL."
texts.zh:
"是啊，好吧。\"他嘴角一抽，\"可不是这样收场的。"

他顿了顿，目光打量着你。

"我所求的，是对英仙座联盟的安全与安稳最有利的结果，$titlePL。"

texts.en:
He turns his head at you, almost coy.

"I thank you, $titlePL. For your help."
texts.zh:
他转过头看你，神情近乎羞怯。

"我谢谢你，$titlePL。谢谢你的帮助。"

texts.en:
He turns his head at you, almost coy.

"We must all contend with how events played out. You in your way, me in mine. It is, after all, my duty."

Siyavong folds his hands together and re-affirms his ironic half-smile like the lowering of a blast-shield.
texts.zh:
他转过头看你，神情近乎羞怯。

"我们都得面对事情最终的走向。你以你的方式，我以我的。毕竟，这是我的职责。"

Siyavong 十指交叠，重新挂上那抹带着讥诮的半笑，仿佛降下一道防爆闸门。

texts.en:
"What I want," Siyavong says.

He makes as if to consider the question for a moment.

"What I want is the safety and security of the Persean League, $titlePL." A quick smile. "Contingency and circumstance willing, we may get it."
texts.zh:
"我所求的，"Siyavong 说。

他装模作样地思索了片刻。

"我所求的，是英仙座联盟的安全与安稳，$titlePL。\"他飞快地一笑，\"若时势与机缘允许，我们或许能得到它。"

texts.en:
"Undeniably. But power abhors a vacuum."

Siyavong looks away with a sigh.

"What I want is to ensure the safety and security of the Persean League, $titlePL, and the benefits that happy situation would confer upon the Persean Sector entire."

"Contingency and circumstance willing, it will require... vigilance. The specifics of which need not concern you at this moment."
texts.zh:
"无可否认。但权力厌恶真空。"

Siyavong 叹了口气，移开目光。

"我所求的，是确保英仙座联盟的安全与安稳，$titlePL，以及这一可喜局面将为整个英仙座星域带来的好处。"

"若时势与机缘允许，这需要...警惕。具体细节此刻不必劳你费心。"
